field.name: Account
field.synopsis: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

field.name: AdvId
field.synopsis: Unique identifier of advertisement message.

field.name: AdvRefID
field.synopsis: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE transaction types.

field.name: AdvSide
field.synopsis: Broker's side of advertised trade

field.name: AdvTransType
field.synopsis: Identifies advertisement message transaction type

field.name: AvgPx
field.synopsis: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

field.name: BeginSeqNo
field.synopsis: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent

field.name: BeginString
field.synopsis: Identifies beginning of new message and session protocol version by means of a session profile identifier (see FIX Session Layer for details). ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted).

field.name: BodyLength
field.synopsis: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

field.name: CheckSum
field.synopsis: Three byte, simple checksum (see Volume 2: "Checksum Calculation" for description). ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e. serves, with the trailing <SOH>, as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters. (Always unencrypted)

field.name: ClOrdID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the buy-side (institution, broker, intermediary etc.) (identified by SenderCompID(49) or OnBehalfOfCompID(115) as appropriate). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms, particularly those which electronically submit multi-day orders, trade globally or throughout market close periods, should ensure uniqueness across days, for example by embedding a date within the ClOrdID(11) field.

field.name: Commission
field.synopsis: Commission. Note if CommType (13) is percentage, Commission of 5% should be represented as .05.

field.name: CommType
field.synopsis: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the total commission based on the rate.

field.name: CumQty
field.synopsis: Total quantity (e.g. number of shares) filled.

field.name: Currency
field.synopsis: Identifies currency used for price or quantity fields, depending on the asset class being traded. CurrencyCodeSource(2897) may be used to disambiguate the code source scheme used, and ISO 4217 is the default scheme if absent.

field.name: EndSeqNo
field.synopsis: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent. If request is for a single message BeginSeqNo (7) = EndSeqNo. If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo = "0" (representing infinity).

field.name: ExecID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier of execution message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN) (will be 0 (zero) for ExecType (150)=I (Order Status)).

field.name: ExecInst
field.synopsis: Instructions for order handling on exchange trading floor. If more than one instruction is applicable to an order, this field can contain multiple instructions separated by space. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

code.name: FixedPegToLocalBestBidOrOfferAtTimeOfOrder
code.synopsis: Fixed peg to local best bid or offer at time of order

code.name: SingleExecutionRequestedForBlockTrade
code.synopsis: Single execution requested for block trade

code.name: ExecuteAsDeltaNeutral
code.synopsis: Execute as delta neutral using volatility provided

field.name: ExecRefID
field.synopsis: Reference identifier used with Trade, Trade Cancel and Trade Correct execution types.

field.name: HandlInst
field.synopsis: Instructions for order handling on Broker trading floor

code.name: AutomatedExecutionNoIntervention
code.synopsis: Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention

code.name: AutomatedExecutionInterventionOK
code.synopsis: Automated execution order, public, Broker intervention OK

field.name: SecurityIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID(48) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: IOIID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier of IOI message.

field.name: IOIQltyInd
field.synopsis: Relative quality of indication

field.name: IOIRefID
field.synopsis: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE, transaction types.

field.name: IOIQty
field.synopsis: Quantity (e.g. number of shares) in numeric form or relative size.

field.name: IOITransType
field.synopsis: Identifies IOI message transaction type

field.name: LastCapacity
field.synopsis: Broker capacity in order execution

field.name: LastMkt
field.synopsis: Market of execution for last fill, or an indication of the market where an order was routed

field.name: LastPx
field.synopsis: Price of this (last) fill.

field.name: LastQty
field.synopsis: Quantity (e.g. shares) bought/sold on this (last) fill.

field.name: NoLinesOfText
field.synopsis: Identifies number of lines of text body

field.name: MsgSeqNum
field.synopsis: Integer message sequence number.

field.name: MsgType
field.synopsis: Defines message type ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

field.name: NewSeqNo
field.synopsis: New sequence number

field.name: OrderID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which accept multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the OrderID field to assure uniqueness across days.

field.name: OrderQty
field.synopsis: Quantity ordered. This represents the number of shares for equities or par, face or nominal value for FI instruments.

field.name: OrdStatus
field.synopsis: Identifies current status of order. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

code.name: PendingCancel
code.synopsis: Pending Cancel (i.e. result of Order Cancel Request)

code.name: PendingReplace
code.synopsis: Pending Replace (i.e. result of Order Cancel/Replace Request)

field.name: OrdType
field.synopsis: Order type.

code.name: Funari
code.synopsis: Funari (Limit day order with unexecuted portion handles as Market On Close. E.g. Japan)

code.name: MarketWithLeftOverAsLimit
code.synopsis: Market With Left Over as Limit

code.name: PreviousFundValuationPoint
code.synopsis: Previous Fund Valuation Point (Historic pricing; for CIV)

code.name: NextFundValuationPoint
code.synopsis: Next Fund Valuation Point (Forward pricing; for CIV)

code.name: StopLimitOnBidOrOffer
code.synopsis: Stop Limit on Bid or Offer

field.name: OrigClOrdID
field.synopsis: ClOrdID (11) of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) as assigned by the institution, used to identify the previous order in cancel and cancel/replace requests.

field.name: OrigTime
field.synopsis: Time of message origination (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT"))

field.name: PossDupFlag
field.synopsis: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

field.name: Price
field.synopsis: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

field.name: RefSeqNum
field.synopsis: Reference message sequence number

field.name: SecurityID
field.synopsis: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource (22) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityIDSource.

field.name: SenderCompID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

field.name: SenderSubID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

field.name: SendingTime
field.synopsis: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

field.name: Quantity
field.synopsis: Overall/total quantity (e.g. number of shares)

field.name: Side
field.synopsis: Side of order (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

code.name: Cross
code.synopsis: Cross (orders where counterparty is an exchange, valid for all messages except IOIs)

field.name: Symbol
field.synopsis: Ticker symbol. Common, "human understood" representation of the security. SecurityID (48) value can be specified if no symbol exists (e.g. non-exchange traded Collective Investment Vehicles)

field.name: TargetCompID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify receiving firm.

field.name: TargetSubID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

field.name: Text
field.synopsis: Free format text string

field.name: TimeInForce
field.synopsis: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Absence of this field is interpreted as DAY. NOTE not applicable to CIV Orders.

field.name: TransactTime
field.synopsis: Timestamp when the business transaction represented by the message occurred.

field.name: Urgency
field.synopsis: Urgency flag

field.name: ValidUntilTime
field.synopsis: Indicates expiration time of indication message (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

field.name: SettlType
field.synopsis: Indicates order settlement period. If present, SettlDate (64) overrides this field. If both SettlType (63) and SettDate (64) are omitted, the default for SettlType (63) is 0 (Regular)

code.name: Regular
code.synopsis: Regular / FX Spot settlement (T+1 or T+2 depending on currency)

code.name: FXSpotNextSettlement
code.synopsis: FX Spot Next settlement (Spot+1, aka next day)

field.name: SettlDate
field.synopsis: Specific date of trade settlement (SettlementDate) in YYYYMMDD format.

field.name: SymbolSfx
field.synopsis: Additional information about the security (e.g. preferred, warrants, etc.). Note also see SecurityType (167).

code.name: EUCPWithLumpSumInterest
code.synopsis: EUCP with lump-sum interest rather than discount price

code.name: WhenIssued
code.synopsis: "When Issued" for a security to be reissued under an old CUSIP or ISIN

field.name: ListID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for list as assigned by institution, used to associate multiple individual orders. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which generate multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the ListID field to assure uniqueness across days.

field.name: ListSeqNo
field.synopsis: Sequence of individual order within list (i.e. ListSeqNo of TotNoOrders (68), 2 of 25, 3 of 25, . . . )

field.name: TotNoOrders
field.synopsis: Total number of list order entries across all messages. Should be the sum of all NoOrders (73) in each message that has repeating list order entries related to the same ListID (66). Used to support fragmentation.

field.name: ListExecInst
field.synopsis: Free format text message containing list handling and execution instructions.

field.name: AllocID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for allocation message.

field.name: AllocTransType
field.synopsis: Identifies allocation transaction type *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" ***

field.name: RefAllocID
field.synopsis: Reference identifier to be used with AllocTransType (71) = Replace or Cancel.

field.name: NoOrders
field.synopsis: Indicates number of orders to be combined for average pricing and allocation.

field.name: AvgPxPrecision
field.synopsis: Indicates number of decimal places to be used for average pricing. Absence of this field indicates that default precision arranged by the broker/institution is to be used.

field.name: TradeDate
field.synopsis: Indicates date of trading day. Absence of this field indicates current day (expressed in local time at place of trade).

field.name: PositionEffect
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together.

field.name: NoAllocs
field.synopsis: Number of repeating AllocAccount (79)/AllocPrice (366) entries.

field.name: AllocAccount
field.synopsis: Sub-account mnemonic

field.name: AllocQty
field.synopsis: Quantity to be allocated to specific sub-account

field.name: ProcessCode
field.synopsis: Processing code for sub-account. Absence of this field in AllocAccount (79) / AllocPrice (366) /AllocQty (80) / ProcessCode instance indicates regular trade.

field.name: NoRpts
field.synopsis: Total number of reports within series.

field.name: RptSeq
field.synopsis: Sequence number of message within report series. Used to carry reporting sequence number of the fill as represented on the Trade Report Side.

field.name: CxlQty
field.synopsis: Total quantity canceled for this order.

field.name: NoDlvyInst
field.synopsis: Number of delivery instruction fields in repeating group.

field.name: AllocStatus
field.synopsis: Identifies status of allocation.

field.name: AllocRejCode
field.synopsis: Identifies reason for rejection.

code.name: IncorrectOrMissingFundIDOrFundName
code.synopsis: Incorrect or missing fund ID or fund name

code.name: IncorrectOrMissingSettlCcyInstructions
code.synopsis: Incorrect or missing settlement currency instructions

field.name: Signature
field.synopsis: Electronic signature

field.name: SecureDataLen
field.synopsis: Length of encrypted message

field.name: SecureData
field.synopsis: Actual encrypted data stream

field.name: SignatureLength
field.synopsis: Number of bytes in signature field

field.name: EmailType
field.synopsis: Email message type.

field.name: RawDataLength
field.synopsis: Number of bytes in raw data field.

field.name: RawData
field.synopsis: Unformatted raw data, can include bitmaps, word processor documents, etc.

field.name: PossResend
field.synopsis: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

field.name: EncryptMethod
field.synopsis: Method of encryption.

code.name: PGPDESMD5
code.synopsis: PGP / DES-MD5 (See app note on FIX web site)

code.name: PEM
code.synopsis: PEM / DES-MD5 (see app note on FIX web site)

field.name: StopPx
field.synopsis: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

field.name: ExDestination
field.synopsis: Execution destination as defined by institution when order is entered.

field.name: CxlRejReason
field.synopsis: Code to identify reason for rejection of cancellation or modification.

code.name: OrderAlreadyInPendingStatus
code.synopsis: Order already in Pending Cancel or Pending Replace status

code.name: UnableToProcessOrderMassCancelRequest
code.synopsis: Unable to process Order Mass Cancel Request

code.name: OrigOrdModTime
code.synopsis: OrigOrdModTime (586) did not match last TransactTime (60) of order

field.name: OrdRejReason
field.synopsis: Code to identify reason for order rejection. Note: Values 3, 4, and 5 will be used when rejecting an order due to pre-allocation information errors.

code.name: DuplicateOfAVerballyCommunicatedOrder
code.synopsis: Duplicate of a verbally communicated order

code.name: ShortSellSecurityPreBorrowRestriction
code.synopsis: Short sell rejected due to security pre-borrow restriction

code.name: ShortSellAccountPreBorrowRestriction
code.synopsis: Short sell rejected due to account pre-borrow restriction

field.name: IOIQualifier
field.synopsis: Code to qualify IOI use. (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

code.name: AtTheClose
code.synopsis: At the close (around/not held to close)

code.name: AtTheMarket
code.synopsis: At the Market (previously called Current Quote)

field.name: Issuer
field.synopsis: Name of security issuer (e.g. International Business Machines, GNMA).

field.name: SecurityDesc
field.synopsis: Can be used by the venue or one of the trading parties to provide a non-normative textual description for the financial instrument.

field.name: HeartBtInt
field.synopsis: Heartbeat interval (seconds)

field.name: MinQty
field.synopsis: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed.

field.name: MaxFloor
field.synopsis: The quantity to be displayed . Required for reserve orders. On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

field.name: TestReqID
field.synopsis: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat

field.name: ReportToExch
field.synopsis: Identifies party of trade responsible for exchange reporting.

code.name: SenderReports
code.synopsis: Indicates the party sending message will report trade

code.name: ReceiverReports
code.synopsis: Indicates the party receiving message must report trade

field.name: LocateReqd
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the broker is to locate the stock in conjunction with a short sell order.

code.name: No
code.synopsis: Indicates the broker is not required to locate

code.name: Yes
code.synopsis: Indicates the broker is responsible for locating the stock

field.name: OnBehalfOfCompID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID field and the firm originating the message in this field.

field.name: OnBehalfOfSubID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

field.name: QuoteID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for quote

field.name: NetMoney
field.synopsis: Total amount due as the result of the transaction (e.g. for Buy order - principal + commission + fees) reported in currency of execution.

field.name: SettlCurrAmt
field.synopsis: Total amount due expressed in settlement currency (includes the effect of the forex transaction)

field.name: SettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Currency code of settlement denomination.

field.name: ForexReq
field.synopsis: Indicates request for forex accommodation trade to be executed along with security transaction.

code.name: DoNotExecuteForexAfterSecurityTrade
code.synopsis: Do Not Execute Forex After Security Trade

field.name: OrigSendingTime
field.synopsis: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT") when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

field.name: GapFillFlag
field.synopsis: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

code.name: SequenceReset
code.synopsis: Sequence Reset, Ignore Msg Seq Num (N/A For FIXML - Not Used)

code.name: GapFillMessage
code.synopsis: Gap Fill Message, Msg Seq Num Field Valid

field.name: NoExecs
field.synopsis: Number of executions or trades.

field.name: ExpireTime
field.synopsis: Time/Date of order expiration (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

field.name: DKReason
field.synopsis: Reason for execution rejection.

field.name: DeliverToCompID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID (56) field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

field.name: DeliverToSubID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

field.name: IOINaturalFlag
field.synopsis: Indicates that IOI is the result of an existing agency order or a facilitation position resulting from an agency order, not from principal trading or order solicitation activity.

field.name: QuoteReqID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for a QuoteRequest(35=R).

field.name: BidPx
field.synopsis: Bid price/rate

field.name: OfferPx
field.synopsis: Offer price/rate

field.name: BidSize
field.synopsis: Quantity of bid

field.name: OfferSize
field.synopsis: Quantity of offer

field.name: NoMiscFees
field.synopsis: Number of repeating groups of miscellaneous fees

field.name: MiscFeeAmt
field.synopsis: Miscellaneous fee value

field.name: MiscFeeCurr
field.synopsis: Currency of miscellaneous fee

field.name: MiscFeeType
field.synopsis: Indicates type of miscellaneous fee.

field.name: PrevClosePx
field.synopsis: Previous closing price of security.

field.name: ResetSeqNumFlag
field.synopsis: Indicates that both sides of the FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

field.name: SenderLocationID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

field.name: TargetLocationID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific message destination's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

field.name: OnBehalfOfLocationID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

field.name: DeliverToLocationID
field.synopsis: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

field.name: NoRelatedSym
field.synopsis: Specifies the number of repeating symbols specified.

field.name: Subject
field.synopsis: The subject of an Email message

field.name: Headline
field.synopsis: The headline of a News message

field.name: URLLink
field.synopsis: A URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) or URL (Uniform Resource Locator) link to additional information (i.e. http://www.XYZ.com/research.html)

field.name: ExecType
field.synopsis: Describes the specific ExecutionRpt (e.g. Pending Cancel) while OrdStatus(39) will always identify the current order status (e.g. Partially Filled).

code.name: PendingCancel
code.synopsis: Pending Cancel (e.g. result of Order Cancel Request)

code.name: Restated
code.synopsis: Restated (Execution Report sent unsolicited by sellside, with ExecRestatementReason (378) set)

code.name: PendingReplace
code.synopsis: Pending Replace (e.g. result of Order Cancel/Replace Request)

code.name: TradeHasBeenReleasedToClearing
code.synopsis: Trade has been released to Clearing

field.name: LeavesQty
field.synopsis: Quantity open for further execution. If the OrdStatus (39) is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty (38) - CumQty (14).

field.name: CashOrderQty
field.synopsis: Specifies the approximate order quantity desired in total monetary units vs. as tradeable units (e.g. number of shares). The broker or fund manager (for CIV orders) would be responsible for converting and calculating a tradeable unit (e.g. share) quantity (OrderQty (38)) based upon this amount to be used for the actual order and subsequent messages.

field.name: AllocAvgPx
field.synopsis: AvgPx (6) for a specific AllocAccount (79)

field.name: AllocNetMoney
field.synopsis: NetMoney(118) for a specific AllocAccount(79).

field.name: SettlCurrFxRate
field.synopsis: Foreign exchange rate used to compute SettlCurrAmt(119) from Currency(15) to SettlCurrency(120).

field.name: SettlCurrFxRateCalc
field.synopsis: Specifies whether or not SettlCurrFxRate (155) should be multiplied or divided.

field.name: NumDaysInterest
field.synopsis: Number of Days of Interest for convertible bonds and fixed income. Note value may be negative.

field.name: AccruedInterestRate
field.synopsis: The amount the buyer compensates the seller for the portion of the next coupon interest payment the seller has earned but will not receive from the issuer because the issuer will send the next coupon payment to the buyer. Accrued Interest Rate is the annualized Accrued Interest amount divided by the purchase price of the bond.

field.name: AccruedInterestAmt
field.synopsis: Amount of Accrued Interest for convertible bonds and fixed income

field.name: SettlInstMode
field.synopsis: Indicates mode used for Settlement Instructions message. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" ***

code.name: SpecificOrderForASingleAccount
code.synopsis: Specific Order for a single account (for CIV)

field.name: AllocText
field.synopsis: Free format text related to a specific AllocAccount (79).

field.name: SettlInstID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for Settlement Instruction.

field.name: SettlInstTransType
field.synopsis: Settlement Instructions message transaction type

field.name: EmailThreadID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for an email thread (new and chain of replies)

field.name: SettlInstSource
field.synopsis: Indicates source of Settlement Instructions

field.name: SecurityType
field.synopsis: Indicates type of security. Security type enumerations are grouped by Product(460) field value. NOTE: Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

code.name: USTreasuryNoteOld
code.synopsis: US Treasury Note (Deprecated Value Use TNOTE)

code.name: USTreasuryBillOld
code.synopsis: US Treasury Bill (Deprecated Value Use TBILL)

code.name: OffshoreIssuedChineseYuanCorporateBond
code.synopsis: Offshore issued Chinese Yuan (CNY) denominated corporate bond

code.name: OptionsOnPhysical
code.synopsis: Options on Physical - use not recommended

code.name: Index
code.synopsis: General type for a contract based on an established index

code.name: InterestStripFromAnyBondOrNote
code.synopsis: Interest Strip From Any Bond Or Note

code.name: PrincipalStripOfACallableBondOrNote
code.synopsis: Principal Strip Of A Callable Bond Or Note

code.name: PrincipalStripFromANonCallableBondOrNote
code.synopsis: Principal Strip From A Non-Callable Bond Or Note

code.name: OffshoreIssuedChineseYuanSovereignBond
code.synopsis: Offshore issued Chinese Yuan (CNY) denominated sovereign bond

code.name: Wildcard
code.synopsis: Wildcard entry for use on Security Definition Request

field.name: EffectiveTime
field.synopsis: Time the details within the message should take effect (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

field.name: StandInstDbType
field.synopsis: Identifies the Standing Instruction database used

code.name: AGlobalCustodian
code.synopsis: A Global Custodian (StandInstDBName (70) must be provided)

field.name: StandInstDbName
field.synopsis: Name of the Standing Instruction database represented with StandInstDbType (169) (i.e. the Global Custodian's name).

field.name: StandInstDbID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier used on the Standing Instructions database for the Standing Instructions to be referenced.

field.name: SettlDeliveryType
field.synopsis: Identifies type of settlement

code.name: Versus
code.synopsis: "Versus. Payment": Deliver (if Sell) or Receive (if Buy) vs. (Against) Payment

code.name: Free
code.synopsis: "Free": Deliver (if Sell) or Receive (if Buy) Free

field.name: BidSpotRate
field.synopsis: Bid F/X spot rate.

field.name: BidForwardPoints
field.synopsis: Bid F/X forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

field.name: OfferSpotRate
field.synopsis: Offer F/X spot rate.

field.name: OfferForwardPoints
field.synopsis: Offer F/X forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

field.name: OrderQty2
field.synopsis: OrderQty (38) of the future part of a F/X swap order.

field.name: SettlDate2
field.synopsis: SettDate (64) of the future part of a F/X swap order.

field.name: LastSpotRate
field.synopsis: F/X spot rate.

field.name: LastForwardPoints
field.synopsis: F/X forward points added to LastSpotRate(194). May be a negative value. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199.

field.name: AllocLinkID
field.synopsis: Can be used to link two different Allocation messages (each with unique AllocID (70)) together, i.e. for F/X "Netting" or "Swaps". Should be unique.

field.name: AllocLinkType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of Allocation linkage when AllocLinkID(196) is used.

field.name: SecondaryOrderID
field.synopsis: Assigned by the party which accepts the order. Can be used to provide the OrderID (37) used by an exchange or executing system.

field.name: NoIOIQualifiers
field.synopsis: Number of repeating groups of IOIQualifiers (04).

field.name: MaturityMonthYear
field.synopsis: Can be used with standardized derivatives vs. the MaturityDate (541) field. Month and Year of the maturity (used for standardized futures and options).

field.name: PutOrCall
field.synopsis: Indicates whether an option contract is a put, call, chooser or undetermined.

field.name: StrikePrice
field.synopsis: Strike Price for an Option.

field.name: CoveredOrUncovered
field.synopsis: Used for derivative products, such as options

field.name: OptAttribute
field.synopsis: Provided to support versioning of option contracts as a result of corporate actions or events. Use of this field is defined by counterparty agreement or market conventions.

field.name: SecurityExchange

code.synopsis: Non "Data" value includes field delimiter (<SOH> character)

field.name: BidRequestTransType
field.synopsis: Identifies the Bid Request message type.

field.name: ContraBroker
field.synopsis: Identifies contra broker. Standard NASD market-maker mnemonic is preferred.

field.name: ComplianceID
field.synopsis: ID used to represent this transaction for compliance purposes (e.g. OATS reporting).

field.name: SolicitedFlag
field.synopsis: Indicates whether or not the order was solicited.

field.name: ExecRestatementReason
field.synopsis: The reason for restatement when an ExecutionReport(35=8) or TradeCaptureReport(35=AE) message is sent with ExecType(150) = D (Restated) or used when communicating an unsolicited cancel.

code.name: PartialDeclineOfOrderQty
code.synopsis: Partial decline of OrderQty (e.g. exchange initiated partial cancel)

code.name: CxldSMPAggressivePassive
code.synopsis: Cancelled, self-match prevention aggressive and passive order

field.name: BusinessRejectRefID
field.synopsis: The value of the business-level "ID" field on the message being referenced.

field.name: BusinessRejectReason
field.synopsis: Code to identify reason for a Business Message Reject message.

code.name: DeliverToFirmNotAvailableAtThisTime
code.synopsis: DeliverTo firm not available at this time

code.name: ThrottleLimitExceededSessionDisconnected
code.synopsis: Throttle limit exceeded, session will be disconnected

field.name: GrossTradeAmt
field.synopsis: Total amount traded expressed in units of currency - usually quantity * price. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when quantity fields are expressed in terms of contract size (i.e. quantity * price * contract size).

field.name: NoContraBrokers
field.synopsis: The number of ContraBroker (375) entries.

field.name: MaxMessageSize
field.synopsis: Maximum number of bytes supported for a single message.

field.name: NoMsgTypes
field.synopsis: Number of MsgTypes (35) in repeating group.

field.name: MsgDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the direction of the message.

field.name: NoTradingSessions
field.synopsis: Number of TradingSessionIDs (336) in repeating group.

field.name: TotalVolumeTraded
field.synopsis: Total volume (quantity) traded.

field.name: DiscretionInst
field.synopsis: Code to identify the price a DiscretionOffsetValue (389) is related to and should be mathematically added to.

field.name: DiscretionOffsetValue
field.synopsis: Amount (signed) added to the "related to" price specified via DiscretionInst (388), in the context of DiscretionOffsetType (842)

field.name: BidID
field.synopsis: For bid lists, unique identifier for BidResponse(35=I) as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day.

field.name: ClientBidID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for a Bid Request as assigned by institution. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day.

field.name: ListName
field.synopsis: Descriptive name for list order.

field.name: TotNoRelatedSym
field.synopsis: Total number of securities.

field.name: BidType
field.synopsis: Code to identify the type of Bid Request.

field.name: NumTickets
field.synopsis: Total number of tickets.

field.name: SideValue1
field.synopsis: Amounts in currency

field.name: SideValue2
field.synopsis: Amounts in currency

field.name: NoBidDescriptors
field.synopsis: Number of BidDescriptor (400) entries.

field.name: BidDescriptorType
field.synopsis: Code to identify the type of BidDescriptor (400).

field.name: BidDescriptor
field.synopsis: BidDescriptor value. Usage depends upon BidDescriptorTyp (399).

field.name: SideValueInd
field.synopsis: Code to identify which "SideValue" the value refers to. SideValue1 and SideValue2 are used as opposed to Buy or Sell so that the basket can be quoted either way as Buy or Sell.

field.name: LiquidityPctLow
field.synopsis: Liquidity indicator or lower limit if TotalNumSecurities (393) > 1. Represented as a percentage.

field.name: LiquidityPctHigh
field.synopsis: Upper liquidity indicator if TotalNumSecurities (393) > 1. Represented as a percentage.

field.name: LiquidityValue
field.synopsis: Value between LiquidityPctLow (402) and LiquidityPctHigh (403) in Currency

field.name: EFPTrackingError
field.synopsis: Eg Used in EFP trades 2% (EFP - Exchange for Physical ). Represented as a percentage.

field.name: FairValue
field.synopsis: Used in EFP trades

field.name: OutsideIndexPct
field.synopsis: Used in EFP trades. Represented as a percentage.

field.name: ValueOfFutures
field.synopsis: Used in EFP trades

field.name: LiquidityIndType
field.synopsis: Code to identify the type of liquidity indicator.

field.name: WtAverageLiquidity
field.synopsis: Overall weighted average liquidity expressed as a % of average daily volume. Represented as a percentage.

field.name: ExchangeForPhysical
field.synopsis: Indicates whether or not to exchange for phsyical.

field.name: OutMainCntryUIndex
field.synopsis: Value of stocks in Currency

field.name: CrossPercent
field.synopsis: Percentage of program that crosses in Currency. Represented as a percentage.

field.name: ProgRptReqs
field.synopsis: Code to identify the desired frequency of progress reports.

code.name: BuySideRequests
code.synopsis: Buy-side explicitly requests status using Statue Request (default), the sell-side firm can, however, send a DONE status List STatus Response in an unsolicited fashion

code.name: SellSideSends
code.synopsis: Sell-side periodically sends status using List Status. Period optionally specified in ProgressPeriod.

field.name: ProgPeriodInterval
field.synopsis: Time in minutes between each ListStatus report sent by SellSide. Zero means don't send status.

field.name: IncTaxInd
field.synopsis: Code to represent whether value is net (inclusive of tax) or gross.

field.name: NumBidders
field.synopsis: Indicates the total number of bidders on the list

field.name: BidTradeType
field.synopsis: Code to represent the type of trade.

field.name: BasisPxType
field.synopsis: Code to represent the basis price type.

code.name: VWAPThroughADayExcept
code.synopsis: VWAP through a day except "YORI" (an opening auction)

code.name: VWAPThroughAMorningSessionExcept
code.synopsis: VWAP through a morning session except "YORI" (an opening auction)

code.name: VWAPThroughAnAfternoonSessionExcept
code.synopsis: VWAP through an afternoon session except "YORI" (an opening auction)

field.name: NoBidComponents
field.synopsis: Indicates the number of list entries.

field.name: Country
field.synopsis: ISO Country Code in field

field.name: TotNoStrikes
field.synopsis: Total number of strike price entries across all messages. Should be the sum of all NoStrikes (428) in each message that has repeating strike price entries related to the same ListID (66). Used to support fragmentation.

field.name: PriceType
field.synopsis: Code to represent the price type.

code.name: Percentage
code.synopsis: Percentage (i.e. percent of par) (often called "dollar price" for fixed income)

code.name: PerUnit
code.synopsis: Per unit (i.e. per share or contract)

code.name: FixedCabinetTradePrice
code.synopsis: Fixed cabinet trade price (primarily for listed futures and options)

code.name: VariableCabinetTradePrice
code.synopsis: Variable cabinet trade price (primarily for listed futures and options)

field.name: DayOrderQty
field.synopsis: For GT orders, the OrderQty (38) less all quantity (adjusted for stock splits) that traded on previous days. DayOrderQty (424) = OrderQty - (CumQty (14) - DayCumQty (425))

field.name: DayCumQty
field.synopsis: Quantity on a GT order that has traded today.

field.name: DayAvgPx
field.synopsis: The average price for quantity on a GT order that has traded today.

field.name: GTBookingInst
field.synopsis: Code to identify whether to book out executions on a part-filled GT order on the day of execution or to accumulate.

code.name: BookOutAllTradesOnDayOfExecution
code.synopsis: Book out all trades on day of execution

code.name: AccumulateUntilFilledOrExpired
code.synopsis: Accumulate executions until order is filled or expires

field.name: NoStrikes
field.synopsis: Number of list strike price entries.

field.name: ListStatusType
field.synopsis: Code to represent the status type.

field.name: NetGrossInd
field.synopsis: Code to represent whether value is net (inclusive of tax) or gross.

field.name: ListOrderStatus
field.synopsis: Code to represent the status of a list order.

field.name: ExpireDate
field.synopsis: Date of order expiration (last day the order can trade), always expressed in terms of the local market date. The time at which the order expires is determined by the local market's business practices

field.name: ListExecInstType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of ListExecInst (69).

code.name: WaitForInstruction
code.synopsis: Wait for Execut Instruction (i.e. a List Execut message or phone call before proceeding with execution of the list)

code.name: BuyDrivenCashTopUp
code.synopsis: Exchange/switch CIV order - Buy driven, cash top-up (i.e. additional cash will be provided to fulfill the order)

code.name: BuyDrivenCashWithdraw
code.synopsis: Exchange/switch CIV order - Buy driven, cash withdraw (i.e. additional cash will not be provided to fulfill the order)

field.name: CxlRejResponseTo
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of request that a Cancel Reject is in response to.

field.name: UnderlyingCouponRate
field.synopsis: Underlying security's CouponRate.

field.name: UnderlyingContractMultiplier
field.synopsis: Underlying security's ContractMultiplier.

field.name: ContraTradeQty
field.synopsis: Quantity traded with the ContraBroker (375).

field.name: ContraTradeTime
field.synopsis: Identifes the time of the trade with the ContraBroker (375). (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

field.name: LiquidityNumSecurities
field.synopsis: Number of Securites between LiquidityPctLow (402) and LiquidityPctHigh (403) in Currency.

field.name: MultiLegReportingType
field.synopsis: Used to indicate how the multi-legged security (e.g. option strategies, spreads, etc.) is being reported.

code.name: IndividualLegOfAMultiLegSecurity
code.synopsis: Individual leg of a multi-leg security

field.name: StrikeTime
field.synopsis: The time at which current market prices are used to determine the value of a basket.

field.name: ListStatusText
field.synopsis: Free format text string related to List Status.

field.name: EncodedListStatusTextLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedListStatusText (446) field.

field.name: EncodedListStatusText
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ListStatusText (444) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ListStatusText field.

field.name: PartyIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the PartyID (448) value. Required if PartyID is specified. Note: applicable values depend upon PartyRole (452) specified.

code.name: UKNationalInsuranceOrPensionNumber
code.synopsis: UK National Insurance or Pension Number

code.name: USEmployerOrTaxIDNumber
code.synopsis: US Employer or Tax ID Number

code.name: TaiwaneseForeignInvestorID
code.synopsis: Taiwanese Qualified Foreign Investor ID QFII/FID

code.name: ISITCAcronym
code.synopsis: Directed broker three character acronym as defined in ISITC "ETC Best Practice" guidelines document

code.name: BIC
code.synopsis: BIC (Bank Identification Code - SWIFT managed) code (ISO9362 - See "Appendix 6-B")

code.name: GeneralIdentifier
code.synopsis: Generally accepted market participant identifier (e.g. NASD mnemonic)

code.name: SettlementEntityLocation
code.synopsis: Settlement Entity Location (note if Local Market Settlement use "E=ISO Country Code") (see "Appendix 6-G" for valid values)

code.name: CSDParticipant
code.synopsis: CSD participant/member code (e.g. Euroclear, DTC, CREST or Kassenverein number

field.name: PartyID
field.synopsis: Party identifier/code. See PartyIDSource (447) and PartyRole (452).

field.name: NetChgPrevDay
field.synopsis: Net change from previous day's closing price vs. last traded price.

field.name: PartyRole
field.synopsis: Identifies the type or role of the PartyID (448) specified.

code.name: OrderOriginationTrader
code.synopsis: Order Origination Trader (associated with Order Origination Firm - i.e. trader who initiates/submits the order)

code.name: ExecutingTrader
code.synopsis: Executing Trader (associated with Executing Firm - actually executes)

code.name: GiveupClearingFirmDepr
code.synopsis: Giveup Clearing Firm (firm to which trade is given up)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityLiquidity
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity (CAL)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityTransactionVenue
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the Transaction (Execution) Venue (CATV)

code.name: PrimeBroker
code.synopsis: Prime Broker providing General Trade Services

field.name: NoPartyIDs
field.synopsis: Number of PartyID (448), PartyIDSource (447), and PartyRole (452) entries

field.name: NoSecurityAltID
field.synopsis: Number of SecurityAltID (455) entries.

field.name: SecurityAltID
field.synopsis: Alternate Security identifier value for this security of SecurityAltIDSource (456) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityAltIDSource.

field.name: SecurityAltIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the SecurityAltID(455) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: NoUnderlyingSecurityAltID
field.synopsis: Number of UnderlyingSecurityAltID (458) entries.

field.name: UnderlyingSecurityAltID
field.synopsis: Alternate Security identifier value for this underlying security of UnderlyingSecurityAltIDSource (459) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires UnderlyingSecurityAltIDSource.

field.name: UnderlyingSecurityAltIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the UnderlyingSecurityAltID(458) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: Product
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of product the security is associated with. See also the CFICode (461) and SecurityType (167) fields.

field.name: CFICode
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of security using ISO 10962 standard, Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI code) values. ISO 10962 is maintained by ANNA (Association of National Numbering Agencies) acting as Registration Authority. See "Appendix 6-B FIX Fields Based Upon Other Standards". See also the Product (460) and SecurityType (167) fields. It is recommended that CFICode be used instead of SecurityType (167) for non-Fixed Income instruments.

field.name: UnderlyingProduct
field.synopsis: Underlying security's Product.

field.name: UnderlyingCFICode
field.synopsis: Underlying security's CFICode.

field.name: TestMessageIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether or not this FIX Session is a "test" vs. "production" connection. Useful for preventing "accidents".

field.name: BookingRefID
field.synopsis: Common reference passed to a post-trade booking process (e.g. industry matching utility).

field.name: IndividualAllocID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for a specific NoAllocs (78) repeating group instance (e.g. for an AllocAccount).

field.name: RoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies which direction to round For CIV - indicates whether or not the quantity of shares/units is to be rounded and in which direction where CashOrdQty (152) or (for CIV only) OrderPercent (516) are specified on an order.

field.name: RoundingModulus
field.synopsis: For CIV - a float value indicating the value to which rounding is required.

field.name: CountryOfIssue
field.synopsis: ISO Country code of instrument issue (e.g. the country portion typically used in ISIN). Can be used in conjunction with non-ISIN SecurityID (48) (e.g. CUSIP for Municipal Bonds without ISIN) to provide uniqueness.

field.name: StateOrProvinceOfIssue
field.synopsis: A two-character state or province abbreviation.

field.name: LocaleOfIssue
field.synopsis: Identifies the locale or region of issue.

field.name: NoRegistDtls
field.synopsis: The number of registration details on a Registration Instructions message

field.name: MailingDtls
field.synopsis: Set of Correspondence address details, possibly including phone, fax, etc.

field.name: InvestorCountryOfResidence
field.synopsis: The ISO 3166 Country code (2 character) identifying which country the beneficial investor is resident for tax purposes.

field.name: PaymentRef
field.synopsis: "Settlement Payment Reference" - A free format Payment reference to assist with reconciliation, e.g. a Client and/or Order ID number.

field.name: DistribPaymentMethod
field.synopsis: Identifies the payment method for a (fractional) distribution. Used for CIV.

field.name: CashDistribCurr
field.synopsis: Specifies currency to be used for Cash Distributions see "Appendix 6-A Valid Currency Codes".

field.name: CommCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies currency to be used for Commission(12) if the commission currency is different from the deal currency.

field.name: CancellationRights
field.synopsis: For CIV - A one character code identifying whether Cancellation rights/Cooling off period applies.

field.name: MoneyLaunderingStatus
field.synopsis: A one character code identifying Money laundering status.

code.name: ExemptAuthorised
code.synopsis: Exempt - Authorised Credit or financial institution

field.name: MailingInst
field.synopsis: Free format text to specify mailing instruction requirements, e.g. "no third party mailings".

field.name: TransBkdTime
field.synopsis: For CIV A date and time stamp to indicate the time a CIV order was booked by the fund manager.

field.name: ExecPriceType
field.synopsis: For CIV - Identifies how the execution price LastPx (31) was calculated from the fund unit/share price(s) calculated at the fund valuation point.

field.name: ExecPriceAdjustment
field.synopsis: For CIV the amount or percentage by which the fund unit/share price was adjusted, as indicated by ExecPriceType (484)

field.name: DateOfBirth
field.synopsis: The date of birth applicable to the individual, e.g. required to open some types of tax-exempt account.

field.name: TradeReportTransType
field.synopsis: Identifies Trade Report message transaction type

code.name: CancelDueToBackOutOfTrade
code.synopsis: Cancel Due To Back Out of Trade

field.name: CardHolderName
field.synopsis: The name of the payment card holder as specified on the card being used for payment.

field.name: CardNumber
field.synopsis: The number of the payment card as specified on the card being used for payment.

field.name: CardExpDate
field.synopsis: The expiry date of the payment card as specified on the card being used for payment.

field.name: CardIssNum
field.synopsis: The issue number of the payment card as specified on the card being used for payment. This is only applicable to certain types of card.

field.name: PaymentMethod
field.synopsis: Identifies the settlement payment method.

field.name: RegistAcctType
field.synopsis: For CIV - a fund manager-defined code identifying which of the fund manager's account types is required.

field.name: Designation
field.synopsis: Free format text defining the designation to be associated with a holding on the register. Used to identify assets of a specific underlying investor using a common registration, e.g. a broker's nominee or street name.

field.name: TaxAdvantageType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of tax exempt account in which purchases shares/units are to be held. Used for CIV.

field.name: RegistRejReasonText
field.synopsis: Text indicating reason(s) why a Registration Instruction has been rejected.

field.name: FundRenewWaiv
field.synopsis: A one character code identifying whether the Fund based renewal commission is to be waived.

field.name: CashDistribAgentName
field.synopsis: Name of local agent bank if for cash distributions

field.name: CashDistribAgentCode
field.synopsis: BIC (Bank Identification Code--Swift managed) code of agent bank for cash distributions

field.name: CashDistribAgentAcctNumber
field.synopsis: Account number at agent bank for distributions.

field.name: CashDistribPayRef
field.synopsis: Free format Payment reference to assist with reconciliation of distributions.

field.name: CashDistribAgentAcctName
field.synopsis: Name of account at agent bank for distributions.

field.name: CardStartDate
field.synopsis: The start date of the card as specified on the card being used for payment.

field.name: PaymentDate
field.synopsis: The date written on a cheque or date payment should be submitted to the relevant clearing system.

field.name: PaymentRemitterID
field.synopsis: Identifies sender of a payment, e.g. the payment remitter or a customer reference number.

field.name: RegistStatus
field.synopsis: Registration status as returned by the broker or (for CIV) the fund manager:

code.name: Reminder
code.synopsis: Reminder - i.e. Registration Instructions are still outstanding

field.name: RegistRejReasonCode
field.synopsis: Reason(s) why Registration Instructions has been rejected.

code.name: InvalidAccountName
code.synopsis: Invalid/unacceptable Cash Distrib Agent Acct Name

code.name: InvalidAccountNum
code.synopsis: Invalid/unacceptable Cash Distrib Agent Acct Num

field.name: RegistRefID
field.synopsis: Reference identifier for the RegistID(513) with Cancel and Replace RegistTransType(514) transaction types.

field.name: RegistDtls
field.synopsis: Set of Registration name and address details, possibly including phone, fax etc.

field.name: NoDistribInsts
field.synopsis: The number of Distribution Instructions on a Registration Instructions message

field.name: RegistEmail
field.synopsis: Email address relating to Registration name and address details

field.name: DistribPercentage
field.synopsis: The amount of each distribution to go to this beneficiary, expressed as a percentage

field.name: RegistID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier of the registration details as assigned by institution or intermediary.

field.name: RegistTransType
field.synopsis: Identifies Registration Instructions transaction type

field.name: ExecValuationPoint
field.synopsis: For CIV - a date and time stamp to indicate the fund valuation point with respect to which a order was priced by the fund manager.

field.name: OrderPercent
field.synopsis: For CIV specifies the approximate order quantity desired. For a CIV Sale it specifies percentage of investor's total holding to be sold. For a CIV switch/exchange it specifies percentage of investor's cash realised from sales to be re-invested. The executing broker, intermediary or fund manager is responsible for converting and calculating OrderQty (38) in shares/units for subsequent messages.

field.name: OwnershipType
field.synopsis: The relationship between Registration parties.

field.name: NoContAmts
field.synopsis: The number of Contract Amount details on an Execution Report message

field.name: ContAmtType
field.synopsis: Type of ContAmtValue (520).

code.name: FundBasedRenewalCommissionPercent
code.synopsis: Fund-Based Renewal Commission Percent (a.k.a. Trail commission)

code.name: ProjectedFundValue
code.synopsis: Projected Fund Value (i.e. for investments intended to realise or exceed a specific future value)

code.name: FundBasedRenewalCommissionOnOrder
code.synopsis: Fund-Based Renewal Commission Amount (based on Order value)

code.name: FundBasedRenewalCommissionOnFund
code.synopsis: Fund-Based Renewal Commission Amount (based on Projected Fund value)

field.name: ContAmtValue
field.synopsis: Value of Contract Amount, e.g. a financial amount or percentage as indicated by ContAmtType (519).

field.name: ContAmtCurr
field.synopsis: Specifies currency for the Contract amount if different from the Deal Currency - see "Appendix 6-A; Valid Currency Codes".

field.name: OwnerType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of owner.

code.name: CustodianUnderGiftsToMinorsAct
code.synopsis: Custodian under Gifts to Minors Act

code.name: MemberFirmEmployee
code.synopsis: Member firm employee or associated person

field.name: PartySubID
field.synopsis: Sub-identifier (e.g. Clearing Account for PartyRole (452)=Clearing Firm, Locate ID # for PartyRole=Locate/Lending Firm, etc). Not required when using PartyID (448), PartyIDSource (447), and PartyRole.

field.name: NestedPartyID
field.synopsis: PartyID value within a nested repeating group.

field.name: NestedPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: PartyIDSource value within a nested repeating group.

code.name: UKNationalInsuranceOrPensionNumber
code.synopsis: UK National Insurance or Pension Number

code.name: USEmployerOrTaxIDNumber
code.synopsis: US Employer or Tax ID Number

code.name: TaiwaneseForeignInvestorID
code.synopsis: Taiwanese Qualified Foreign Investor ID QFII/FID

code.name: ISITCAcronym
code.synopsis: Directed broker three character acronym as defined in ISITC "ETC Best Practice" guidelines document

code.name: BIC
code.synopsis: BIC (Bank Identification Code - SWIFT managed) code (ISO9362 - See "Appendix 6-B")

code.name: GeneralIdentifier
code.synopsis: Generally accepted market participant identifier (e.g. NASD mnemonic)

code.name: SettlementEntityLocation
code.synopsis: Settlement Entity Location (note if Local Market Settlement use "E=ISO Country Code") (see "Appendix 6-G" for valid values)

code.name: CSDParticipant
code.synopsis: CSD participant/member code (e.g. Euroclear, DTC, CREST or Kassenverein number

field.name: SecondaryClOrdID
field.synopsis: Assigned by the party which originates the order. Can be used to provide the ClOrdID (11) used by an exchange or executing system.

field.name: SecondaryExecID
field.synopsis: Assigned by the party which accepts the order. Can be used to provide the ExecID (17) used by an exchange or executing system.

field.name: OrderCapacity
field.synopsis: Designates the capacity of the firm placing the order.

field.name: OrderRestrictions
field.synopsis: Restrictions associated with an order. If more than one restriction is applicable to an order, this field can contain multiple instructions separated by space.

code.name: ActingAsMarketMakerOrSpecialistInSecurity
code.synopsis: Acting as Market Maker or Specialist in the security

code.name: ActingAsMarketMakerOrSpecialistInUnderlying
code.synopsis: Acting as Market Maker or Specialist in the underlying security of a derivative security

code.name: ForeignEntity
code.synopsis: Foreign Entity (of foreign government or regulatory jurisdiction)

field.name: MassCancelRequestType
field.synopsis: Specifies scope of Order Mass Cancel Request.

code.name: CancelOrdersForAnUnderlyingSecurity
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for an underlying security

code.name: CancelOrdersForASecurityType
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a security type

code.name: CancelOrdersForATradingSession
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a trading session

code.name: CancelOrdersForAMarketSegment
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a market segment

code.name: CancelOrdersForASecurityGroup
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a security group

code.name: CancelForIssuerOfUnderlyingSecurity
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for an issuer of underlying security

field.name: MassCancelResponse
field.synopsis: Specifies the action taken by counterparty order handling system as a result of the Order Mass Cancel Request

code.name: CancelOrdersForAnUnderlyingSecurity
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for an underlying security

code.name: CancelOrdersForACFICode
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a CFI Code

code.name: CancelOrdersForASecurityType
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a security type

code.name: CancelOrdersForATradingSession
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a trading session

code.name: CancelOrdersForAMarketSegment
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a market segment

code.name: CancelOrdersForASecurityGroup
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for a security group

code.name: CancelOrdersForIssuerOfUnderlyingSecurity
code.synopsis: Cancel orders for an issuer of underlying security

field.name: MassCancelRejectReason
field.synopsis: Reason Order Mass Cancel Request was rejected

code.name: InvalidOrUnknownIssuerOfUnderlyingSecurity
code.synopsis: Invalid or unknown issuer of underlying security

field.name: TotalAffectedOrders
field.synopsis: Total number of orders affected by either the OrderMassActionRequest(MsgType=CA) or OrderMassCancelRequest(MsgType=Q).

field.name: NoAffectedOrders
field.synopsis: Number of affected orders in the repeating group of order ids.

field.name: AllocMethod

field.name: TradeID
field.synopsis: The unique ID assigned to the trade entity once it is received or matched by the exchange or central counterparty.

field.name: SideTradeReportID
field.synopsis: Used on a multi-sided trade to designate the ReportID

field.name: SideFillStationCd
field.synopsis: Used on a multi-sided trade to convey order routing information

field.name: SideReasonCd
field.synopsis: Used on a multi-sided trade to convey reason for execution

field.name: SideTrdSubType
field.synopsis: Used on a multi-sided trade to specify the type of trade for a given side. Same values as TrdSubType (829).

code.name: ExternalTransferOrTransferOfAccount
code.synopsis: External transfer or transfer of account

code.name: ImpliedSpreadLegExecutedAgainstAnOutright
code.synopsis: Implied spread leg executed against an outright

code.name: TrdSubmitVenueClrSettl
code.synopsis: Trade submitted to venue for clearing and settlement

code.name: AI
code.synopsis: AI (Automated input facility disabled in response to an exchange request.)

code.name: B
code.synopsis: B (Transaction between two member firms where neither member firm is registered as a market maker in the security in question and neither is a designated fund manager. Also used by broker dealers when dealing with another broker which is not a member firm. Non-order book securities only.)

code.name: LC
code.synopsis: LC (Correction submitted more than three days after publication of the original trade report.)

code.name: M
code.synopsis: M (Transaction, other than a transaction resulting from a stock swap or stock switch, between two market makers registered in that security including IDB or a public display system trades. Non-order book securities only.)

code.name: N
code.synopsis: N (Non-protected portfolio transaction or a fully disclosed portfolio transaction)

code.name: NM
code.synopsis: NM ( i) transaction where Exchange has granted permission for non-publication

code.name: NR
code.synopsis: NR (Non-risk transaction in a SEATS security other than an AIM security)

code.name: P
code.synopsis: P (Protected portfolio transaction or a worked principal agreement to effect a portfolio transaction which includes order book securities)

code.name: PC
code.synopsis: PC (Contra trade for transaction which took place on a previous day and which was automatically executed on the Exchange trading system)

code.name: PN
code.synopsis: PN (Worked principal notification for a portfolio transaction which includes order book securities)

code.name: R
code.synopsis: R ( (i) riskless principal transaction between non-members where the buying and selling transactions are executed at different prices or on different terms (requires a trade report with trade type indicator R for each transaction)

code.name: RO
code.synopsis: RO (Transaction which resulted from the exercise of a traditional option or a stock-settled covered warrant)

code.name: RT
code.synopsis: RT (Risk transaction in a SEATS security, (excluding AIM security) reported by a market maker registered in that security)

code.name: SW
code.synopsis: SW (Transactions resulting from stock swap or a stock switch (one report is required for each line of stock))

code.name: T
code.synopsis: T (If reporting a single protected transaction)

code.name: WN
code.synopsis: WN (Worked principal notification for a single order book security)

code.name: WT
code.synopsis: WT (Worked principal transaction (other than a portfolio transaction))

field.name: SideLastQty
field.synopsis: Used to indicate the quantity on one side of a multi-sided trade.

field.name: MessageEventSource
field.synopsis: Used to identify the event or source which gave rise to a message.

field.name: SideTrdRegTimestamp
field.synopsis: Same as TrdRegTimestamp(769). Used in a multi-sided message to indicate relevant trade-side timestamp.

field.name: SideTrdRegTimestampType
field.synopsis: Same as TrdRegTimeStampType(770). Used in a multi-sided message to indicate relevant trade-side timestamp type.

field.name: SideTrdRegTimestampSrc
field.synopsis: Same as TrdRegTimestampOrigin(771). Used in a multi-sided message to indicate relevant trade-side origin or source of timestamp.

field.name: AsOfIndicator
field.synopsis: A trade that is being submitted for a trade date prior to the current trade or clearing date, e.g. in an open outcry market an out trade being submitted for the previous trading session or trading day.

code.name: False
code.synopsis: false - trade is not an AsOf trade

code.name: True
code.synopsis: true - trade is an AsOf trade

field.name: NoSideTrdRegTS
field.synopsis: Number of timestamp entries.

field.name: LegOptionRatio
field.synopsis: Expresses the risk of an option leg

field.name: NoInstrumentParties
field.synopsis: Identifies the number of parties identified with an instrument

field.name: InstrumentPartyID
field.synopsis: PartyID value within an instrument party repeating group. Same values as PartyID (448)

field.name: TradeVolume
field.synopsis: Used to report volume with a trade

field.name: MDBookType
field.synopsis: Describes the type of book for which the feed is intended. Used when multiple feeds are provided over the same connection

field.name: MDFeedType
field.synopsis: Describes a class of service for a given data feed, ie Regular and Market Maker, Bandwidth Intensive or Bandwidth Conservative

field.name: MDPriceLevel
field.synopsis: Integer to convey the level of a bid or offer at a given price level. This is in contrast to MDEntryPositionNo(290) which is used to convey the position of an order within a price level.

field.name: MDOriginType
field.synopsis: Used to describe the origin of the market data entry.

field.name: FirstPx
field.synopsis: Indicates the first trade price of the day/session

field.name: MDEntrySpotRate
field.synopsis: The spot rate for an FX entry

field.name: MDEntryForwardPoints
field.synopsis: Used for an F/X entry. The forward points to be added to or subtracted from the spot rate to get the "all-in" rate in MDEntryPx. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: ManualOrderIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates if an order, quote or trade was initially received manually (as opposed to electronically) or if it was entered manually (as opposed to entered by automated trading software).

field.name: CustDirectedOrder
field.synopsis: Indicates if the customer directed this order to a specific execution venue "Y" or not "N".

field.name: ReceivedDeptID
field.synopsis: Identifies the broker-dealer department that first took the order.

field.name: CustOrderHandlingInst
field.synopsis: Codes that apply special information that the Broker / Dealer needs to report, as specified by the customer.

code.name: ClientProvidedPlatformControlledByFCM
code.synopsis: Client provided platform controlled by FCM

code.name: ClientProvidedPlatformDirectToExchange
code.synopsis: Client provided platform direct to exchange

code.name: PriceAtExecution
code.synopsis: Price at execution (price added at initial order entry, trading, middle office or time of give-up)

code.name: FixedPegToLocalBBO
code.synopsis: Fixed peg to local best bid or offer at time of order

code.name: GOrderAndFCMAPIorFIX
code.synopsis: G Order(FINRA OATS), FCM API or FIX(FIA Execution Source)

field.name: OrderHandlingInstSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of the order handling instruction values. Scope of this will apply to both CustOrderHandlingInst(1031) and DeskOrderHandlingInst(1035).

field.name: DeskType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of Trading Desk.

code.name: TradingDeskSystem
code.synopsis: Trading desk or system non-market maker

field.name: DeskTypeSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of DeskType(1033) values. Conditionally required when DeskType(1033) is specified.

field.name: DeskOrderHandlingInst
field.synopsis: Codes that apply special information that the broker-dealer needs to report.

code.name: ClientProvidedPlatformControlledByFCM
code.synopsis: Client provided platform controlled by FCM

code.name: ClientProvidedPlatformDirectToExchange
code.synopsis: Client provided platform direct to exchange

code.name: PriceAtExecution
code.synopsis: Price at execution (price added at initial order entry, trading, middle office or time of give-up)

code.name: FixedPegToLocalBBO
code.synopsis: Fixed peg to local best bid or offer at time of order

code.name: GOrderAndFCMAPIorFIX
code.synopsis: G Order(FINRA OATS), FCM API or FIX(FIA Execution Source)

field.name: ExecAckStatus
field.synopsis: The status of this execution acknowledgement message.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryAmount
field.synopsis: Indicates the underlying position amount to be delivered

field.name: UnderlyingCapValue
field.synopsis: Maximum notional value for a capped financial instrument

field.name: UnderlyingSettlMethod
field.synopsis: Settlement method for a contract or instrument. Additional values may be used with bilateral agreement.

field.name: SecondaryTradeID
field.synopsis: Used to carry an internal trade entity ID which may or may not be reported to the firm

field.name: FirmTradeID
field.synopsis: The ID assigned to a trade by the Firm to track a trade within the Firm system. This ID can be assigned either before or after submission to the exchange or central counterpary

field.name: SecondaryFirmTradeID
field.synopsis: Used to carry an internal firm assigned ID which may or may not be reported to the exchange or central counterpary

field.name: CollApplType
field.synopsis: conveys how the collateral should be/has been applied

field.name: UnderlyingAdjustedQuantity
field.synopsis: Unit amount of the underlying security (shares) adjusted for pending corporate action not yet allocated.

field.name: UnderlyingFXRate
field.synopsis: Foreign exchange rate used to compute UnderlyingCurrentValue(885) (or market value) from UnderlyingCurrency(318) to Currency(15).

field.name: UnderlyingFXRateCalc
field.synopsis: Specifies whether the UnderlyingFxRate(1045) should be multiplied or divided.

field.name: AllocPositionEffect
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together.

field.name: DealingCapacity
field.synopsis: Identifies role of dealer in the trade.

field.name: InstrmtAssignmentMethod
field.synopsis: Method under which assignment was conducted

field.name: InstrumentPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: PartyIDSource value within an instrument partyrepeating group.

code.name: UKNationalInsuranceOrPensionNumber
code.synopsis: UK National Insurance or Pension Number

code.name: USEmployerOrTaxIDNumber
code.synopsis: US Employer or Tax ID Number

code.name: TaiwaneseForeignInvestorID
code.synopsis: Taiwanese Qualified Foreign Investor ID QFII/FID

code.name: ISITCAcronym
code.synopsis: Directed broker three character acronym as defined in ISITC "ETC Best Practice" guidelines document

code.name: BIC
code.synopsis: BIC (Bank Identification Code - SWIFT managed) code (ISO9362 - See "Appendix 6-B")

code.name: GeneralIdentifier
code.synopsis: Generally accepted market participant identifier (e.g. NASD mnemonic)

code.name: SettlementEntityLocation
code.synopsis: Settlement Entity Location (note if Local Market Settlement use "E=ISO Country Code") (see "Appendix 6-G" for valid values)

code.name: CSDParticipant
code.synopsis: CSD participant/member code (e.g. Euroclear, DTC, CREST or Kassenverein number

field.name: InstrumentPartyRole
field.synopsis: PartyRole value within an instrument partyepeating group.

code.synopsis: Order Origination Trader (associated with Order Origination Firm - i.e. trader who initiates/submits the order)

code.name: ExecutingTrader
code.synopsis: Executing Trader (associated with Executing Firm - actually executes)

code.name: GiveupClearingFirmDepr
code.synopsis: Giveup Clearing Firm (firm to which trade is given up)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityLiquidity
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity (CAL)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityTransactionVenue
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the Transaction (Execution) Venue (CATV)

code.synopsis: Prime Broker providing General Trade Services

field.synopsis: Number of InstrumentPartySubID (1053) and InstrumentPartySubIDType (1054) entries

field.name: InstrumentPartySubID
field.synopsis: PartySubID value within an instrument party repeating group.

field.name: InstrumentPartySubIDType
field.synopsis: Type of InstrumentPartySubID (1053) value.

code.name: RegistrationNumber
code.synopsis: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)

code.name: ContractLinked
code.synopsis: Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: PositionCurrency
field.synopsis: The Currency in which the position Amount is denominated

field.name: CalculatedCcyLastQty
field.synopsis: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency trade. Can be derived from LastQty and LastPx.

field.name: AggressorIndicator
field.synopsis: Used to identify whether the order initiator is an aggressor or not in the trade.

field.name: NoUndlyInstrumentParties
field.synopsis: Identifies the number of parties identified with an underlying instrument

field.name: UnderlyingInstrumentPartyID
field.synopsis: PartyID value within an underlying instrument party repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingInstrumentPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: PartyIDSource value within an underlying instrument partyrepeating group.

code.synopsis: US Employer or Tax ID Number

field.synopsis: Number of Underlying InstrumentPartySubID (1053) and InstrumentPartySubIDType (1054) entries

field.synopsis: PartySubID value within an underlying instrument party repeating group.
