field.synopsis: Type of underlying InstrumentPartySubID (1053) value.

code.name: RegistrationNumber
code.synopsis: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)

code.name: ContractLinked
code.synopsis: Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: BidSwapPoints
field.synopsis: The bid FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far bid forward points - near offer forward point". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: OfferSwapPoints
field.synopsis: The offer FX Swap points for an FX Swap. It is the "far offer forward points - near bid forward points". Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: LegBidForwardPoints
field.synopsis: The bid FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: LegOfferForwardPoints
field.synopsis: The offer FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: SwapPoints
field.synopsis: For FX Swap, this is used to express the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: MDQuoteType
field.synopsis: Identifies market data quote type.

field.name: LastSwapPoints
field.synopsis: For FX Swap, this is used to express the last market event for the differential between the far leg's bid/offer and the near leg's bid/offer in a fill or partial fill. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: SideGrossTradeAmt
field.synopsis: The gross trade amount for this side of the trade. See also GrossTradeAmt (381) for additional definition.

field.name: LegLastForwardPoints
field.synopsis: The forward points for this leg's fill event. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199

field.name: LegCalculatedCcyLastQty
field.synopsis: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency for this leg. Can be derived from LegQty and LegLastPx.

field.name: LegGrossTradeAmt
field.synopsis: The gross trade amount of the leg. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when LegLastQty and other quantity fields are express in terms of contract size.

field.name: MaturityTime
field.synopsis: Time of security's maturity expressed in local time with offset to UTC specified

field.name: RefOrderID
field.synopsis: The ID reference to the order being hit or taken.

field.name: RefOrderIDSource
field.synopsis: Used to specify the source for the identifier in RefOrderID(1080). This can be an identifier provided in order depth market data when hitting (taking) a specific order or to identify what type of order or quote reference is being provided when seeking credit limit check. In the context of US CAT this can be used to identify related orders and quotes which are parent, previous, or manual orders or quotes. Previous relates to orders changing their unique system assigned order identifier.

field.name: SecondaryDisplayQty
field.synopsis: Used for reserve orders when DisplayQty applies to the primary execution market (e.g.an ECN) and another quantity is to be shown at other markets (e.g. the exchange). On orders specifies the qty to be displayed, on execution reports the currently displayed quantity.

field.name: DisplayWhen
field.synopsis: Instructs when to refresh DisplayQty (1138).

field.name: DisplayMethod
field.synopsis: Defines what value to use in DisplayQty (1138). If not specified the default DisplayMethod is "1"

field.name: DisplayLowQty
field.synopsis: Defines the lower quantity limit to a randomized refresh of DisplayQty.

field.name: DisplayHighQty
field.synopsis: Defines the upper quantity limit to a randomized refresh of DisplayQty.

field.name: DisplayMinIncr
field.synopsis: Defines the minimum increment to be used when calculating a random refresh of DisplayQty. A user specifies this when he wants a larger increment than the standard provided by the market (e.g. the round lot size).

field.name: RefreshQty
field.synopsis: Defines the quantity used to refresh DisplayQty.

field.name: MatchIncrement
field.synopsis: Allows orders to specify a minimum quantity that applies to every execution (one execution could be for multiple counter-orders). The order may still fill against smaller orders, but the cumulative quantity of the execution must be in multiples of the MatchIncrement.

field.name: MaxPriceLevels
field.synopsis: Allows an order to specify a maximum number of price levels to trade through. Only valid for aggressive orders and during continuous (autoexecution) trading sessions. Property lost when order is put on book. A partially filled order is assigned last trade price as limit price. Non-filled order behaves as ordinary Market or Limit.

field.name: PreTradeAnonymity
field.synopsis: Allows trader to explicitly request anonymity or disclosure in pre-trade market data feeds. Anonymity is relevant in markets where counterparties are regularly disclosed in order depth feeds. Disclosure is relevant when counterparties are not normally visible.

field.name: PriceProtectionScope
field.synopsis: Defines the type of price protection the customer requires on their order.

field.name: LotType
field.synopsis: Defines the lot type assigned to the order.

field.name: PegPriceType
field.synopsis: Defines the type of peg.

code.name: PrimaryPeg
code.synopsis: Primary peg (primary market - buy at bid or sell at offer)

field.name: PeggedRefPrice
field.synopsis: The value of the reference price that the order is pegged to. PeggedRefPrice + PegOffsetValue (211) = PeggedPrice (839) unless the limit price (44, Price) is breached. The values may not be exact due to rounding.

field.name: PegSecurityIDSource
field.synopsis: Defines the identity of the security off whose prices the order will peg. Same values as SecurityIDSource (22)

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: PegSecurityID
field.synopsis: Defines the identity of the security off whose prices the order will peg.

field.name: PegSymbol
field.synopsis: Defines the common, 'human understood' representation of the security off whose prices the order will Peg.

field.name: PegSecurityDesc
field.synopsis: Security description of the security off whose prices the order will Peg.

field.name: TriggerType
field.synopsis: Defines when the trigger will hit, i.e. the action specified by the trigger instructions will come into effect.

code.name: OnOrderEntryOrModification
code.synopsis: On Order Entry or order modification entry

field.name: TriggerAction
field.synopsis: Defines the type of action to take when the trigger hits.

field.name: TriggerPrice
field.synopsis: The price at which the trigger should hit.

field.name: TriggerSymbol
field.synopsis: Defines the common, 'human understood' representation of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

field.name: TriggerSecurityID
field.synopsis: Defines the identity of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

field.name: TriggerSecurityIDSource
field.synopsis: Defines the identity of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic. Same values as SecurityIDSource (22).

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: TriggerSecurityDesc
field.synopsis: Defines the security description of the security whose prices will be tracked by the trigger logic.

field.name: TriggerPriceType
field.synopsis: The type of price that the trigger is compared to.

field.name: TriggerPriceTypeScope
field.synopsis: Defines the type of price protection the customer requires on their order.

field.name: TriggerPriceDirection
field.synopsis: The side from which the trigger price is reached.

code.name: Up
code.synopsis: Trigger if the price of the specified type goes UP to or through the specified Trigger Price.

code.name: Down
code.synopsis: Trigger if the price of the specified type goes DOWN to or through the specified Trigger Price.

field.name: TriggerNewPrice
field.synopsis: The Price that the order should have after the trigger has hit. Could be applicable for any trigger type, but must be specified for Trigger Type 1.

field.name: TriggerOrderType
field.synopsis: The OrdType the order should have after the trigger has hit. Required to express orders that change from Limit to Market. Other values from OrdType (40) may be used if appropriate and bilaterally agreed upon.

field.name: TriggerNewQty
field.synopsis: The Quantity the order should have after the trigger has hit.

field.name: TriggerTradingSessionID
field.synopsis: Defines the trading session at which the order will be activated.

field.name: TriggerTradingSessionSubID
field.synopsis: Defines the subordinate trading session at which the order will be activated.

field.name: OrderCategory
field.synopsis: Defines the type of interest behind a trade (fill or partial fill).

field.name: NoRootPartyIDs
field.synopsis: Number of RootPartyID (1117), RootPartyIDSource (1118), and RootPartyRole (1119) entries

field.name: RootPartyID
field.synopsis: PartyID value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyID (448)

field.name: RootPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: PartyIDSource value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyIDSource (447)

field.synopsis: Type of RootPartySubID (1121) value. Same values as PartySubIDType (803)

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: TradeHandlingInstr
field.synopsis: Specified how the TradeCaptureReport(35=AE) should be handled by the respondent.

field.name: OrigTradeHandlingInstr
field.synopsis: Optionally used with TradeHandlingInstr = 0 to relay the trade handling instruction used when reporting the trade to the marketplace. Same values as TradeHandlingInstr (1123)

field.name: OrigTradeDate
field.synopsis: Used to preserve original trade date when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

field.name: OrigTradeID
field.synopsis: Used to preserve original trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

field.name: OrigSecondaryTradeID
field.synopsis: Used to preserve original secondary trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

field.name: ApplVerID
field.synopsis: Specifies the application layer version being applied at the message level.

field.name: CstmApplVerID
field.synopsis: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the message level. Enumerated field

field.name: RefApplVerID
field.synopsis: Specifies the service pack release being applied to a message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID

field.name: RefCstmApplVerID
field.synopsis: Specifies a custom extension to a message being applied at the session level.

field.name: TZTransactTime
field.synopsis: Transact time in the local date-time stamp with a TZ offset to UTC identified

field.name: ExDestinationIDSource
field.synopsis: The ID source of ExDestination

code.name: GeneralIdentifier
code.synopsis: Generally accepted market participant identifier (e.g. NASD mnemonic)

field.name: ReportedPxDiff

field.name: MaxPriceVariation
field.synopsis: The maximum price variation of an execution from one event to the next for a given security. Expressed in absolute price terms.

field.name: ImpliedMarketIndicator

Determination as to whether implied markets should be created is generally done at the level of the multi-leg instrument. Commonly used in listed derivatives.

code.name: ImpliedIn
code.synopsis: Implied-in - The existence of a multi-leg instrument is implied by the legs of that instrument

code.name: ImpliedOut

field.name: EventTime
field.synopsis: Specific time of event. To be used in combination with EventDate [866]

field.name: MinPriceIncrementAmount
field.synopsis: Minimum price increment amount associated with MinPriceIncrement(969). For listed derivatives, the value can be calculated by multiplying MinPriceIncrement(969) with ContractMultiplier(231).

field.name: UnitOfMeasureQty
field.synopsis: Used to indicate the quantity of the underlying commodity unit of measure on which the contract is based, such as, 2500 lbs of lean cattle, 1000 barrels of crude oil, 1000 bushels of corn, etc. UnitOfMeasureQty is required for UnitOfMeasure(996) Variable Quantity UOMs enumerations. Refer to the definition of UnitOfMeasure(996) for more information on the use of UnitOfMeasureQty.

field.name: LowLimitPrice

field.name: HighLimitPrice

field.synopsis: Reference price for the current trading price range usually representing the mid price between the HighLimitPrice and LowLimitPrice. The value may be the settlement price or closing price of the prior trading day.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument

In futures, this can be different for physically delivered products in which price is quoted in a unit size different from the contract, i.e. a Cattle Future contract has a UOMQty of 40,000 and a PriceUOMQty of 100.

field.name: StrikePriceBoundaryPrecision
field.synopsis: Used in combination with StrikePriceBoundaryMethod to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

field.name: UnderlyingPriceDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies how the underlying price is determined at the point of option exercise. The underlying price may be set to the current settlement price, set to a special reference, set to the optimal value of the underlying during the defined period ("Look-back") or set to the average value of the underlying during the defined period ("Asian option").

field.name: NoOrderEvents
field.synopsis: Number of order events.

field.name: OrderEventType
field.synopsis: The type of event affecting an order. The last event type within the OrderEventGrp component indicates the ExecType(150) value resulting from the series of events (ExecType(150) values are shown in brackets).

field.name: OrderEventExecID
field.synopsis: Refer to ExecID(17). Used when multiple different events are reported in single Execution Report. ExecID(17) and OrderEventExecID(1797) values should not overlap.

field.name: OrderEventReason
field.synopsis: Action that caused the event to occur.

field.name: OrderEventPx
field.synopsis: Price associated with the event.

field.name: OrderEventQty
field.synopsis: Quantity associated with the event.

field.name: OrderEventLiquidityIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrderEventType(1796) values of 4(Partially Filled) or 5(Filled).

code.name: RemovedLiquidityAfterFirmOrderCommitment
code.synopsis: Removed liquidity after firm order commitment

code.name: AuctionExecutionAfterFirmOrderCommitment
code.synopsis: Auction execution after firm order commitment

field.name: OrderEventText
field.synopsis: Additional information about the event.

field.name: AuctionType
field.synopsis: Type of auction order.

field.name: AuctionAllocationPct
field.synopsis: Percentage of matched quantity to be allocated to the submitter of the response to an auction order.

field.name: AuctionInstruction
field.synopsis: Instruction related to system generated auctions, e.g. flash order auctions.

field.name: RefClOrdID
field.synopsis: Used to reference an order via ClOrdID(11).

field.name: LockType
field.synopsis: Indicates whether an order is locked and for what reason.

field.name: LockedQty
field.synopsis: Locked order quantity.

field.name: SecondaryLockedQty
field.synopsis: Locked order quantity in addition to LockedQty (1808), e.g. to distinguish total locked quantity from currently locked quantity.

field.name: ReleaseInstruction
field.synopsis: Instruction to define conditions under which to release a locked order or parts of it.

field.name: ReleaseQty
field.synopsis: Quantity to be made available, i.e. released from a lock.

field.name: NoDisclosureInstructions
field.synopsis: Number of disclosure instructions.

field.name: DisclosureType
field.synopsis: Information subject to disclosure.

field.name: DisclosureInstruction
field.synopsis: Instruction to disclose information or to use default value of the receiver.

field.name: TradingCapacity
field.synopsis: Designates the capacity in which the order is submitted for trading by the market participant.

field.name: ClearingAccountType
field.synopsis: Designates the account type to be used for the order when submitted to clearing.

field.name: LegClearingAccountType
field.synopsis: Designates the capacity in which the order will be submitted to clearing.

field.name: TargetPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Qualifies the value of TargetPartyRole (1464).

field.name: RelatedHighPrice
field.synopsis: Upper boundary for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order.

field.name: RelatedLowPrice
field.synopsis: Lower boundary for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order.

field.name: RelatedPriceSource
field.synopsis: Source for the price of a related entity, e.g. price of the underlying instrument in an Underlying Price Contingency (UPC) order. Can be used together with RelatedHighPrice (1819) and/or RelatedLowPrice (1820).

field.name: MinQtyMethod
field.synopsis: Indicates how the minimum quantity should be applied when executing the order.

field.name: Triggered
field.synopsis: Indicates whether order has been triggered during its lifetime. Applies to cases where original information, e.g. OrdType(40), is modified when the order is triggered.

code.name: OCOOrderTriggered
code.synopsis: One Cancels the Other (OCO) order triggered

code.name: OTOOrderTriggered
code.synopsis: One Triggers the Other (OTO) order triggered

code.name: OUOOrderTriggered
code.synopsis: One Updates the Other (OUO) order triggered

field.name: AffectedOrigClOrdID
field.synopsis: OrigClOrdID(41) of an order affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

field.name: NotAffSecondaryOrderID
field.synopsis: SecondaryOrderID (198) of an order not affected by a mass cancel or mass action request.

field.name: EventTimePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the event.

field.name: EventTimeUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the event.

field.name: LastQtyVariance
field.synopsis: When LastQty is an estimated value, e.g. for a Repo "circled" trade, LastQtyVariance specifies the absolute amount that the size may vary up or down when finalized. Omitted when LastQty(32) is already final.

field.name: NoCrossLegs
field.synopsis: Number of legs in the side of a cross order.

field.name: SettlPriceIncrement
field.synopsis: Settlement price increment for stated price range.

field.name: SettlPriceSecondaryIncrement
field.synopsis: Secondary settlement price increment for stated price range. The meaning of secondary is left to bilateral agreement, e.g. it may refer to final settlement for a contract.

field.name: ClearedIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the trade or position being reported was cleared through a clearing organization.

field.name: ContractRefPosType
field.synopsis: Additional information related to the pricing of a commodity swaps position, specifically an indicator referring to the position type.

field.name: PositionCapacity
field.synopsis: Used to describe the ownership of the position.

field.name: PosQtyUnitOfMeasureCurrency
field.synopsis: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure if position quantity is expressed in valuation rather than contracts. Conditionally required when PosQtyUnitOfMeasure(1836)=Ccy.

field.name: PosQtyUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Indicates the unit of measure of the position quantity when not expressed in contracts.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: UnderlyingContractPriceRefMonth
field.synopsis: Reference month if there is no applicable UnderlyingMaturityMonth(313) value for the contract or security.

field.name: NoTradePriceConditions
field.synopsis: Number of trade price conditions.

field.name: TradePriceCondition
field.synopsis: Price conditions in effect at the time of the trade. Multiple price conditions can be in effect at the same time. Price conditions are usually required to be reported in markets that have regulations on price execution at a market or national best bid or offer, and the trade price differs from the best bid or offer.

code.name: PricePending
code.synopsis: Price or strike price is pending

field.name: TradeAllocStatus
field.synopsis: Identifies the status of an allocation when using a pre-clear workflow.

field.name: NoTradeQtys
field.synopsis: Number of trade quantities.

field.name: TradeQtyType
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of trade quantity in TradeQty(1843).

field.name: TradeQty
field.synopsis: Trade quantity.

field.name: NoTradeAllocAmts
field.synopsis: Number of trade allocation amount entries.

field.name: TradeAllocAmtType
field.synopsis: Type of the amount associated with a trade allocation.

code.name: LongPairedSwapNotionalValue
code.synopsis: Long paired swap or swaption notional value

code.name: ShortPairedSwapNotionalValue
code.synopsis: Short paired swap or swaption notional value

code.name: PresentValueOneBasisPoints
code.synopsis: Present value of one basis points

code.name: FiveYearEquivalentNotional
code.synopsis: The five year equivalent notional amount

field.name: TradeAllocAmt
field.synopsis: The amount associated with a trade allocation.

field.name: TradeAllocCurrency
field.synopsis: Currency denomination of the trade allocation amount.

field.name: TradeAllocGroupInstruction
field.synopsis: Instruction on how to add a trade to an allocation group when it is being given-up.

code.name: Add
code.synopsis: Add to an existing allocation group if one exists.

code.name: DoNotAdd
code.synopsis: Do not add the trade to an allocation group.

field.name: OffsetInstruction
field.synopsis: Indicates the trade is a result of an offset or onset.

field.name: TradeAllocAmtReason
field.synopsis: Specifies the reason for an amount type when reported on an allocation. Useful when multiple instances of the same amount type are reported.

field.name: StrategyLinkID
field.synopsis: Identifies the multileg strategy (e.g. spread) to which the trade belongs. This links together trade legs executed as part of a strategy during a single match event.

field.name: SideAvgPx
field.synopsis: Calculated average price for this side of the trade.

field.name: SideAvgPxIndicator
field.synopsis: Used to indicate whether a trade or a sub-allocation should be allocated at the trade price (e.g. no average pricing), or whether it should be grouped with other trades/sub-allocations and allocated at the average price of the group.

code.name: Trade
code.synopsis: Trade is part of an average price group identified by the AvgPxGroupID(1731)

code.name: LastTrade
code.synopsis: Last trade of the average price group identified by the AvgPxGroupID(1731)

code.name: NotionalValueAveragePxGroupTrade
code.synopsis: Trade is part of a notional value average price group

field.name: SideAvgPxGroupID
field.synopsis: The identifier for the average price group for the trade side. See also AvgPxGroupID(1731).

field.name: NoRelatedTrades
field.synopsis: Number of related trades.

field.name: RelatedTradeID
field.synopsis: Identifier of a related trade.

field.name: RelatedTradeIDSource
field.synopsis: Describes the source of the identifier that RelatedTradeID(1856) represents.

field.name: RelatedTradeDate
field.synopsis: Date of a related trade.

field.name: RelatedTradeMarketID
field.synopsis: Market of execution of related trade.

field.name: RelatedTradeQuantity
field.synopsis: Quantity of the related trade which can be less than or equal to the actual quantity of the related trade. For example, when one trade offsets another across asset classes.

field.name: NoRelatedPositions
field.synopsis: Number of related positions.

field.name: RelatedPositionID
field.synopsis: Identifier of a related position.

field.name: RelatedPositionIDSource
field.synopsis: Describes the source of the identifier that RelatedPositionID(1862) represents.

field.name: RelatedPositionDate
field.synopsis: Used to help identify the position when RelatedPositionID(1862) is not unique across multiple days. This date is generally the creation date of the identifier.

field.name: QuoteAckStatus
field.synopsis: Acknowledgement status of a Quote(35=S) or QuoteCancel(35=Z) message submission.

field.name: StrikeIndex
field.synopsis: Specifies the index used to calculate the strike price.

field.name: OfferID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for the ask side of the quote assigned by the quote issuer.

field.name: NoValueChecks
field.synopsis: Number of value check entries.

field.name: ValueCheckType
field.synopsis: Type of value to be checked.

field.name: ValueCheckAction
field.synopsis: Action to be taken for the ValueCheckType(1869).

field.name: LegSecurityXMLLen
field.synopsis: The length of the LegSecurityXML(1872) data block.

field.name: LegSecurityXML
field.synopsis: XML definition for the leg security.

field.name: LegSecurityXMLSchema
field.synopsis: The schema used to validate the contents of LegSecurityXML(1872).

field.name: UnderlyingSecurityXMLLen
field.synopsis: The length of the UnderlyingSecurityXML(1875) data block.

field.name: UnderlyingSecurityXML
field.synopsis: XML definition for the underlying security.

field.name: UnderlyingSecurityXMLSchema
field.synopsis: The schema used to validate the contents of UnderlyingSecurityXML(1875).

field.name: PartyDetailRequestResult
field.synopsis: Result party detail definition request.

field.name: PartyDetailRequestStatus
field.synopsis: Status of party details definition request.

field.name: PartyDetailDefinitionStatus
field.synopsis: Status of party detail definition for one party.

field.name: PartyDetailDefinitionResult
field.synopsis: Result of party detail definition for one party.

field.name: EntitlementRequestResult
field.synopsis: Result of risk limit definition request.

field.name: EntitlementRequestStatus
field.synopsis: Status of party entitlements definition request.

field.name: EntitlementStatus
field.synopsis: Status of entitlement definition for one party.

field.name: EntitlementResult
field.synopsis: Result of entitlement definition for one party.

field.name: EntitlementRefID
field.synopsis: Reference to an EntitlementID(1776). Used for modification or deletion of an entitlement.

field.name: SettlPriceUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Used to express the unit of measure of the settlement price if different from the contract.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: SettlPriceUnitOfMeasureCurrency
field.synopsis: Indicates the currency of the settlement price unit of measure if expressed in another currency than the base currency.

field.name: TradeMatchTimestamp
field.synopsis: Timestamp of the match event. For off-exchange trades the time at which the deal was matched by the exchange.

field.name: NoInstrmtMatchSides
field.synopsis: Number of instrument match sides.

field.name: NoTrdMatchSides
field.synopsis: Number of trade match sides.

field.name: TrdMatchSubID
field.synopsis: Used to identify each price level, step or clip within a match event.

field.name: NoLegExecs
field.synopsis: Number of instrument leg executions.

field.name: LegExecID
field.synopsis: The ExecID(17) value corresponding to a trade leg.

field.name: LegTradeID
field.synopsis: The TradeID(1003) value corresponding to a trade leg.

field.name: LegTradeReportID
field.synopsis: The TradeReportID(571) value corresponding to a trade leg.

field.name: TradeMatchAckStatus
field.synopsis: Used to indicate the status of the trade match report submission.

field.name: TradeMatchRejectReason
field.synopsis: Reason the trade match report submission was rejected.

field.name: SideMarketSegmentID
field.synopsis: Identifies the market segment of the side.

field.name: SideVenueType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of venue where the trade was executed for the side.

field.name: SideExecRefID
field.synopsis: Used to reference the value from SideExecID(1427).

field.name: LegExecRefID
field.synopsis: Used to reference the value from LegExecID(1893).

field.name: HaircutIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates, if "Y", that a stated valuation includes a haircut, e.g. that the stated value reflects the subtraction of the haircut. Note that a value of "N" does not imply a haircut is not applicable, only that the haircut (if any) is not reflected in the stated valuation.

field.name: RegulatoryTradeID
field.synopsis: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

field.name: RegulatoryTradeIDEvent
field.synopsis: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

field.name: RegulatoryTradeIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

field.name: RegulatoryTradeIDType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in RegulatoryTradeID(1903).

field.name: NoRegulatoryTradeIDs
field.synopsis: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

field.name: NoAllocRegulatoryTradeIDs
field.synopsis: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

field.name: AllocRegulatoryTradeID
field.synopsis: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

field.name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

field.name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDEvent
field.synopsis: Identifies the event which caused the origination of the identifier in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2(Clearing).

field.name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

field.name: NumOfCompetitors
field.synopsis: The number of competing Respondents (e.g. dealers) to receive a quote request (either via the QuoteRequest(35=R) or via other means).

field.name: ResponseTime
field.synopsis: The time by which a meaningful response should arrive back (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT").

field.name: QuoteDisplayTime
field.synopsis: Time by which the quote will be displayed.

field.name: ExposureDurationUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit in which the ExposureDuration(1629) is expressed.

field.name: CoverPrice
field.synopsis: The best quoted price received among those not traded.

field.name: NoClearingAccountTypes
field.synopsis: Number of clearing account type entries.

field.name: NoPriceMovements
field.synopsis: Number of price movement entries.

field.name: NoPriceMovementValues
field.synopsis: Number of price movement value entries.

field.name: PriceMovementValue
field.synopsis: Value at specific price movement point.

field.name: PriceMovementPoint
field.synopsis: Price movement point up (positive integer) or down (negative integer) relative to the underlying price of the instrument.

field.name: PriceMovementType
field.synopsis: Describes the format of the PriceMovementValue(1921).

field.name: ClearingIntention
field.synopsis: Specifies the party's or parties' intention to clear the trade.

field.name: TradeClearingInstruction
field.synopsis: Specifies the eligibility of this trade for clearing and central counterparty processing.

code.name: AutomaticPostingMode
code.synopsis: Automatic posting mode (trade posting to the position account number specified)

code.name: AutomaticGiveUpMode
code.synopsis: Automatic give-up mode (trade give-up to the give-up destination number specified)

field.name: BackloadedTradeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates that the trade being reported occurred in the past and is still in effect or active.

field.name: ConfirmationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies how a trade was confirmed.

field.name: MandatoryClearingIndicator
field.synopsis: An indication that the trade is flagged for mandatory clearing.

field.name: MixedSwapIndicator
field.synopsis: An indication that the trade is a mixed swap.

field.name: OffMarketPriceIndicator
field.synopsis: An indication that the price is off-market.

field.name: VerificationMethod
field.synopsis: Indication of how a trade was verified.

field.name: ClearingRequirementException
field.synopsis: Specifies whether a party to a swap is using an exception to a clearing requirement. In the US, one such clearing requirement is CFTC's rule pursuant to CEA Section 2(h)(1).

field.name: IRSDirection
field.synopsis: Used to specify whether the principal is paying or receiving the fixed rate in an interest rate swap.

field.name: RegulatoryReportType
field.synopsis: Type of regulatory report.

code.name: RTPETConfirmation
code.synopsis: Combination of RT, PET and confirmation

code.name: VolumeOmissionTradeEnrichment
code.synopsis: Volume Omission Trade Eligible for Subsequent Aggregated Enrichment

code.name: FullDetailsFourWeeksAggregationTrade
code.synopsis: Full Details of "Four Weeks Aggregation Trade"

code.name: FullDetailsVolumeOmissionTradeEnrichment
code.synopsis: Full Details in Aggregated Form of "Volume Omission Trade Eligible for Subsequent Aggregated Enrichment"

field.name: VoluntaryRegulatoryReport
field.synopsis: Used in conjunction with RegulatoryReportType(1934) to indicate whether the trade report is a voluntary regulatory report. If not specified, the default for a regulatory report is "N".

field.name: TradeCollateralization
field.synopsis: Specifies how the trade is collateralized.

field.name: TradeContinuation
field.synopsis: Specifies the post-execution trade continuation or lifecycle event. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: AssetClass
field.synopsis: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

field.name: AssetSubClass
field.synopsis: The subcategory description of the asset class.

field.name: AssetType
field.synopsis: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in AssetSubClass(1939). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: SwapClass
field.synopsis: The classification or type of swap. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: NthToDefault
field.synopsis: The Nth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. If specified without MthToDefault(1943) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If MthToDefault(1943) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

field.name: MthToDefault
field.synopsis: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When NthToDefault(1942) and MthToDefault(1943) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

field.name: SettledEntityMatrixSource
field.synopsis: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

field.name: SettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
field.synopsis: The publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. If not specified, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

field.name: CouponType
field.synopsis: Coupon type of the bond.

field.name: TotalIssuedAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued securities.

field.name: CouponFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: CouponFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: CouponDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security. Absence of this field for a bond or an interest bearing security transaction implies a "flat" trade, i.e. no accrued interest determined at time of the transaction.

field.name: ConvertibleBondEquityID
field.synopsis: Identifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted to.

field.name: ConvertibleBondEquityIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the ConvertibleBondEquityID(1951) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: ContractPriceRefMonth
field.synopsis: Reference month if there is no applicable MaturityMonthYear(200) value for the contract or security.

field.name: LienSeniority
field.synopsis: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

field.name: LoanFacility
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

field.name: ReferenceEntityType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.

field.name: IndexSeries
field.synopsis: The series identifier of a credit default swap index.

field.name: IndexAnnexVersion
field.synopsis: The version of a credit default swap index annex.

field.name: IndexAnnexDate
field.synopsis: The date of a credit default swap index series annex.

field.name: IndexAnnexSource
field.synopsis: The source of a credit default swap series annex.

field.name: AgreementVersion
field.synopsis: The version of the master agreement

field.name: MasterConfirmationDesc
field.synopsis: The type of master confirmation executed between the parties. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-type for values.

field.name: MasterConfirmationDate
field.synopsis: Alternative to broker confirmation. The date of the confirmation executed between the parties and intended to govern all relevant transactions between those parties.

field.name: MasterConfirmationAnnexDesc
field.synopsis: The type of master confirmation annex executed between the parties. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-annex-type for values.

field.name: MasterConfirmationAnnexDate
field.synopsis: The date that an annex to the master confirmation was executed between the parties.

field.name: BrokerConfirmationDesc
field.synopsis: Describes the type of broker confirmation executed between the parites. Can be used as an alterative to MasterConfirmationDesc(1962). See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/broker-confirmation-type for values.

field.name: CreditSupportAgreementDesc
field.synopsis: The type of ISDA Credit Support Agreement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-support-agreement-type for values.

field.name: CreditSupportAgreementDate
field.synopsis: The date of the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties and intended to govern collateral arrangements for all OTC derivatives transactions between those parties.

field.name: CreditSupportAgreementID
field.synopsis: A common reference or unique identifier to identify the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties.

field.name: GoverningLaw
field.synopsis: Identification of the law governing the transaction. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/governing-law for values.

field.name: NoSideRegulatoryTradeIDs
field.synopsis: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group.

field.name: SideRegulatoryTradeID
field.synopsis: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organziations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifier (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

field.name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entity identifier may be assigned by a regulator or from a supported standard identifier source scheme.

field.name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDEvent
field.synopsis: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972). When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value. For example, if the identifier is originated due to an allocated trade which was cleared and reported, use the enumeration value 2 (Clearing).

field.name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

field.name: NoSecondaryAssetClasses
field.synopsis: Number of secondary asset classes in the repeating group.

field.name: SecondaryAssetClass
field.synopsis: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure for a multi-asset trade.

field.name: SecondaryAssetSubClass
field.synopsis: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

field.name: SecondaryAssetType
field.synopsis: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in SecondaryAssetSubClass(1978). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: BlockTrdAllocIndicator
field.synopsis: Indication that a block trade will be allocated.

field.name: NoUnderlyingEvents
field.synopsis: Number of events in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingEventType
field.synopsis: Code to represent the type of event.

field.name: UnderlyingEventDate
field.synopsis: The date of the event.

field.name: UnderlyingEventTime
field.synopsis: The time of the event. To be used in combination with UnderlyingEventDate(1983).

field.name: UnderlyingEventTimeUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the event.

field.name: UnderlyingEventTimePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the event.

field.name: UnderlyingEventPx
field.synopsis: Predetermined price of issue at event, if applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingConstituentWeight
field.synopsis: For a basket, or pool, describes the weight of each of the constituents within the basket. If not provided, it is assumed to be equal weighted.

field.name: UnderlyingCouponType
field.synopsis: Specifies the coupon type of the underlying bond.

field.name: UnderlyingTotalIssuedAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the total amount of the issue. Corresponds to the par value multiplied by the number of issued security.

field.name: UnderlyingCouponFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: UnderlyingCouponFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: UnderlyingCouponDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

field.name: UnderlyingObligationID
field.synopsis: For a CDS basket or pool identifies the reference obligation.

field.name: UnderlyingObligationIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source scheme of the UnderlyingObligationID(1994).

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: UnderlyingEquityID
field.synopsis: Specifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted.

field.name: UnderlyingEquityIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of the UnderlyingEquityID(1996).

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: UnderlyingLienSeniority
field.synopsis: Indicates the seniority level of the lien in a loan.

field.name: UnderlyingLoanFacility
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of loan when the credit default swap's reference obligation is a loan.

field.name: UnderlyingReferenceEntityType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of reference entity for first-to-default CDS basket contracts.

field.name: StrikeIndexSpread
field.synopsis: Specifies the strike price offset from the named index.

field.name: ValuationSource
field.synopsis: Specifies the source of trade valuation data.

field.name: UnderlyingIndexSeries
field.synopsis: The series identifier of a credit default swap index.

field.name: UnderlyingIndexAnnexVersion
field.synopsis: The version identifier of a credit default swap index annex.

field.name: UnderlyingIndexAnnexDate
field.synopsis: The date of a credit default swap index series annex.

field.name: UnderlyingIndexAnnexSource
field.synopsis: The source of a credit default swap index series annex.

field.name: UnderlyingProductComplex
field.synopsis: Identifies an entire suite of products for a given market. In Futures this may be "interest rates", "agricultural", "equity indexes", etc

field.name: UnderlyingSecurityGroup
field.synopsis: An exchange specific name assigned to a group of related securities which may be concurrently affected by market events and actions.

field.name: UnderlyingSettleOnOpenFlag
field.synopsis: Indicator to determine if Instrument is Settle on Open.

field.name: UnderlyingAssignmentMethod
field.synopsis: Method under which assignment was conducted

field.name: UnderlyingSecurityStatus
field.synopsis: Indicates the current state of the underlying instrument.

field.name: UnderlyingObligationType
field.synopsis: Type of reference obligation for credit derivatives contracts.

field.name: UnderlyingAssetClass
field.synopsis: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure.

field.name: UnderlyingAssetSubClass
field.synopsis: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

field.name: UnderlyingAssetType
field.synopsis: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingAssetSubClass(2082). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: UnderlyingSwapClass
field.synopsis: The type or classification of swap. Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: UnderlyingNthToDefault
field.synopsis: The Nth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. If specified without UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

field.name: UnderlyingMthToDefault
field.synopsis: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When UnderlyingNthToDefault(2017) and UnderlyingMthToDefault(2018) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

field.name: UnderlyingSettledEntityMatrixSource
field.synopsis: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

field.name: UnderlyingSettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
field.synopsis: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. If not specified, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingStrikeMultiplier
field.synopsis: Used for derivatives. Multiplier applied to the strike price for the purpose of calculating the settlement value.

field.name: UnderlyingStrikeValue
field.synopsis: Used for derivatives. The number of shares/units for the financial instrument involved in the option trade.

field.name: UnderlyingStrikePriceDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies how the strike price is determined at the point of option exercise. The strike may be fixed throughout the life of the option, set at expiration to the value of the underlying, set to the average value of the underlying , or set to the optimal value of the underlying.

code.name: StrikeSetAtExpiration
code.synopsis: Strike set at expiration to underlying or other value (lookback floating)

code.name: StrikeSetToAverageAcrossLife
code.synopsis: Strike set to average of underlying settlement price across the life of the option

field.name: UnderlyingStrikePriceBoundaryMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the strike price relative to the underlying price at the point of option exercise.

code.name: LessThan
code.synopsis: Less than underlying price is in-the-money (ITM)

code.name: LessThanOrEqual
code.synopsis: Less than or equal to the underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)

code.name: Equal
code.synopsis: Equal to the underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)

code.name: GreaterThanOrEqual
code.synopsis: Greater than or equal to underlying price is in-the-money(ITM)

field.name: UnderlyingStrikePriceBoundaryPrecision
field.synopsis: Used in combination with StrikePriceBoundaryMethod(1479) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

field.name: UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement
field.synopsis: Minimum price increment for the instrument. Could also be used to represent tick value.

field.name: UnderlyingMinPriceIncrementAmount
field.synopsis: Minimum price increment amount associated with the UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement(2026). For listed derivatives, the value can be calculated by multiplying UnderlyingMinPriceIncrement(2026) by UnderlyingContractMultiplier(436).

field.name: UnderlyingOptPayoutType
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of valuation method or payout trigger for an in-the-money option.

field.name: UnderlyingOptPayoutAmount
field.synopsis: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an option. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

field.name: UnderlyingPriceQuoteMethod
field.synopsis: Method for price quotation.

code.name: Standard
code.synopsis: Standard, money per unit of a physical

field.name: UnderlyingValuationMethod
field.synopsis: Indicates type of valuation method used.

code.name: FuturesStyleWithAnAttachedCashAdjustment
code.synopsis: futures style with an attached cash adjustment

code.name: CDSStyleCollateralization
code.synopsis: CDS style collateralization of market to market and coupon

code.name: CDSInDeliveryUseRecoveryRateToCalculate
code.synopsis: CDS in delivery - use recovery rate to calculate obligation

field.name: UnderlyingListMethod
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the instruments are pre-listed only or can also be defined via user request.

field.name: UnderlyingCapPrice
field.synopsis: Used to express the ceiling price of a capped call.

field.name: UnderlyingFloorPrice
field.synopsis: Used to express the floor price of a capped put.

field.name: UnderlyingFlexibleIndicator
field.synopsis: Used to indicate if a security has been defined as flexible according to "non-standard" means. Analog to CFICode Standard/Non-standard indicator.

field.name: UnderlyingFlexProductEligibilityIndicator
field.synopsis: Used to indicate if a product or group of product supports the creation of flexible securities.

field.name: UnderlyingPositionLimit
field.synopsis: Position limit for the instrument.

field.name: UnderlyingNTPositionLimit
field.synopsis: Position Limit in the near-term contract for a given exchange-traded product.

field.name: UnderlyingPool
field.synopsis: Identifies the mortgage backed security (MBS) / asset backed security (ABS) pool.

field.name: UnderlyingContractSettlMonth
field.synopsis: Specifies when the contract (i.e. MBS/TBA) will settle. Must be present for MBS/TBA.

field.name: UnderlyingDatedDate
field.synopsis: If different from IssueDate()

field.name: UnderlyingInterestAccrualDate
field.synopsis: If different from IssueDate and DatedDate

field.name: UnderlyingShortSaleRestriction
field.synopsis: Indicates whether a restriction applies to short selling a security.

code.name: SecurityNotShortableAtOrBelowBestBid
code.synopsis: Security not shortable at or below the best bid

code.name: SecurityNotShortableWithoutPreBorrow
code.synopsis: Security is not shortable without pre-borrow

field.name: UnderlyingRefTickTableID
field.synopsis: Spread table code referred by the security or symbol.

field.name: NoUnderlyingComplexEvents
field.synopsis: Number of complex events in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of complex event.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexOptPayoutAmount
field.synopsis: Cash amount indicating the pay out associated with an event. For binary options this is a fixed amount.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventPrice
field.synopsis: Specifies the price at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the UnderlyingComplexEventType(2046).

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the boundary condition to be used for the event price relative to the UnderlyingComplexEventPrice(2048) at the point the complex event outcome takes effect as determined by the UnderlyingComplexEventPriceTimeType(2051).

code.name: LessThanOrEqualToComplexEventPrice
code.synopsis: Less than or equal to ComplexEventPrice(1486)

code.name: GreaterThanOrEqualToComplexEventPrice
code.synopsis: Greater than or equal to ComplexEventPrice(1486)

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryPrecision
field.synopsis: Used in combination with UnderlyingComplexEventPriceBoundaryMethod(2049) to specify the percentage of the strike price in relation to the underlying price. The percentage is generally 100 or greater for puts and 100 or less for calls.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventPriceTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies when the complex event outcome takes effect. The outcome of a complex event is a payout or barrier action as specified by the UnderlyingComplexEventType(2046).

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventCondition
field.synopsis: Specifies the condition between complex events when more than one event is specified.

field.name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventDates
field.synopsis: Number of underlying complex event dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventStartDate
field.synopsis: The start date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventEndDate
field.synopsis: The end date of the date range on which a complex event is effective. The start date will be set equal to the end date for single day events such as Bermuda options.

field.name: NoUnderlyingComplexEventTimes
field.synopsis: Number of complex event times in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventStartTime
field.synopsis: The start time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventEndTime
field.synopsis: The end time of the time range on which a complex event date is effective.

field.name: NoLegEvents

field.name: LegEventTimeUnit

field.name: LegAssetType
field.synopsis: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in LegAssetSubClass(2068). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: LegSwapClass

field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingEventText(2071) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingEventText(2071) field.

field.name: EncodedLegEventTextLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegEventText(2075) field.

field.name: EncodedLegEventText

field.name: LegSecondaryAssetType
field.synopsis: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in LegSecondaryAssetSubClass(2078). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: NoUnderlyingSecondaryAssetClasses
field.synopsis: Number of secondary asset classes in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingSecondaryAssetClass
field.synopsis: The broad asset category for assessing risk exposure for a multi-asset trade.

field.name: UnderlyingSecondaryAssetSubClass
field.synopsis: An indication of the general description of the asset class.

field.name: UnderlyingSecondaryAssetType
field.synopsis: Used to provide more specific description of the asset specified in UnderlyingSecondaryAssetSubClass(2082). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-type for code list of applicable values. ISO 4721 Currency Code values are to be used when specific currency as an asset type is to be expressed. Other values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

field.name: PreviousClearingBusinessDate
field.synopsis: The date of the previous clearing business day.

field.name: ValuationDate
field.synopsis: The valuation date of the trade.

field.name: ValuationTime

field.synopsis: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the MarginAmt(1645) from the MarginAmtCcy(1646) and the Currency(15).

field.name: MarginAmtFXRateCalc
field.synopsis: Specifies whether or not MarginAmtFXRate(2088) should be multipled or divided.

field.synopsis: Specifies whether or not CollateralFXRate(2090) should be multipled or divided.

field.name: CollateralAmountMarketSegmentID

field.name: CollateralAmountMarketID
field.synopsis: Market associated with the collateral amount.

field.synopsis: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the PayAmount(1710) or CollectAmount(1711) from the PayCollectCurrency(1709) and the Currency(15).

field.name: PayCollectFXRateCalc
field.synopsis: Specifies whether or not PayCollectFXRate(2094) should be multipled or divided.

field.name: PosAmtStreamDesc
field.synopsis: Corresponds to the value in StreamDesc(40051) in the StreamGrp component.

field.name: PositionFXRate
field.synopsis: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the PosAmt(708) from the PositionCurrency(1055) and the Currency (15).

field.name: PositionFXRateCalc
field.synopsis: Specifies whether or not PositionFXRate(2097) should be multipled or divided.

field.name: PosAmtMarketSegmentID
field.synopsis: Market segment associated with the position amount.

field.name: PosAmtMarketID
field.synopsis: Market associated with the position amount.

field.name: TerminatedIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates if the position has been terminated.

field.synopsis: Indicates whether the originating account is exempt (Y) from marking orders as short or not (N). This designation may be used on both buy and sell orders.

field.name: RelatedRegulatoryTradeIDSource
field.synopsis: Specifies the identifier of the reporting entity as assigned by regulatory agency.

field.name: NoAttachments
field.synopsis: The number of attached files.

field.name: AttachmentName
field.synopsis: Specifies the file name of the attachment.

field.name: AttachmentMediaType
field.synopsis: The MIME media type (and optional subtype) of the attachment. The values used are those assigned, listed and maintained by IANA (www.iana.org) [RFC2046]. See http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/index.html for available types.

field.name: AttachmentClassification
field.synopsis: Specifies semantically the type of the attached document from a business perspective. The default classification scheme reuses the FIX standard classification scheme of a high level section (pretrade, trade, posttrade, etc.) and a category, then a specific application or document type. The expression follows {"section/category/application type"}.

field.name: AttachmentExternalURL
field.synopsis: Used to specify an external URL where the attachment can be obtained.

field.name: AttachmentEncodingType
field.synopsis: The encoding type of the content provided in EncodedAttachment(2112).

field.name: UnencodedAttachmentLen
field.synopsis: Unencoded content length in bytes. Can be used to validate successful unencoding.

field.name: EncodedAttachmentLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded the EncodedAttachment(2112) field.

field.name: EncodedAttachment
field.synopsis: The content of the attachment in the encoding format specified in the AttachmentEncodingType(2109) field.

field.name: NoAttachmentKeywords
field.synopsis: The number of attachment keywords.

field.name: AttachmentKeyword
field.synopsis: Can be used to provide data or keyword tagging of the content of the attachment.

field.name: NegotiationMethod

code.name: PhoneSpot

field.name: NextAuctionTime
field.synopsis: The time of the next auction.

field.name: ComplexOptPayoutPaySide

field.name: ComplexOptPayoutReceiveSide
field.synopsis: Trade side of payout receiver.

field.name: ComplexOptPayoutUnderlier
field.synopsis: Reference to the underlier whose payments are being passed through.

field.name: ComplexOptPayoutPercentage
field.synopsis: Percentage of observed price for calculating the payout associated with the event.

field.name: ComplexOptPayoutTime
field.synopsis: Specifies when the payout is to occur.

field.name: ComplexOptPayoutCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of the payout amount.

field.name: ComplexEventPricePercentage
field.synopsis: Specifies the price percentage at which the complex event takes effect. Impact of the event price is determined by the ComplexEventType(1484).

field.name: ComplexEventCurrencyOne
field.synopsis: Specifies the first or only reference currency of the trade.

field.name: ComplexEventCurrencyTwo
field.synopsis: Specifies the second reference currency of the trade.

field.name: ComplexEventQuoteBasis
field.synopsis: For foreign exchange Quanto option feature.

field.name: ComplexEventFixedFXRate
field.synopsis: Specifies the fixed FX rate alternative for FX Quantro options.

field.name: ComplexEventDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: ComplexEventCalculationAgent
field.synopsis: Used to identify the calculation agent.

code.name: MasterAgreeent
code.synopsis: As specified in the master agreement

code.name: Supplement
code.synopsis: As specified in the standard terms supplement

field.name: ComplexEventStrikePrice
field.synopsis: Upper strike price for Asian option feature. Strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

field.name: ComplexEventStrikeFactor
field.synopsis: Strike factor for Asian option feature. Upper strike percentage for a Strike Spread.

field.name: ComplexEventStrikeNumberOfOptions
field.synopsis: Upper string number of options for a Strike Spread.

field.name: ComplexEventCreditEventsXIDRef
field.synopsis: Reference to credit event table elsewhere in the message.

field.name: ComplexEventCreditEventNotifyingParty
field.synopsis: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

field.name: ComplexEventCreditEventBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The local business center for which the credit event is to be determined. The inclusion of this business center implies that Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions is replaced by the local time of the specified business center. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ComplexEventCreditEventStandardSources
field.synopsis: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', indicates that ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable.

field.name: ComplexEventCreditEventMinimumSources
field.synopsis: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.

field.name: ComplexEventXID
field.synopsis: Identifier of this complex event for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

field.name: ComplexEventXIDRef
field.synopsis: Reference to a complex event elsewhere in the message.

field.name: ValuationReferenceModel
field.synopsis: Specifies the methodology and/or assumptions used to generate the trade value.

field.name: StrategyType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of trade strategy.

field.name: CommonPricingIndicator
field.synopsis: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that common pricing applies. Common pricing may be relevant for a transaction that references more than one commodity reference price.

field.name: SettlDisruptionProvision
field.synopsis: Specifies the consequences of bullion settlement disruption events.

field.name: InstrumentRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction if not overridden elsewhere.

field.name: InstrumentRoundingPrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: LegSettleOnOpenFlag
field.synopsis: Indicator to determine if the instrument is to settle on open.

field.name: LegInstrmtAssignmentMethod

field.name: LegSeniority

field.name: LegNotionalPercentageOutstanding

field.name: LegOriginalNotionalPercentageOutstanding
field.synopsis: Used to reflect the Original value prior to the application of a credit event. See LegNotionalPercentageOutstanding(2151).

field.name: LegAttachmentPoint

field.name: LegDetachmentPoint
field.synopsis: Upper bound percentage of the loss the tranche can endure.

field.name: LegObligationType

field.name: LegSwapSubClass
field.synopsis: The sub-classification or notional schedule type of the swap.

field.name: LegNthToDefault
field.synopsis: The Nth reference obligation in a CDS reference basket. If specified without LegMthToDefault(2158) the default will trigger a CDS payout. If LegMthToDefault(2158) is also present then payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

field.name: LegMthToDefault
field.synopsis: The Mth reference obligation to default in a CDS reference basket. When an NthToDefault(2157) to MthToDefault(2158) are represented then the CDS payout occurs between the Nth and Mth obligations to default.

field.name: LegSettledEntityMatrixSource
field.synopsis: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

field.name: LegSettledEntityMatrixPublicationDate
field.synopsis: The publication date of the applicable version of the matrix. When this element is omitted, the Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

field.name: LegCouponType

field.name: LegTotalIssuedAmount

field.name: LegCouponFrequencyPeriod

field.name: LegCouponFrequencyUnit

field.name: LegCouponDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

field.name: LegConvertibleBondEquityID
field.synopsis: Identifies the equity in which a convertible bond can be converted to.

field.name: LegConvertibleBondEquityIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the LegConvertibleBondEquitySecurityID(2166) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation

field.name: LegContractPriceRefMonth

field.name: LegLienSeniority

field.name: LegLoanFacility

field.name: LegOptionExpirationDesc

field.name: EncodedLegOptionExpirationDesc

field.name: LegStrikeMultiplier

field.name: LegStrikeValue

field.name: LegStrikeUnitOfMeasure

field.synopsis: Specifies how the strike price is determined at the point of option exercise. The strike may be fixed throughout the life of the option, set at expiration to the value of the underlying, set to the average value of the underlying , or set to the optimal value of the underlying.

code.name: StrikeSetAtExpiration

code.name: StrikeSetToAverageAcrossLife
