field.synopsis: Identifies an order or trade that should not be matched to an opposite order or trade if both buy and sell orders for the same asset contain the same SelfMatchPreventionID(2362) and submitted by the same firm.

field.name: UnderlyingTradingUnitPeriodMultiplier
field.synopsis: Indicates the number of contract periods associated with the minimum trading unit for a given contract duration resulting in the number of total traded contracts.

field.name: PosReportAction
field.synopsis: Indicates action that triggered the Position Report.

field.name: SettlForwardPoints
field.synopsis: FX forward points added to SettlPrice(730). The value is expressed in decimal form and may be a negative.

field.name: SettlPriceFxRateCalc
field.synopsis: Specifies whether LastPx(31) [TradeCaptureReport] or SettlPrice(730) [PositionReport] should be multiplied or divided.

field.name: TotalTradeQty
field.synopsis: Expresses the total quantity traded over the life of the contract when LastQty(32) is repeated periodically over the term of the contract. The value is the product of LastQty(32) and TradingUnitPeriodMultiplier(2353).

field.name: LastMultipliedQty
field.synopsis: Expresses the quantity bought or sold when LastQty(32) is expressed in number of contracts. Used in addition to LastQty(32). It is the product of LastQty(32) and ContractMultiplier(231).

field.name: TotalGrossTradeAmt
field.synopsis: Expresses the full total monetary value of the traded contract. The value is the product of LastPx(31) and TotalTradeQty(2367) or TotalTradeMultipliedQty(2370), if priced in units instead of contracts.

field.name: TotalTradeMultipliedQty
field.synopsis: Expresses the total trade quantity in units where ContractMultiplier(231) is not 1. The value is the product of TotalTradeQty(2367) and ContractMultiplier(231).

field.name: EncodedTradeContinuationText
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the TradeContinuationText(2374) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the TradeContinuationText(2374) field.

field.name: EncodedTradeContinuationTextLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedTradeContinuationText(2371) field.

field.name: IntraFirmTradeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the trade or position was entered into as an intra-group transaction, i.e. between two units of the same parent entity having majority ownership interest in both counterparties.

field.name: TradeContinuationText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional trade continuation information or data.

field.name: TaxonomyType
field.synopsis: The type of identification taxonomy used to identify the security.

code.name: ISINOrAltInstrmtID
code.synopsis: ISIN or Alternate instrument identifier plus CFI

field.name: PartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of PartyRole(452).

field.name: DerivativeInstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of DerivativeInstrumentPartyRole(1295).

field.name: InstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of InstrumentPartyRole(1051).

field.name: LegInstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of LegInstrumentPartyRole(2257).

field.name: LegProvisionPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of LegProvisionPartyRole(40536).

field.name: Nested2PartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of Nested2PartyRole(759).

field.name: Nested3PartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of Nested3PartyRole(951).

field.name: Nested4PartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of Nested4PartyRole(1417).

field.name: NestedPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of NestedPartyRole(538).

field.name: ProvisionPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of ProvisionPartyRole(40177).

field.name: RequestedPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of RequestedPartyRole(1509).

field.name: TradeContingency
field.synopsis: Indicates the contingency attribute for a trade in an asset class that may be contingent on the clearing of a corresponding paired trade (for example Exchange for Physical (EFP), Exchange for Swap (EFS), Exchange for Related (EFR) or Exchange for Option (EFO), collectively called EFRPs). Once the paired trade clears or fails to clear, the related trade (the trade which carries this attribute) ceases to exist.

code.name: DoesNotApply
code.synopsis: Does not apply (default if not specified)

field.name: RootPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of RootPartyRole(1119).

field.name: SettlPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of SettlPartyRole(784).

field.name: TradeConfirmationReferenceID
field.synopsis: A reference or control identifier or number used as a trade confirmation key.

field.name: UnderlyingInstrumentPartyRoleQualifier
field.synopsis: Used to further qualify the value of UnderlyingInstrumentPartyRole(1061).

field.name: AllocRefRiskLimitCheckID
field.synopsis: The reference identifier to the PartyRiskLimitCheckRequest(35=DF), or a similar out of band message, message that contained the approval or rejection for risk/credit limit check for this allocation.

field.name: AllocRefRiskLimitCheckIDType
field.synopsis: Specifies which type of identifier is specified in AllocRefRiskLimitCheckID(2392) field.

field.name: LimitUtilizationAmt
field.synopsis: The total amount of the limit that has been drawn down against the counterparty. This includes the amount for prior trades. It may or may not include the amount for the given trade, specified in LastLimitAmt(1632), depending upon whether the given trade is considered pending.

field.name: LimitAmt
field.synopsis: The limit for the counterparty. This represents the total limit amount, independent of any amount already utilized.

field.name: LimitRole
field.synopsis: Indicates the scope of the limit by role.

code.name: OrderOriginationTrader
code.synopsis: Order Origination Trader (associated with Order Origination Firm - i.e. trader who initiates/submits the order)

code.name: ExecutingTrader
code.synopsis: Executing Trader (associated with Executing Firm - actually executes)

code.name: GiveupClearingFirmDepr
code.synopsis: Giveup Clearing Firm (firm to which trade is given up)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityLiquidity
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity (CAL)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityTransactionVenue
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the Transaction (Execution) Venue (CATV)

code.name: PrimeBroker
code.synopsis: Prime Broker providing General Trade Services

field.name: RegulatoryTradeIDScope
field.synopsis: Specifies the scope to which the RegulatoryTradeID(1903) applies. Used when a trade must be assigned more than one identifier, e.g. one for the clearing member and another for the client on a cleared trade as with the principal model in Europe.

field.name: SideRegulatoryTradeIDScope
field.synopsis: Specifies the scope to which the SideRegulatoryTradeID(1972) applies. Used when a trade must be assigned more than one identifier, e.g. one for the clearing member and another for the client on a cleared trade as with the principal model in Europe.

field.name: AllocRegulatoryTradeIDScope
field.synopsis: Specifies the scope to which the AllocRegulatoryTradeID(1909) applies. Used when a trade must be assigned more than one identifier, e.g. one for the clearing member and another for the client on a cleared trade as with the principal model in Europe.

field.name: EffectiveBusinessDate
field.synopsis: Specifies an explicit business date for associated reference data or transaction. Used when an implicit date is not sufficiently specific.

field.name: ListManualOrderIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates if the list of orders was initially received manually (as opposed to electronically) or if it was entered manually (as opposed to entered by automated trading software).

field.name: EntitlementSubType
field.synopsis: Subtype of an entitlement specified in EntitlementType(1775).

field.name: QuoteModelType
field.synopsis: Quote model type

field.name: ComplianceText
field.synopsis: Free text for compliance information required for regulatory reporting.

field.name: ExecMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies how the transaction was executed, e.g. via an automated execution platform or other method.

field.name: AllocRegulatoryLegRefID
field.synopsis: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

field.name: ComplexEventSpotRate
field.synopsis: FX spot rate.

field.name: ComplexEventForwardPoints
field.synopsis: FX forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

field.name: LegComplexEventSpotRate
field.synopsis: FX spot rate.

field.name: LegComplexEventForwardPoints
field.synopsis: FX forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

field.name: RegulatoryLegRefID
field.synopsis: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

field.name: RateSourceReferencePageHeading
field.synopsis: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

field.name: RelatedToSecurityID
field.synopsis: The security identifier of the instrument, instrument leg or underlying instrument with which the related instrument has correlation.

field.name: RelatedToSecurityIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the RelatedToSecurityID(2413) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: RelatedToStreamXIDRef
field.synopsis: StreamXID(41303), LegStreamXID(41700) or UnderlyingStreamXID(42016) of the stream with which the related instrument has correlation.

field.name: SideRegulatoryLegRefID
field.synopsis: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

field.name: RelatedToDividendPeriodXIDRef
field.synopsis: The DividendPeriodXID(42293) of the stream dividend period with which the related instrument has correlation.

field.name: FirmTradeEventID
field.synopsis: An identifier created by the trading party for the life cycle event associated with this report.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventSpotRate
field.synopsis: FX spot rate.

field.name: UnderlyingComplexEventForwardPoints
field.synopsis: FX forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

field.name: FillRefID
field.synopsis: A reference to either the value of the FillExecID(1363) or an implicit position of a fills instance in the FillsGrp component.

field.name: OrderRequestID
field.synopsis: Unique message identifier for an order request as assigned by the submitter of the request.

field.name: MassOrderRequestID
field.synopsis: Unique message identifier for a mass order request as assigned by the submitter of the orders.

field.name: MassOrderReportID
field.synopsis: Unique message identifier for the response to a mass order request as assigned by the receiver of the orders.

field.name: MassOrderRequestStatus
field.synopsis: Status of mass order request.

field.name: MassOrderRequestResult
field.synopsis: Request result of mass order request.

field.name: OrderResponseLevel
field.synopsis: The level of response requested from receiver of mass order messages. A default value should be bilaterally agreed.

field.name: NoOrderEntries
field.synopsis: Number of order entries.

field.name: OrderEntryAction
field.synopsis: Specifies the action to be taken for the given order.

field.name: OrderEntryID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for an order within a single MassOrder(35=DJ) message that can be used as a reference in the MassOrderAck(35=DK) message.

field.name: ExecTypeReason
field.synopsis: The initiating event when an ExecutionReport(35=8) is sent.

code.name: OrdReplacedWithNonRestingOrdOnRequest
code.synopsis: Order replaced with non-resting order upon request

field.name: TotNoOrderEntries
field.synopsis: Totals number of orders for a mass order or its acknowledgment being fragmented across multiple messages.

field.name: NoTargetPartySubIDs
field.synopsis: Number of target party sub IDs in the repeating group.

field.name: TargetPartySubID
field.synopsis: Party sub-identifier value within a target party repeating group.

field.name: TargetPartySubIDType
field.synopsis: Type of TargetPartySubID(2434) value.

code.name: RegistrationNumber
code.synopsis: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)

code.name: ContractLinked
code.synopsis: Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: TransferInstructionID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for the transfer instruction assigned by the submitter.

field.name: TransferID
field.synopsis: The unique identifier assigned to the transfer entity once it is received, for example, by the CCP or the party governing the transfer process. Generally this same identifier for the transfer is used by all parties involved.

field.name: TransferReportID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for the transfer report message.

field.name: TransferTransType
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of transfer transaction.

field.name: TransferType
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of transfer request.

field.name: TransferScope
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of transfer.

field.name: TransferStatus
field.synopsis: Status of the transfer.

field.name: TransferRejectReason
field.synopsis: Reason the transfer instruction was rejected.

field.name: TransferReportType
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of transfer report.

field.name: AggressorTime
field.synopsis: Timestamp of aggressive order or quote resulting in match event.

field.name: AggressorSide
field.synopsis: Side of aggressive order or quote resulting in match event.

code.name: Cross
code.synopsis: Cross (orders where counterparty is an exchange, valid for all messages except IOIs)

field.name: FastMarketIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates if the instrument is in "fast market" state.

field.name: LinkageHandlingIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicate whether linkage handling is in effect for an instrument or not.

field.name: NumberOfBuyOrders
field.synopsis: Number of buy orders involved in a trade.

field.name: NumberOfSellOrders
field.synopsis: Number of sell orders involved in a trade.

field.name: SettlPriceDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Calculation method used to determine settlement price.

field.name: MDStatisticReqID
field.synopsis: Message identifier for a statistics request.

field.name: MDStatisticRptID
field.synopsis: Message identifier for a statistics report.

field.name: MDStatisticName
field.synopsis: The short name or acronym for a set of statistic parameters.

field.name: MDStatisticDesc
field.synopsis: Can be used to provide an optional textual description for a statistic.

field.name: MDStatisticType
field.synopsis: Type of statistic value.

field.name: MDStatisticScope
field.synopsis: Entities used as basis for the statistics.

field.name: MDStatisticSubScope
field.synopsis: Sub-scope of the statistics to further reduce the entities used as basis for the statistics.

code.name: NeitherHiddenNorLargeInScale
code.synopsis: Neither hidden nor large in scale

field.name: MDStatisticScopeType
field.synopsis: Scope details of the statistics to reduce the number of events being used as basis for the statistics.

field.name: MDStatisticFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Dissemination frequency of statistics.

field.name: MDStatisticFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit for MDStatisticFrequencyPeriod(2460).

field.name: MDStatisticDelayPeriod
field.synopsis: Number of time units between the calculation of the statistic and its dissemination. Can be used to defer or delay publication.

field.name: MDStatisticDelayUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit for MDStatisticDelayPeriod(2462).

field.name: MDStatisticIntervalType
field.synopsis: Type of interval over which statistic is calculated.

code.name: MaximumRangeUpToPreviousTimeUnit
code.synopsis: Maximum range up to previous time unit

field.name: MDStatisticIntervalTypeUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit for MDStatisticIntervalType(2464).

field.name: MDStatisticIntervalPeriod
field.synopsis: Length of time over which the statistic is calculated. Special meaning for a value of zero to express that there is no aggregation over time. Can be used with other interval types expressing relative date and time ranges to combine them with sliding window peaks, e.g. highest volume across 1 minute intervals of the previous day.

field.name: MDStatisticIntervalUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit for MDStatisticIntervalPeriod(2466).

field.name: MDStatisticStartDate
field.synopsis: First day of range for which statistical data is collected.

field.name: MDStatisticEndDate
field.synopsis: Last day of range for which statistical data is collected.

field.name: MDStatisticStartTime
field.synopsis: Start time of the time range for which statistical data is collected.

field.name: MDStatisticEndTime
field.synopsis: End time of the time range for which statistical data is collected.

field.name: MDStatisticRatioType
field.synopsis: Ratios between various entities.

code.name: TradeVolumeToTotalTradedVolume
code.synopsis: Trade volume to total traded volume

code.name: OrdersToTotalNumberOrders
code.synopsis: Orders to total number of orders

field.name: MDStatisticRequestResult
field.synopsis: Result returned in response to MarketDataStatisticsRequest (35=DO).

code.name: TradeDateOutOfSupportedRange
code.synopsis: Trade date out of supported range

code.name: InvalidOrUnknownTradeInputSource
code.synopsis: Invalid or unknown trade input source

field.name: NoMDStatistics
field.synopsis: Number of market data statistics.

field.name: MDStatisticID
field.synopsis: Unique identifier for a statistic.

field.name: MDStatisticTime
field.synopsis: Time of calculation of a statistic.

field.name: MDStatisticStatus
field.synopsis: Status for a statistic to indicate its availability.

field.name: MDStatisticValue
field.synopsis: Statistical value.

field.name: MDStatisticValueType
field.synopsis: Type of statistical value.

field.name: MDStatisticValueUnit
field.synopsis: Unit of time for statistical value.

field.name: EncodedMDStatisticDescLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMDStatisticDesc(2482) field.

field.name: EncodedMDStatisticDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MDStatisticDesc(2455) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MDStatisticDesc(2455) field.

field.name: AllocRiskLimitCheckStatus
field.synopsis: Indicates the status of the risk limit check performed on a trade for this allocation instance.

field.name: FirmTransactionID
field.synopsis: The unique transaction entity identifier assigned by the firm.

field.name: TransactionID
field.synopsis: The unique transaction entity identifier.

field.name: WireReference
field.synopsis: The reference to a wire transfer associated with the transaction. Wire references done via wire services such as Fedwire Output Message Accountabilitty Data "OMAD" or SWIFT Output Sequence Number "OSN".

field.name: CollRptRejectReason
field.synopsis: Reject reason code for rejecting the collateral report.

code.name: UnacceptableCollateral
code.synopsis: Unacceptable or invalid type of collateral

field.name: CollRptStatus
field.synopsis: The status of the collateral report.

field.name: PackageID
field.synopsis: Identifier assigned to a collection of trades so that they can be analyzed as one atomic unit for risk assessment and clearing.

field.name: TradeNumber
field.synopsis: Ordinal number of the trade within a series of related trades.

field.name: UnderlyingAssetGroup
field.synopsis: Indicates the broad product or asset classification. May be used to provide grouping for the product taxonomy (Product(460), SecurityType(167), etc.) and/or the risk taxonomy (AssetClass(1938), AssetSubClass(1939), AssetType(1940), etc.).

field.name: LegDifferentialPrice
field.synopsis: Used in pricing a group of individual Trade at Settlement (TAS) and Trade At Marker (TAM) contracts as an atomic unit. The value is the negotiated currency offset either at settlement (TAS) or at the time specified in the product definition (TAM). The final contract price is reported in LegLastPx(637).

field.name: EncodedLegDocumentationText
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegDocumentationText(2505) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegDocumentationText(2505) field.

field.name: EncodedLegDocumentationTextLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegDocumentationText(2493) field.

field.name: LegAgreementCurrency
field.synopsis: Contractual currency forming the basis of a financing agreement and associated transactions. Usually, but not always, the same as the trade currency.

field.name: LegAgreementDate
field.synopsis: A reference to the date the underlying agreement specified by LegAgreementID(2498) and LegAgreementDesc(2497) was executed.

field.name: LegAgreementDesc
field.synopsis: The full name of the base standard agreement, annexes and amendments in place between the principals applicable to a financing transaction. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-agreement-type for derivative values.

field.name: LegAgreementID
field.synopsis: A common reference to the applicable standing agreement between the counterparties to a financing transaction.

field.name: LegAgreementVersion
field.synopsis: The version of the master agreement.

field.name: LegBrokerConfirmationDesc
field.synopsis: Describes the type of broker confirmation executed between the parties. Can be used as an alternative to MasterConfirmationDesc(1962). See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/broker-confirmation-type for values.

field.name: LegCreditSupportAgreementDate
field.synopsis: The date of the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties and intended to govern collateral arrangements for all OTC derivatives transactions between those parties.

field.name: LegCreditSupportAgreementDesc
field.synopsis: The type of ISDA Credit Support Agreement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-support-agreement-type for values.

field.name: LegCreditSupportAgreementID
field.synopsis: A common reference or unique identifier to identify the ISDA Credit Support Agreement executed between the parties.

field.name: LegDeliveryType
field.synopsis: Identifies type of settlement.

code.name: VersusPayment
code.synopsis: "Versus Payment": Deliver (if sell) or Receive (if buy) vs. (against) Payment

code.name: Free
code.synopsis: "Free": Deliver (if sell) or Receive (if buy) Free

field.name: LegDocumentationText
field.synopsis: A sentence or phrase pertinent to the trade, not a reference to an external document. E.g. "To be registered with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Acid Rain Division, SO2 Allowance Tracking System".

field.name: LegEndDate
field.synopsis: End date of a financing deal, i.e. the date the seller reimburses the buyer and takes back control of the collateral.

field.name: LegGoverningLaw
field.synopsis: Identification of the law governing the transaction. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/governing-law for values.

field.name: LegMarginRatio
field.synopsis: The fraction of the cash consideration that must be collateralized, expressed as a percent. A MarginRatio of 2% indicates that the value of the collateral (after deducting for "haircut") must exceed the cash consideration by 2%.

field.name: LegMasterConfirmationAnnexDate
field.synopsis: The date that an annexation to the master confirmation was executed between the parties.

field.name: LegMasterConfirmationDate
field.synopsis: Alternative to broker confirmation. The date of the confirmation executed between the parties and intended to govern all relevant transactions between those parties.

field.name: LegMasterConfirmationDesc
field.synopsis: The type of master confirmation executed between the parties. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-type for values.

field.name: LegMasterConfirmationAnnexDesc
field.synopsis: The type of master confirmation annexation executed between the parties. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/master-confirmation-annex-type for values.

field.name: LegStartDate
field.synopsis: Start date of a financing deal, i.e. the date the buyer pays the seller cash and takes control of the collateral.

field.name: LegTerminationType
field.synopsis: Type of financing termination.

field.name: AllocCalculatedCcyQty
field.synopsis: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency trade applicable to the allocation instance.

field.name: CollateralRequestInstruction
field.synopsis: An encoded collateral request processing instruction to the receiver.

field.name: CollateralRequestLinkID
field.synopsis: A unique identifier to link together a set or group of requests.

field.name: CollateralRequestNumber
field.synopsis: Ordinal number of the request within a set or group of requests.

field.name: TotNumCollateralRequests
field.synopsis: Total number of request messages within a set or group of requests.

field.name: WarningText
field.synopsis: Communicates the underlying condition when the request response indicates "warning".

field.name: EncodedWarningText
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the WarningText(2520) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the WarningText(2520) field.

field.name: EncodedWarningTextLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedWarningtText(2521) field.

field.name: CrossedIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the order or quote was crossed with another order or quote having the same context, e.g. having accounts with a common ownership.

field.name: TradeReportingIndicator
field.synopsis: Used between parties to convey trade reporting status.

code.name: OnBook
code.synopsis: Trade has been or will be reported by a trading venue as an "on-book" trade

code.name: SISeller
code.synopsis: Trade has or will be reported as a seller trade by the authorised reporter

code.name: SIBuyer
code.synopsis: Trade has or will be reported as a buyer trade by the authorised reporter

code.name: NonSISeller
code.synopsis: Trade has or will be reported as a seller trade by an entity other than the authorised reporter

code.name: SubDelegationByFirm
code.synopsis: Trade has been or will be reported under a sub-delegation arrangement by an investment firm to a reporting facility (e.g. APA) on behalf of another investment firm

code.name: Reportable
code.synopsis: Trade has been or will be reported

code.name: NonSIBuyer
code.synopsis: Trade has been or will be reported as a buyer trade by an entity other than the authorised reporter

code.name: OffBook
code.synopsis: Trade has been or will be reported by a trading venue as an "off-book" trade

field.name: AffiliatedFirmsTradeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the transaction or position was entered into between two affiliated firms. I.e. one counterparty has an ownership interest in the other counterparty but less than the majority interest.

field.name: InternationalSwapIndicator
field.synopsis: Identifies the swap trade as an "international" transaction.

field.name: MultiAssetSwapIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates a swap that does not have one easily identifiable primary underlying asset, but instead involves multiple underlying assets within one trade repository's jurisdiction that belong to different asset classes.

field.name: ClearingSettlPrice
field.synopsis: Clearing settlement price.

field.name: NoRelativeValues
field.synopsis: Number of relative value metrics entries in the repeating group.

field.name: RelativeValueType
field.synopsis: Indicates the type of relative value measurement being specified.

field.name: RelativeValue
field.synopsis: The valuation of an instrument relative to a base measurement specified in RelativeValueType(2530). This value can be negative.

field.name: RelativeValueSide
field.synopsis: Specifies the side of the relative value.

field.name: BidSpread
field.synopsis: Basis points relative to a benchmark curve on the bid side, such as LIBOR, or a known security, such as 10Y US Treasury bond. The benchmark security or curve name is specified in the SpreadOrBenchmarkCurveData component.

field.name: OfferSpread
field.synopsis: Basis points relative to a benchmark curve on the offer side, such as LIBOR, or a known security, such as 10Y US Treasury bond. The benchmark security or curve name is specified in the SpreadOrBenchmarkCurveData component.

field.name: MDReportEvent
field.synopsis: Technical event within market data feed.

field.name: MDReportCount
field.synopsis: Number of reference and market data messages in-between two MarketDataReport(35=DR) messages.

field.name: TotNoMarketSegmentReports
field.synopsis: Total number of reports related to market segments.

field.name: TotNoInstrumentReports
field.synopsis: Total number of reports related to instruments.

field.name: TotNoPartyDetailReports
field.synopsis: Total number of reports related to party detail information.

field.name: TotNoEntitlementReports
field.synopsis: Total number of reports related to party entitlement information.

field.name: TotNoRiskLimitReports
field.synopsis: Total number of reports related to party risk limit information.

field.name: MarketSegmentStatus
field.synopsis: Status of market segment.

field.name: MarketSegmentType
field.synopsis: Used to classify the type of market segment.

field.name: MarketSegmentSubType
field.synopsis: Used to further categorize market segments within a MarketSegmentType(2543).

field.name: NoRelatedMarketSegments
field.synopsis: Number of related market segments.

field.name: RelatedMarketSegmentID
field.synopsis: Identifies a related market segment.

field.name: MarketSegmentRelationship
field.synopsis: Type of relationship between two or more market segments.

field.name: NoAuctionTypeRules
field.synopsis: Number of auction order types.

field.name: AuctionTypeProductComplex
field.synopsis: Identifies an entire suite of products for which the auction order type rule applies.

field.name: NoPriceRangeRules
field.synopsis: Number of rules related to price ranges.

field.name: StartPriceRange
field.synopsis: Lower boundary for price range.

field.synopsis: Cross reference to another notional amount for duplicating its properties.

field.name: UnderlyingFutureID
field.synopsis: In the case of an index underlier specifies the unique identifier for the referenced futures contract.

field.name: UnderlyingFutureIDSource

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation

field.synopsis: The number of units (units of the index or number of securities, par amount of a bond) that constitute the underlier. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

field.name: UnderlyingBasketDivisor
field.synopsis: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

field.name: UnderlyingInstrumentXID

field.name: EncodedMiscFeeSubTypeDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2636) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MiscFeeSubTypeDesc(2636) field.

field.name: NoCommissions
field.synopsis: Number of commissions in the repeating group.

field.name: CommissionAmount
field.synopsis: The commission amount.

field.synopsis: Indicates what type of commission is being expressed in CommissionAmount(2640).

field.synopsis: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

field.name: CommissionCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency denomination of the commission amount if different from the trade's currency.

field.name: CommissionUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: The commission rate unit of measure.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: CommissionUnitOfMeasureCurrency
field.synopsis: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when CommissionUnitOfMeasure(2644) = Ccy (Amount of currency).

field.name: CommissionRate
field.synopsis: The commission rate when CommissionAmount(2640) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". If the rate is a percentage or expressed in basis points, use the decimalized form, e.g. "0.05" for a 5% commission or "0.005" for 50 basis points.

field.name: CommissionSharedIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the amount in CommissionAmount(2640) is to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement.

field.name: CommissionAmountShared
field.synopsis: Commission amount to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement. If specified, this amount should not exceed the amount in CommissionAmount(2640).

field.name: CommissionLegRefID

field.name: CommissionDesc

field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the CommissionDesc(2650) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding(347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the CommissionDesc(2650) field.

field.name: AllocCommissionAmount

field.name: AllocCommissionUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: The commission rate unit of measure.

field.synopsis: Indicates the currency of the unit of measure. Conditionally required when AllocCommissionUnitOfMeasure(2658) = Ccy (Currency).

field.name: AllocCommissionRate
field.synopsis: The commission rate when AllocCommissionAmount(2654) is based on a percentage of quantity, amount per unit or a factor of "unit of measure". field.name: AllocCommissionSharedIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the amount in AllocCommissionAmount(2654) is to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement.

field.name: AllocCommissionAmountShared
field.synopsis: Commission amount to be shared with a third party, e.g. as part of a directed brokerage commission sharing arrangement. If specified, this amount should not exceed the amount in AllocCommissionAmount(2654).

field.name: AllocCommissionLegRefID
field.synopsis: Identifies the leg of the trade the entry applies to by referencing the leg's LegID(1788).

field.name: AllocCommissionDesc
field.synopsis: Description of the commission.

code.name: NonSISeller

code.name: Reportable
code.synopsis: Trade has been or will be reported

field.synopsis: Maximum deviation, in percentage terms, of an execution price from a reference price, e.g. the initial price of a match event.

field.name: DerivativeInTheMoneyCondition
field.synopsis: Specifies an option instrument's "in the money" condition in general terms.

field.synopsis: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of LegInTheMoneyCondition(2682). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

field.synopsis: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of UnderlyingInTheMoneyCondition(2683). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

field.synopsis: Identifies whether the option instrument is eligible for contrary instructions at the time of exercise. The contrariness of an instruction will be determined in the context of DerivativeInTheMoneyCondition(2684). When not specified, the eligibility is undefined or not applicable.

field.name: SideCollateralAmountType
field.synopsis: The type of value in CurrentCollateralAmount(1704).

field.name: SideCollateralFXRateCalc

field.name: SideCollateralMarketPrice
field.synopsis: Market price of the collateral, either from market sources or pre-agreed by the counterparties.

field.name: SideCollateralPercentOverage
field.synopsis: Percentage of over-collateralization particularly when SideCollateralAmountType(2694) = 4 (Additional collateral value).
