field.synopsis: Identifies the source scheme of the AdditionalTermBondSecurityID(40001) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: AdditionalTermBondDesc
field.synopsis: Description of the bond.

field.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDescLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc(40005) field.

field.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the bond value is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondIssuer
field.synopsis: Issuer of the bond.

field.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer(40009) field.

field.name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondSeniority
field.synopsis: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondCouponType
field.synopsis: Coupon type of the bond.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondCouponRate
field.synopsis: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

field.name: AdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
field.synopsis: The maturity date of the bond.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondParValue
field.synopsis: The par value of the bond.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
field.synopsis: Total issued amount of the bond.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: AdditionalTermBondDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

field.name: NoAdditionalTerms
field.synopsis: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

field.name: AdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

field.name: AdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

field.name: NoCashSettlTerms
field.synopsis: Number of elements in the repeating group.

field.name: CashSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the CashSettlAmount(40034) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: CashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
field.synopsis: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for the purpose of cash settlement.

field.name: CashSettlValuationTime
field.synopsis: The time of valuation.

field.name: CashSettlBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: CashSettlQuoteMethod
field.synopsis: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

field.name: CashSettlQuoteAmount
field.synopsis: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

field.name: CashSettlQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the CashSettlQuoteAmount(40028) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

field.name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
field.synopsis: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

field.name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount(40030) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

field.name: CashSettlDealer
field.synopsis: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.

field.name: CashSettlBusinessDays
field.synopsis: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.

field.name: CashSettlAmount
field.synopsis: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

field.name: CashSettlRecoveryFactor
field.synopsis: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount calculated is (1 - CashSettlRecoveryFactor(40035)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

field.name: CashSettlFixedTermIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

field.name: CashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in CashSettlAmount(40034). For cash settlement this specifies whether quotations should be obtained inclusive or not of accrued interest.

field.name: CashSettlValuationMethod
field.synopsis: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

field.name: CashSettlTermXID
field.synopsis: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

field.name: NoContractualDefinitions
field.synopsis: Number of financing definitions in the repeating group.

field.name: ContractualDefinition
field.synopsis: Specifies which contract definition, such as those published by ISDA, will apply for the terms of the trade. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-definitions for values.

field.name: NoContractualMatrices
field.synopsis: Number of contractual matrices in the repeating group.

field.name: ContractualMatrixSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the applicable contract matrix. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/matrix-type-1-0.xml for values.

field.name: ContractualMatrixDate
field.synopsis: The publication date of the applicable version of the contract matrix. If not specified, the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

field.name: ContractualMatrixTerm
field.synopsis: Specifies the applicable key into the relevant contract matrix. In the case of 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions, the ContractualMatrixTerm(40045) is not applicable and is to be omitted. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-matrix-transaction-type for values.

field.name: NoFinancingTermSupplements
field.synopsis: Number of financing terms supplements in the repeating group.

field.name: FinancingTermSupplementDesc
field.synopsis: Identifies the applicable contractual supplement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-supplement for values.

field.name: FinancingTermSupplementDate
field.synopsis: The publication date of the applicable version of the contractual supplement.

field.name: NoStreams
field.synopsis: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

field.name: StreamType
field.synopsis: Type of swap stream.

field.name: StreamDesc
field.synopsis: A short descriptive name given to the payment stream. Eg. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as reference.

field.name: StreamPaySide
field.synopsis: The side of the party paying the stream.

field.name: StreamReceiveSide
field.synopsis: The side of the party receiving the stream.

field.name: StreamNotional
field.synopsis: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. Use the PaymentScheduleGrp component to specify the rate steps.

field.name: StreamCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the StreamNotional(40054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: StreamText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted effective date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the effective date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative effective date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative effective date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative effective date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted effective date.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted termination date.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

field.name: StreamTerminationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted termination date.

field.name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust calculation periods, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

field.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

field.name: StreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

field.name: StreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

field.name: StreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

field.name: StreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

field.name: StreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

field.name: StreamCalculationRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: NoSettlRateFallbacks
field.synopsis: Number of settlement rate fallbacks in the repeating group

field.name: SettlRatePostponementMaximumDays
field.synopsis: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceding to this method.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of the rate information.

field.name: SettlRatePostponementSurvey
field.synopsis: Indicates whether to request a settlement rate quote from the market.

field.name: SettlRatePostponementCalculationAgent
field.synopsis: Used to identify the settlement rate postponement calculation agent.

code.name: MasterAgreeent
code.synopsis: As specified in the master agreement

code.name: Supplement
code.synopsis: As specified in the standard terms supplement

field.name: NoProvisions
field.synopsis: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

field.name: ProvisionType
field.synopsis: Type of provisions.

field.name: ProvisionDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date of the provision.

field.name: ProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: ProvisionDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted date of the provision.

field.name: ProvisionDateTenorPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

field.name: ProvisionDateTenorUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

field.name: ProvisionCalculationAgent
field.synopsis: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in ProvisionCalculationAgent(40098) or in the ProvisionParties component.

code.name: MasterAgreeent
code.synopsis: As specified in the master agreement

code.name: Supplement
code.synopsis: As specified in the standard terms supplement

field.name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
field.synopsis: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

field.name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
field.synopsis: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
field.synopsis: The instrument provision option’s exercise style.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
field.synopsis: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
field.synopsis: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
field.synopsis: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: ProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
field.synopsis: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: ProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
field.synopsis: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
field.synopsis: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlMethod
field.synopsis: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of quote information.

field.name: ProvisionText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTime
field.synopsis: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The cash settlement valuation date adjustment business day convention. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
field.synopsis: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
field.synopsis: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
field.synopsis: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
field.synopsis: Number of provision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
field.synopsis: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(40144).

field.name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTime
field.synopsis: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

field.name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
field.synopsis: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
field.synopsis: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

field.name: NoProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
field.synopsis: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
field.synopsis: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40173).

field.name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: NoProvisionPartyIDs
field.synopsis: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

field.name: ProvisionPartyID
field.synopsis: The party identifier/code for the payment settlement party.

field.name: ProvisionPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies class or source of the ProvisionPartyID(40175) value.

code.name: UKNationalInsuranceOrPensionNumber
code.synopsis: UK National Insurance or Pension Number

code.name: USEmployerOrTaxIDNumber
code.synopsis: US Employer or Tax ID Number

code.name: TaiwaneseForeignInvestorID
code.synopsis: Taiwanese Qualified Foreign Investor ID QFII/FID

code.name: ISITCAcronym
code.synopsis: Directed broker three character acronym as defined in ISITC "ETC Best Practice" guidelines document

code.name: BIC
code.synopsis: BIC (Bank Identification Code - SWIFT managed) code (ISO9362 - See "Appendix 6-B")

code.name: GeneralIdentifier
code.synopsis: Generally accepted market participant identifier (e.g. NASD mnemonic)

code.name: SettlementEntityLocation
code.synopsis: Settlement Entity Location (note if Local Market Settlement use "E=ISO Country Code") (see "Appendix 6-G" for valid values)

code.name: CSDParticipant
code.synopsis: CSD participant/member code (e.g. Euroclear, DTC, CREST or Kassenverein number

field.name: ProvisionPartyRole
field.synopsis: Identifies the type or role of ProvisionPartyID(40175) specified.

code.name: OrderOriginationTrader
code.synopsis: Order Origination Trader (associated with Order Origination Firm - i.e. trader who initiates/submits the order)

code.name: ExecutingTrader
code.synopsis: Executing Trader (associated with Executing Firm - actually executes)

code.name: GiveupClearingFirmDepr
code.synopsis: Giveup Clearing Firm (firm to which trade is given up)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityLiquidity
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity (CAL)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityTransactionVenue
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the Transaction (Execution) Venue (CATV)

code.name: PrimeBroker
code.synopsis: Prime Broker providing General Trade Services

field.name: NoProvisionPartySubIDs
field.synopsis: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

field.name: ProvisionPartySubID
field.synopsis: Party sub-identifier, if applicable, for ProvisionPartyID(40175).

field.name: ProvisionPartySubIDType
field.synopsis: The type of ProvisionPartySubID(40179).

code.name: RegistrationNumber
code.synopsis: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)

code.name: ContractLinked
code.synopsis: Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: NoProtectionTerms
field.synopsis: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

field.name: ProtectionTermNotional
field.synopsis: The notional amount of protection coverage.

field.name: ProtectionTermCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of ProtectionTermNotional(40182). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ProtectionTermSellerNotifies
field.synopsis: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

field.name: ProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
field.synopsis: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProtectionTermStandardSources
field.synopsis: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (ProtectionTermStandardSources(40187)=Y) or not.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
field.synopsis: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventNewsSource
field.synopsis: Newspaper or electronic news service or source that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

field.name: ProtectionTermXID
field.synopsis: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

field.name: NoProtectionTermEvents
field.synopsis: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for code list of applicable event types.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventValue
field.synopsis: Protection term event value appropriate to ProtectionTermEvenType(40192). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for applicable event type values.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventCurrency
field.synopsis: Applicable currency if ProtectionTermEventValue(40193) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for protection term events.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with protection term events.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventDayType
field.synopsis: Day type for events that specify a period and unit.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventRateSource
field.synopsis: Rate source for events that specify a rate source, e.g. Floating rate interest shortfall.

field.name: NoProtectionTermEventQualifiers
field.synopsis: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

field.name: ProtectionTermEventQualifier
field.synopsis: Protection term event qualifier. Used to further qualify ProtectionTermEventType(40192).

field.name: NoProtectionTermObligations
field.synopsis: Number of obligations in the repeating group.

field.name: ProtectionTermObligationType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of obligation applicable to the protection terms. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for code list of applicable obligation types.

field.name: ProtectionTermObligationValue
field.synopsis: Protection term obligation value appropriate to ProtectionTermObligationType(40202). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

field.name: NoPhysicalSettlTerms
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the repeating group.

field.name: PhysicalSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PhysicalSettlBusinessDays
field.synopsis: The number of business days used in the determination of physical settlement. Its precise meaning depends on the context in which this element is used.

field.name: PhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
field.synopsis: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning depends on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

field.name: PhysicalSettlTermXID
field.synopsis: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

field.name: NoPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the repeating group.

field.name: PhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of deliverable obligation applicable for physical settlement. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

field.name: PhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
field.synopsis: Physical settlement deliverable obligation value appropriate to PhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(40210). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

field.name: NoPayments
field.synopsis: Number of additional settlement or bullet payments.

field.name: PaymentType
field.synopsis: Type of payment.

field.name: PaymentPaySide
field.synopsis: The side of the party paying the payment.

field.name: PaymentReceiveSide
field.synopsis: The side of the party receiving the payment.

field.name: PaymentCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency in which PaymentAmount(40217) is denominated. Uses ISO 4271 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentAmount
field.synopsis: The total payment amount.

field.name: PaymentPrice
field.synopsis: The price determining the payment amount expressed in terms specified in PaymentPriceType(40919) and expressed in market format.

field.name: PaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted payment date.

field.name: PaymentBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: PaymentBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted payment date.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionValue
field.synopsis: Applicable value for LegMarketDisruptionEvent(41468).

field.name: PaymentDiscountFactor
field.synopsis: The value representing the discount factor used to calculate the present value of the cash flow.

field.name: PaymentPresentValueAmount
field.synopsis: The amount representing the present value of the forecast payment.

field.name: PaymentPresentValueCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the PaymentPresentValueAmount(40225) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentSettlStyle
field.synopsis: Payment settlement style.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource(40087) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains a value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: PaymentText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a sdtandard value does not apply. Identifies the payment type when PaymentType(40213) = 99 (Other).

field.name: NoPaymentSettls
field.synopsis: Number of additional settlements or bullet payments.

field.name: PaymentSettlAmount
field.synopsis: The payment settlement amount.

field.name: PaymentSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the PaymentSettlAmount(40231) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: NoPaymentSettlPartyIDs
field.synopsis: Number of parties identified in the additional settlement or bullet payment.

field.name: PaymentSettlPartyID
field.synopsis: The payment settlement party identifier.

field.name: PaymentSettlPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of PaymentSettlPartyID(40234) value (e.g. BIC).

code.name: CSDParticipant

field.synopsis: Identifies the role of PaymentSettlPartyID(40234) (e.g. the beneficiary's bank or depository institution).

field.synopsis: Qualifies the value of PaymentSettlPartyRole(40236).

field.name: NoPaymentSettlPartySubIDs
field.synopsis: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

field.name: PaymentSettlPartySubID
field.synopsis: Party sub-identifier, if applicable, for PaymentSettlPartyRole(40236).

field.name: PaymentSettlPartySubIDType
field.synopsis: The type of PaymentSettlPartySubID(40239) value.

code.name: RegistrationNumber
code.synopsis: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)

code.synopsis: Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: NoLegStreams
field.synopsis: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

field.name: LegStreamType
field.synopsis: Type of swap stream.

field.name: LegStreamDesc
field.synopsis: A short descriptive name given to the payment stream, e.g. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as a reference.

field.name: LegStreamPaySide
field.synopsis: The side of the party paying the stream.

field.name: LegStreamReceiveSide
field.synopsis: The side of the party receiving the stream.

field.name: LegStreamNotional
field.synopsis: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. The LegPaymentSchedule component should be used for specifying the steps.

field.name: LegStreamCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the LegStreamNotional(40246) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegStreamText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted effective date.

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's effective date or relative effective date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's effective date or relative effective date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the effective date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative effective date offset.

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative effective date offset.

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative effective date offset.

field.name: LegStreamEffectiveDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted effective date.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted termination date.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

field.name: LegStreamTerminationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted termination date.

field.name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust calculation periods, e.g. "GLBO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

field.name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegStreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

field.name: LegStreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

field.name: LegStreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

field.name: LegStreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

field.name: LegStreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

field.name: LegStreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

field.name: LegStreamCalculationRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: NoCashSettlDealers
field.synopsis: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

field.name: NoBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of payment stream applicable to the swap stream associated with the instrument leg.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamMarketRate
field.synopsis: Used only for credit index trade. This contains the credit spread ("fair value") at which the trade was executed. The market rate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. This is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamDelayIndicator
field.synopsis: Applicable to credit default swaps on mortgage backed securities to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed amount.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency that the stream settles in (to support swaps that settle in a currency different from the notional currency). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in the payment stream calculations.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamAccrualDays
field.synopsis: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamDiscountType
field.synopsis: The method of calculating discounted payment amounts.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamDiscountRate
field.synopsis: Discount rate. The rate is expressed in decimal, e.g. 5% is expressed as 0.05.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamDiscountRateDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention applied to the LegPaymentStreamDiscountRate(40286).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingMethod
field.synopsis: Compounding method.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInterimPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of payments.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of payments.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: SFE

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFirstPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first payment date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLastRegularPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last regular payment date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when payment dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative payment date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative payment date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamResetDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the reset dates are relative to an anchor date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's reset date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's reset date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamResetFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for frequency of resets.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamResetFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with frequency of resets.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamResetWeeklyRollConvention
field.synopsis: Used to specify the day of the week in which the reset occurs for payments that reset on a weekly basis.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the initial fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted initial fixing date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted fixing date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRate
field.synopsis: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment stream.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixedAmount
field.synopsis: The leg instrument payment stream's fixed payment amount. In a CDS, this can be an alternative to LegPaymentStreamRate(40326).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateOrAmountCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency in which LegPaymentStreamFixedAmount(40327) or LegPaymentStreamRate(40326) is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFutureValueNotional
field.synopsis: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex
field.synopsis: The payment stream floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexSource
field.synopsis: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpread
field.synopsis: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndex(40331).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determineds the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
field.synopsis: The inflation lag period day type.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the inflation index level from multiple points. The most common is linear method.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationIndexSource
field.synopsis: The inflation index reference source.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationPublicationSource
field.synopsis: The publication source, such as relevant web site, news publication or a government body, where inflation information is obtained.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationInitialIndexLevel
field.synopsis: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInflationFallbackBondApplicable
field.synopsis: Indicates whether a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8, is applicable or not. If not specified, the default value is "Y" (True/Yes).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFRADiscounting
field.synopsis: The method of Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) discounting, if any, that will apply.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableRefCurrency
field.synopsis: Non-deliverable settlement reference currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable settlement terms. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the non-deliverable fixing dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: LegSettlRateFallbackRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information.

field.name: NoLegNonDeliverableFixingDates
field.synopsis: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

field.name: LegNonDeliverableFixingDate
field.synopsis: The non-deliverable fixing date. Type of date is specified in LegNonDeliverableFixingDateType(40369).

field.name: LegNonDeliverableFixingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: LegSettlRateFallbackReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When LegSettlRateFallbackRateSource(40366) = 3(ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information.

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When PaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource(40371) = 3(ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: SettlRateFallbackRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information.

field.name: NoLegPaymentSchedules
field.synopsis: Number of swap schedules in the repeating group

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStubType
field.synopsis: Indicates to which stub this schedule applies.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the value is adjusted, or calculated if a future value notional for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)), or the start date of a cashflow payment.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date of a cashflow payment.

field.name: LegPaymentSchedulePaySide
field.synopsis: The side of the party paying the step schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleReceiveSide
field.synopsis: The side of the party receiving the step schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleNotional
field.synopsis: The notional value for this step schedule, or amount of a cashflow payment.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency for this step schedule. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleRate
field.synopsis: The rate value for this step schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpread
field.synopsis: The spread value for this step schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixedAmount
field.synopsis: The explicit payment amount for this step schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixedCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue
field.synopsis: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepRate
field.synopsis: The percentage by which the notional changes on each step date. The percentage is either a percentage applied to the initial notional amount or the previous outstanding notional, depending on the value specified in LegPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo(40395). The percentage can be either positive or negative.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetRate
field.synopsis: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies whether the LegPaymentScheduleStepRate(40393) or LegPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40392) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted fixing date.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleWeight
field.synopsis: Floating rate observation weight for cashflow payment.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted fixing date.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingTime
field.synopsis: The fxing time associated with the step schedule.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Business center for determining fixing time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangePaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the interim exchange payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative interim exchange date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative interim exchange date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative interim exchange date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted interim exchange date.

field.name: NoLegPaymentScheduleRateSources
field.synopsis: Number of rate sources in the repeating group

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSourceType
field.synopsis: Rate source type.

field.name: LegPaymentScheduleReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When RateSource(1446) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: NoLegPaymentStubs
field.synopsis: Number of stubs in the repeating group

field.name: LegPaymentStubType
field.synopsis: Stub type.

field.name: LegPaymentStubLength
field.synopsis: Optional indication whether stub is shorter or longer than the regular swap period.

field.name: LegPaymentStubRate
field.synopsis: The agreed upon fixed rate for this stub.

field.name: LegPaymentStubFixedAmount
field.synopsis: A fixed payment amount for the stub.

field.name: LegPaymentStubFixedCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of the fixed payment amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex
field.synopsis: The stub floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexSource
field.synopsis: The source for the stub floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateSpread
field.synopsis: Spread from floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the stub index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level.
