The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndexFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2
field.synopsis: The second stub floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2Source
field.synopsis: The source for the second stub floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2CurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Secondary time unit multiplier for the stub floating rate index curve.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2CurveUnit
field.synopsis: Secondary time unit associated with the stub floating rate index curve.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the second floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateSpread
field.synopsis: Spread from the second floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or a short position.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2RateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the second stub index.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2CapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: LegPaymentStubIndex2FloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: NoLegProvisions
field.synopsis: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

field.name: LegProvisionType
field.synopsis: Type of provisions.

field.name: LegProvisionDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date of the provision.

field.name: LegProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegProvisionDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted date of the provision.

field.name: LegProvisionDateTenorPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the leg provision's tenor period.

field.name: LegProvisionDateTenorUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the leg provision's tenor period.

field.name: LegProvisionCalculationAgent
field.synopsis: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in LegProvisionCalculationAgent(40456) or in the ProvisionParties component.

code.name: MasterAgreeent
code.synopsis: As specified in the master agreement

code.name: Supplement
code.synopsis: As specified in the standard terms supplement

field.name: LegProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
field.synopsis: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
field.synopsis: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
field.synopsis: The instrument provision option exercise style.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
field.synopsis: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
field.synopsis: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
field.synopsis: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
field.synopsis: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
field.synopsis: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
field.synopsis: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlMethod
field.synopsis: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of quote information.

field.name: BusinessCenter
field.synopsis: A business center whose calendar is used for date adjustment, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

field.name: NoLegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
field.synopsis: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
field.synopsis: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40521).

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
field.synopsis: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
field.synopsis: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
field.synopsis: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoLegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
field.synopsis: Number of provision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
field.synopsis: A predetermined option exercise date unadjusted or adjusted depending on LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(40497).

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationTime
field.synopsis: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option relevant underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument leg's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
field.synopsis: The first date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
field.synopsis: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueTime
field.synopsis: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: LegProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

field.name: NoLegProvisionPartyIDs
field.synopsis: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

field.name: LegProvisionPartyID
field.synopsis: The party identifier/code for the payment settlement party.

field.name: LegProvisionPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of LegProvisionPartyID(40534).

code.name: UKNationalInsuranceOrPensionNumber
code.synopsis: UK National Insurance or Pension Number

code.name: USEmployerOrTaxIDNumber
code.synopsis: US Employer or Tax ID Number

code.name: TaiwaneseForeignInvestorID
code.synopsis: Taiwanese Qualified Foreign Investor ID QFII/FID

code.name: ISITCAcronym
code.synopsis: Directed broker three character acronym as defined in ISITC "ETC Best Practice" guidelines document

code.name: BIC
code.synopsis: BIC (Bank Identification Code - SWIFT managed) code (ISO9362 - See "Appendix 6-B")

code.name: GeneralIdentifier
code.synopsis: Generally accepted market participant identifier (e.g. NASD mnemonic)

code.name: SettlementEntityLocation
code.synopsis: Settlement Entity Location (note if Local Market Settlement use "E=ISO Country Code") (see "Appendix 6-G" for valid values)

code.name: CSDParticipant
code.synopsis: CSD participant/member code (e.g. Euroclear, DTC, CREST or Kassenverein number

field.name: LegProvisionPartyRole
field.synopsis: Identifies the type or role of LegProvisionPartyID(40534) specified.

code.name: OrderOriginationTrader
code.synopsis: Order Origination Trader (associated with Order Origination Firm - i.e. trader who initiates/submits the order)

code.name: ExecutingTrader
code.synopsis: Executing Trader (associated with Executing Firm - actually executes)

code.name: GiveupClearingFirmDepr
code.synopsis: Giveup Clearing Firm (firm to which trade is given up)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityLiquidity
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity (CAL)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityTransactionVenue
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the Transaction (Execution) Venue (CATV)

code.name: PrimeBroker
code.synopsis: Prime Broker providing General Trade Services

field.name: NoLegProvisionPartySubIDs
field.synopsis: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

field.name: LegProvisionPartySubID
field.synopsis: Party sub-identifier, if applicable, for LegProvisionPartyRole(40536).

field.name: LegProvisionPartySubIDType
field.synopsis: The type of LegProvisionPartySubID(40538) value.

code.name: RegistrationNumber
code.synopsis: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)

code.name: ContractLinked
code.synopsis: Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreams
field.synopsis: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamType
field.synopsis: Type of swap stream.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamDesc
field.synopsis: A short descriptive name given to payment stream. Eg. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as a reference.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamPaySide
field.synopsis: The side of the party paying the stream.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamReceiveSide
field.synopsis: The side of the party receiving the stream.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamNotional
field.synopsis: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. Use SwapSchedule for steps.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingStreamNotional(40545) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted termination date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTerminationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted termination date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the calculation periods, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of payment stream applicable to the swap stream associated with the underlying instrument.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMarketRate
field.synopsis: Used only for credit index trade. This contains the credit spread ("fair value") at which the trade was executed. The market rate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. This is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDelayIndicator
field.synopsis: Applicable to credit default swaps on mortgage backed securities to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed amount.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency that the stream settles in (to support swaps that settle in a currency different from the notional currency). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in the payment stream calculations.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamAccrualDays
field.synopsis: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountType
field.synopsis: The method of calculating discounted payment amounts

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountRate
field.synopsis: Discount rate. The rate is expressed in decimal, e.g. 5% is expressed as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountRateDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention applied to the UnderlyingPaymentStreamDiscountRate(40575).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingMethod
field.synopsis: Compounding Method.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterimPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of payments.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of payments.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLastRegularPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last regular payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when payment dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the reset dates are relative to an anchor date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's reset date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's reset date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for frequency of resets.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with frequency of resets.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamResetWeeklyRollConvention
field.synopsis: Used to specify the day of the week in which the reset occurs for payments that reset on a weekly basis.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the initial fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted initial fixing date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted fixing date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate
field.synopsis: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixedAmount
field.synopsis: The underlying payment stream's fixed payment amount. In CDS an alternative to UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate(40615).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateOrAmountCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency in which UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixedAmount(40616) or UnderlyingPaymentStreamRate(40615) is denominated. Users ISO 4271 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFutureValueNotional
field.synopsis: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex
field.synopsis: The payment stream's floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexSource
field.synopsis: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the underlying instrument’s floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the underlying instrument’s floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. A multiplier schedule is expressed as explicit multipliers and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in the calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpread
field.synopsis: Spread from floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies a short or long spread value.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. An initial rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: When rate averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average calculation method is to be used.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determines the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
field.synopsis: The inflation lag period day type.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the Inflation Index Level from multiple points - the most common is Linear.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationIndexSource
field.synopsis: The inflation index reference source.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationPublicationSource
field.synopsis: The current main publication source such as relevant web site or a government body.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationInitialIndexLevel
field.synopsis: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInflationFallbackBondApplicable
field.synopsis: Indicates whether a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8, is applicable or not. If not specified, the default value is "Y" (True/Yes).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFRADiscounting
field.synopsis: The method of Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) discounting, if any, that will apply.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableRefCurrency
field.synopsis: The non-deliverable settlement reference currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBizDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the non-deliverable fixing dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: SettlRateFallbackReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When SettlRateFallbackRateSource(40373) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: NoUnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDates
field.synopsis: Number of Fixing dates in the repeating group

field.name: UnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDate
field.synopsis: The non-deliverable fixing date unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDateType(40658).

field.name: UnderlyingNonDeliverableFixingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: NoUnderlyingSettlRateFallbacks
field.synopsis: Number of settlement rate fallbacks in the repeating group

field.name: UnderlyingSettlRatePostponementMaximumDays
field.synopsis: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceding to this method.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information.

field.name: UnderlyingSettlRatePostponementSurvey
field.synopsis: Indicates whether to request a settlement rate quote from the market.

field.name: UnderlyingSettlRatePostponementCalculationAgent
field.synopsis: Used to identify the settlement rate postponement calculation agent.

code.name: MasterAgreeent
code.synopsis: As specified in the master agreement

code.name: Supplement
code.synopsis: As specified in the standard terms supplement

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentSchedules
field.synopsis: Number of swap schedules in the repeating group

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleType
field.synopsis: Type of schedule.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStubType
field.synopsis: Indicates to which stub this schedule applies.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the value is adjusted, or calculated if a future value notional for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)), or the start date of a cashflow payment.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date of a cashflow payment.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentSchedulePaySide
field.synopsis: The side of the party paying the step schedule.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleReceiveSide
field.synopsis: The side of the party receiving the step schedule.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleNotional
field.synopsis: The notional value for this step, or amount of a cashflow payment.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency for this step. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRate
field.synopsis: The rate value for this step.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSpread
field.synopsis: The spread value for this step.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixedAmount
field.synopsis: The explicit payment amount for this step.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixedCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue
field.synopsis: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRate
field.synopsis: The percentage by which the notional changes on each step date. The percentage is either a percentage applied to the initial notional amount or the previous outstanding notional, depending on the value specified in UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo(40685). The percentage can be either positive or negative.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepOffsetRate
field.synopsis: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies whether the UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepRate(40683) or UnderlyingPaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40682) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted fixing date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleWeight
field.synopsis: Floating rate observation weight for cashflow payment.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessDayCnvtn
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted fixing date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingTime
field.synopsis: The fixing time.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleFixingTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Business center for determining fixing time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangePaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the interim exchange payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBizDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's interim exchange date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative interim exchange date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative interim exchange date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative interim exchange date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted interim exchange date.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSources
field.synopsis: Number of rate sources in the repeating group

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleRateSourceType
field.synopsis: Rate source type.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentScheduleReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When RateSource(1446) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStubs
field.synopsis: Number of stubs in the repeating group

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubType
field.synopsis: Stub type.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubLength
field.synopsis: Optional indication whether stub is shorter or longer than the regular swap period.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubRate
field.synopsis: The agreed upon fixed rate for this stub.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubFixedAmount
field.synopsis: A fixed payment amount for the stub.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubFixedCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of the fixed payment amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex
field.synopsis: The stub floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexSource
field.synopsis: The source for the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the underlying payment stub floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateSpread
field.synopsis: Spread from floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the stub index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndexFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2
field.synopsis: The second stub floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2Source
field.synopsis: The source of the second stub floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2CurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Secondary time unit multiplier for the stub floating rate index curve.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2CurveUnit
field.synopsis: Secondary time unit associated with the stub floating rate index curve.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the second floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateSpread
field.synopsis: Spread from the second floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2RateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the second stub index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2CapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubIndex2FloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the second floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: PaymentStreamType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of payment stream associated with the swap.

field.name: PaymentStreamMarketRate
field.synopsis: Used only for credit index trade. This contains the credit spread ("fair value") at which the trade was executed. The market rate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. This is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

field.name: PaymentStreamDelayIndicator
field.synopsis: Applicable to credit default swaps on mortgage backed securities to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed amount.

field.name: PaymentStreamSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency that the stream settles in (to support swaps that settle in a currency different from the notional currency). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentStreamDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in the payment stream calculations.

field.name: PaymentStreamAccrualDays
field.synopsis: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

field.name: PaymentStreamDiscountType
field.synopsis: The method of calculating discounted payment amounts

field.name: PaymentStreamDiscountRate
field.synopsis: Discount rate. The rate is expressed in decimal, e.g. 5% is expressed as 0.05.

field.name: PaymentStreamDiscountRateDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention applied to the PaymentStreamDiscountRate(40745).

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingMethod
field.synopsis: Compounding method.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

field.name: PaymentStreamInterimPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalPrincipalExchangeIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's payment date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of payments.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of payments.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: PaymentStreamFirstPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first payment date.

field.name: PaymentStreamLastRegularPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last regular payment date.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when payment dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamResetDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the reset dates are relative to an anchor date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamResetDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's reset date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: PaymentStreamResetDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's reset date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentStreamResetFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of resets.

field.name: PaymentStreamResetFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of resets.

field.name: PaymentStreamResetWeeklyRollConvention
field.synopsis: Used to specify the day of the week in which the reset occurs for payments that reset on a weekly basis.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the initial fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's initial fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative initial fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted initial fixing date.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted fixing date.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateCutoffDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative rate cut-off date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamRate
field.synopsis: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment stream.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixedAmount
field.synopsis: The payment stream's fixed payment amount. In CDS an alternative to PaymentStreamRate(40784).

field.name: PaymentStreamRateOrAmountCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency in which PaymentStreamFixedAmount(40785) or PaymentStreamRate(40784) is denominated. Uses ISO 4271 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentStreamFutureValueNotional
field.synopsis: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

field.name: PaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateIndex
field.synopsis: The payment stream floating rate index.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateIndexSource
field.synopsis: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the floating rate index.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. A multiplier schedule is expressed as explicit multipliers and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in the calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateSpread
field.synopsis: Spread from floating rate index.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: PaymentStreamRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: PaymentStreamCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: PaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: PaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. An initial rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: PaymentStreamAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: When rate averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average calculation method is to be used.

field.name: PaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determines the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
field.synopsis: The inflation lag period day type.

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the Inflation Index Level from multiple points - the most common is Linear.

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationIndexSource
field.synopsis: The inflation index reference source.

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationPublicationSource
field.synopsis: The current main publication source such as relevant web site or a government body.

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationInitialIndexLevel
field.synopsis: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

field.name: PaymentStreamInflationFallbackBondApplicable
field.synopsis: Indicates whether a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8, is applicable or not. If not specified, the default value is "Y" (True/Yes).

field.name: PaymentStreamFRADiscounting
field.synopsis: The method of Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) discounting, if any, that will apply.

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableRefCurrency
field.synopsis: The non-deliverable settlement reference currency. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable settlement terms. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's fixing date for the non-deliverable terms, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the non-deliverable fixing dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamNonDeliverableFixingDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative non-deliverable fixing date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. When UnderlyingPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource(40661) = 3(ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: NoNonDeliverableFixingDates
field.synopsis: Number of Fixing dates in the repeating group

field.name: NonDeliverableFixingDate
field.synopsis: Non-deliverable fixing date unadjusted or adjusted depending on NonDeliverableFixingDateType(40827).

field.name: NonDeliverableFixingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: NoPaymentSchedules
field.synopsis: Number of swap schedules in the repeating group

field.name: PaymentScheduleType
field.synopsis: Type of schedule.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStubType
field.synopsis: Indicates to which stub this schedule applies.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The date on which the value is adjusted, or calculated if a future value notional for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)), or the start date of a cashflow payment.

field.name: PaymentScheduleEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date of a cash flow payment.

field.name: PaymentSchedulePaySide
field.synopsis: The side of the party paying the step schedule.

field.name: PaymentScheduleReceiveSide
field.synopsis: The side of the party receiving the stepf schedule.

field.name: PaymentScheduleNotional
field.synopsis: The notional value for this step, or amount of a cashflow payment.

field.name: PaymentScheduleCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency for this step. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentScheduleRate
field.synopsis: The rate value for this step schedule.

field.name: PaymentScheduleRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: PaymentScheduleRateSpread
field.synopsis: The spread value for this step schedule.
