field.name: PaymentScheduleRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: PaymentScheduleRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the step schedule.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixedAmount
field.synopsis: The explicit payment amount for this step schedule.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixedCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of the fixed amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStepFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the step frequency.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStepFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the step frequency.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue
field.synopsis: The explicit amount that the notional changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative amount.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStepRate
field.synopsis: The percentage by which the notional changes on each step date. The percentage is either a percentage applied to the initial notional amount or the previous outstanding notional, depending on the value specified in PaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo(40849). The percentage can be either positive or negative.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStepOffsetRate
field.synopsis: The explicit amount that the rate changes on each step date. This can be a positive or negative value.

field.name: PaymentScheduleStepRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies whether the PaymentScheduleStepRate(40847) or PaymentScheduleStepOffsetValue(40846) should be applied to the initial notional or the previous notional in order to calculate the notional step change amount.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted fixing date.

field.name: PaymentScheduleWeight
field.synopsis: Floating rate observation weight for cashflow payment.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the fixing date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment schedule's fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative fixing date offset.

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateOffsetDayType

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingDateAdjusted

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingTime

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Business center for determining fixing time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangePaymentDateRelativeTo

field.name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessDayConvention

field.name: PaymentScheduleInterimExchangeDatesBusinessCenter

field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the payment stub index.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStubIndexFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.synopsis: Secondary time unit associated with the stub floating rate index curve.

field.name: PaymentStubIndex2RateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the second floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: PaymentStubIndex2RateSpread
field.synopsis: Spread from the second floating rate index.

field.name: PaymentStubIndex2RateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: PaymentStubIndex2CapRate

The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

field.name: ComplexEventDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted complex event date.

field.name: ComplexEventDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the complex event date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ComplexEventDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative date offset.

field.name: ComplexEventDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative date offset.

field.name: ComplexEventDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative date offset.

field.name: ComplexEventDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the complex event date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: ComplexEventDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted complex event date.

field.name: ComplexEventFixingTime
field.synopsis: The local market fixing time.

field.name: ComplexEventFixingTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to determine the actual fixing times. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoComplexEventCreditEventSources

field.name: ComplexEventCreditEventSource
field.synopsis: A newspaper or electronic news service that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

field.name: NoComplexEventSchedules
field.synopsis: Number of schedules in the repeating group.

field.name: ComplexEventScheduleStartDate
field.synopsis: The start date of the schedule.

field.name: ComplexEventScheduleEndDate
field.synopsis: The end date of the schedule.

field.name: ComplexEventScheduleFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the schedule date frequency.

field.name: ComplexEventScheduleFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the schedule date frequency.

field.name: ComplexEventScheduleRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the DateAdjustment component in Instrument.

code.name: FRN

code.name: IMM

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE

code.name: TBILL

field.name: NoDeliverySchedules
field.synopsis: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of delivery schedule.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleXID
field.synopsis: Identifier for this instance of delivery schedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleNotional
field.synopsis: Physical delivery quantity.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleNotionalUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: DeliveryScheduleNotionalCommodityFrequency
field.synopsis: The frequency of notional delivery.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleNegativeTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41046). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: DeliverySchedulePositiveTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41046). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: DeliveryScheduleToleranceUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: DeliveryScheduleToleranceType
field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value type.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlCountry
field.synopsis: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeZone
field.synopsis: Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlFlowType
field.synopsis: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
field.synopsis: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

field.name: NoDeliveryScheduleSettlDays
field.synopsis: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlDay
field.synopsis: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTotalHours
field.synopsis: The sum of the total hours specified in the DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeGrp component.

field.name: NoDeliveryScheduleSettlTimes
field.synopsis: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlStart
field.synopsis: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41057).

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlEnd
field.synopsis: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41057).

field.name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

field.name: DeliveryStreamType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

field.name: DeliveryStreamPipeline
field.synopsis: The name of the oil delivery pipeline.

field.name: DeliveryStreamEntryPoint
field.synopsis: The point at which the commodity will enter the delivery mechanism or pipeline.

field.name: DeliveryStreamWithdrawalPoint
field.synopsis: The point at which the commodity product will be withdrawn prior to delivery.

field.name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
field.synopsis: The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product. For bullion, see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

field.name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryRestriction
field.synopsis: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

field.name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryContingency
field.synopsis: Specifies the electricity delivery contingency. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

field.name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
field.synopsis: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

field.name: DeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
field.synopsis: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

field.name: DeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
field.synopsis: Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/risk-apportionment for the details of the external code list.

field.name: DeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
field.synopsis: Specifies the title transfer location.

field.name: DeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
field.synopsis: Specifies the condition of title transfer.

code.name: DoesNotTransfer
code.synopsis: Does not transfer with risk of loss

field.name: DeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
field.synopsis: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

field.name: DeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryStreamToleranceType(41074). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: DeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryStreamToleranceType(41074). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: DeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: DeliveryStreamToleranceType
field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value type.

field.name: DeliveryStreamToleranceOptionSide
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

field.name: DeliveryStreamTotalPositiveTolerance
field.synopsis: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

field.name: DeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
field.synopsis: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

field.name: DeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
field.synopsis: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

field.name: DeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
field.synopsis: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.

field.name: DeliveryStreamElectingPartySide
field.synopsis: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period as found in a swing or interruptible contract.

field.name: NoDeliveryStreamCycles
field.synopsis: Number of delivery cycles in the repeating group.

field.name: DeliveryStreamCycleDesc
field.synopsis: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

field.name: EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDescLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41084) field.

field.name: EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the DeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41082) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the DeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41082) field.

field.name: NoDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
field.synopsis: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

field.name: DeliveryStreamCommoditySource
field.synopsis: The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

field.name: MarketDisruptionProvision
field.synopsis: The consequences of market disruption events.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackProvision
field.synopsis: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

field.name: MarketDisruptionMaximumDays
field.synopsis: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).

field.name: MarketDisruptionMaterialityPercentage
field.synopsis: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.

field.name: MarketDisruptionMinimumFuturesContracts
field.synopsis: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.

field.name: NoMarketDisruptionEvents
field.synopsis: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

field.name: MarketDisruptionEvent
field.synopsis: Specifies the market disruption event. For commodities see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values. For foreign exchange, see https://fixtrading.org/packages/market-disruption-event for code list of applicable event types.

field.name: NoMarketDisruptionFallbacks
field.synopsis: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of disruption fallback. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

field.name: NoMarketDisruptionFallbackReferencePrices
field.synopsis: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierType
field.synopsis: The type of reference price underlier.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityID
field.synopsis: Specifies the identifier value of the security.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityIDSource
field.synopsis: Specifies the class or source scheme of the security identifier.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
field.synopsis: Specifies the description of the underlying security.

field.name: EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDescLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41102) field.

field.name: EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41100) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41100) field.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackOpenUnits
field.synopsis: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackBasketCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: MarketDisruptionFallbackBasketDivisor
field.synopsis: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

field.name: ExerciseDesc
field.synopsis: A description of the option exercise.

field.name: EncodedExerciseDescLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedExerciseDesc(41102) field.

field.name: EncodedExerciseDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ExerciseDesc(41106) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ExerciseDesc(41106) field.

field.name: AutomaticExerciseIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

field.name: AutomaticExerciseThresholdRate
field.synopsis: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

field.name: ExerciseConfirmationMethod
field.synopsis: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

field.name: ManualNoticeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: FallbackExerciseIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

field.name: LimitedRightToConfirmIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

field.name: ExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

field.name: NoOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: OptionExerciseBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: OptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative earliest option exercise date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative earliest exercise date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative earliest exercise date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise dates.

field.name: OptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise dates.

field.name: OptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

field.name: OptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise start date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative exercise start date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

field.name: OptionExerciseSkip
field.synopsis: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.name: OptionExerciseNominationDeadline
field.synopsis: Last date (adjusted) for establishing the option exercise terms.

field.name: OptionExerciseFirstDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first exercise date.

field.name: OptionExerciseLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last exercise date.

field.name: OptionExerciseEarliestTime
field.synopsis: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

field.name: OptionExerciseLatestTime
field.synopsis: The latest exercise time. See also OptionExerciseEarliestTime(41134).

field.name: OptionExerciseTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise time, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values

field.name: NoOptionExerciseDates
field.synopsis: Number of dates in the repeating group.

field.name: OptionExerciseDate
field.synopsis: The option exercise fixed date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on OptionExerciseDateType(41139).

field.name: OptionExerciseDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

field.name: NoOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise expiration date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative exercise expiration date offset.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

field.name: OptionExerciseExpirationRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of exercise expiration dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the DateAdjustment component in Instrument.

field.synopsis: Specifies the type of option exercise expiration date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

field.name: PaymentScheduleRateSpreadType

field.name: PaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure

field.name: PaymentScheduleStepUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: The schedule step unit of measure (UOM).

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingLagPeriod

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod

field.name: PaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator
field.synopsis: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', the Flat Rate is the New Worldwide Tanker Nominal Freight Scale for the Freight Index Route taken at the Trade Date of the transaction "Fixed". If 'N' it is taken on each Pricing Date "Floating".

field.name: PaymentStreamFlatRateAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the actual monetary value of the flat rate when PaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator(41180) = 'Y'.

field.name: PaymentStreamFlatRateCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of the actual flat rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentStreamMaximumPaymentAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the limit on the total payment amount.

field.name: PaymentStreamMaximumPaymentCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of total payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentStreamMaximumTransactionAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the limit on the payment amount that goes out in any particular calculation period.

field.name: PaymentStreamMaximumTransactionCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of the period payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixedAmountUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the fixed payment amount unit of measure (UOM).

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: PaymentStreamTotalFixedAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the total fixed payment amount.

field.name: PaymentStreamWorldScaleRate

field.name: PaymentStreamContractPrice
field.synopsis: The price per relevant unit for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a dry voyage charter or time charter commodity swap.

field.name: PaymentStreamContractPriceCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of PaymentStreamContractPrice(41190). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: NoPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenters

field.name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2CurvePeriod

field.name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2CurveUnit

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalRate

field.synopsis: When specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date to the end of the calendar period in which the effective date falls (e.g. Jan 15 - Jan 31 if the calculation periods are one month long and effective date is Jan 15.). If 'N' or not specified, it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date for one whole period (e.g. Jan 15 to Feb 14 if the calculation periods are one month long and the effective date is Jan 15.).

field.name: StreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenter

field.name: StreamCommodityBase

For metals see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-metal-product-type for values. For bullion see https://fixtrading.org/packages/bullion-type for the external code list of bullion types.

field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlAmount(41357) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.synopsis: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

field.name: LegCashSettlValuationSubsequentBusinessDaysOffset
field.synopsis: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement.

field.name: LegCashSettlNumOfValuationDates
field.synopsis: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of applicable valuation dates.

field.name: LegCashSettlQuoteMethod
field.synopsis: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

field.name: LegCashSettlQuoteAmount
field.synopsis: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

field.name: LegCashSettlQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlQuoteAmount(41352) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

field.name: LegCashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
field.synopsis: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

field.name: LegCashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the LegCashSettlQuoteMinimumAmount(41354) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

field.name: LegCashSettlBusinessDays

field.name: LegCashSettlAmount
field.synopsis: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

field.name: LegCashSettlRecoveryFactor
field.synopsis: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount calculated is (1 - LegCashSettlRecoveryFactor(41358)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

field.name: LegCashSettlFixedTermIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

field.name: LegCashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in LegCashSettlAmount(41357).

field.name: LegCashSettlValuationMethod
field.synopsis: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

field.name: LegCashSettlTermXID

field.name: LegDeliverySchedulePositiveTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41417). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

field.synopsis: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeZone
field.synopsis: Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlFlowType
field.synopsis: Specifies the delivery flow type.

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
field.synopsis: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

field.name: NoLegDeliveryScheduleSettlDays
field.synopsis: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlDay
field.synopsis: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTotalHours
field.synopsis: The sum of the total hours specified in the LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeGrp component.

field.name: NoLegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimes
field.synopsis: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlStart
field.synopsis: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41428).

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlEnd
field.synopsis: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41428).

field.name: LegDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamPipeline
field.synopsis: The name of the oil delivery pipeline.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamEntryPoint
field.synopsis: The point at which the commodity will enter the delivery mechanism or pipeline.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamWithdrawalPoint
field.synopsis: The point at which the commodity product will be withdrawn prior to delivery.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
field.synopsis: The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product. For bullion, see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryRestriction
field.synopsis: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingency
field.synopsis: Specifies the electricity delivery contingency. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
field.synopsis: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
field.synopsis: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
field.synopsis: Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/risk-apportionment for the details of the external code list.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
field.synopsis: Specifies the title transfer location.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
field.synopsis: Specifies the condition of title transfer.

code.name: DoesNotTransfer

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
field.synopsis: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
field.synopsis: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
field.synopsis: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
field.synopsis: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamElectingPartySide

field.name: LegStreamAssetAttributeValue
field.synopsis: Specifies the value of the attribute.

field.name: LegStreamAssetAttributeLimit
field.synopsis: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

field.name: NoLegDeliveryStreamCycles
field.synopsis: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
field.synopsis: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41459) field.

field.name: EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41457) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegLeg DeliveryStream(41457) field.

field.name: NoLegDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
field.synopsis: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamCommoditySource
field.synopsis: The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionProvision
field.synopsis: The consequences of market disruption events.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackProvision
field.synopsis: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionMaximumDays
field.synopsis: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionMaterialityPercentage
field.synopsis: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionMinimumFuturesContracts
field.synopsis: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.

field.name: NoLegMarketDisruptionEvents
field.synopsis: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

field.synopsis: Specifies the market disruption event. For commodities see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values. For foreign exchange, see https://fixtrading.org/packages/market-disruption-event for code list of applicable event types.

field.name: NoLegMarketDisruptionFallbacks
field.synopsis: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of disruption fallback. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

field.name: NoLegMarketDisruptionFallbackReferencePrices
field.synopsis: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityIDSource

field.name: EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDescLen

field.name: EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackOpenUnits
field.synopsis: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketDivisor
field.synopsis: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

field.name: LegExerciseDesc

field.name: EncodedLegExerciseDescLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegExerciseDesc(41483) field.

field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field.

field.name: LegAutomaticExerciseThresholdRate

field.synopsis: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

field.synopsis: Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegFallbackExerciseIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

field.name: LegLimitRightToConfirmIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

field.name: LegExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.synopsis: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.synopsis: The unadjusted first exercise date.

field.name: LegOptionExerciseLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last exercise date.

field.synopsis: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

field.name: LegOptionExerciseLatestTime
field.synopsis: The latest exercise time. See also LegOptionExerciseEarliestTime(41509).

field.synopsis: The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise time, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative exercise expiration date offset.

field.name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

field.name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

field.name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of exercise expiration dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the LegDateAdjustment component in InstrumentLeg.

field.synopsis: Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTotalHours

field.synopsis: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41776).

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlEnd
field.synopsis: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41776).

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamPipeline

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamEntryPoint

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
field.synopsis: The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product. For bullion see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
field.synopsis: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
field.synopsis: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
field.synopsis: Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/risk-apportionment for the details of the external code list.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
field.synopsis: Specifies the title transfer location.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
field.synopsis: Specifies the title transfer condition.

code.name: DoesNotTransfer

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
field.synopsis: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41793). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
field.synopsis: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41793). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

field.synopsis: Specifies the tolerance value type.

field.synopsis: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTotalPositiveTolerance
field.synopsis: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
field.synopsis: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
field.synopsis: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
field.synopsis: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamElectingPartySide
field.synopsis: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period e.g. a swing or interruptible contract.

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamAssetAttributes
field.synopsis: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamAssetAttributeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the name of the attribute. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-attribute-type for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamAssetAttributeValue
field.synopsis: Specifies the value of the attribute.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamAssetAttributeLimit
field.synopsis: The limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41805) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41805) field.

field.name: NoUnderlyingDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
field.synopsis: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamCommoditySource
field.synopsis: The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

field.name: UnderlyingExerciseDesc

field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingExerciseDesc(41810) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingExerciseDesc(41810) field.

field.synopsis: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

field.synopsis: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

field.synopsis: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

field.synopsis: Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingFallbackExerciseIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

field.name: UnderlyingLimitedRightToConfirmIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the Expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

field.name: UnderlyingExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.synopsis: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixedAmountUnitOfMeasure

field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.synopsis: Secondary time unit associated with the payment stream’s floating rate index curve.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2CurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Secondary time unit multiplier for the payment stream’s floating rate index curve.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexLocation
field.synopsis: Specifies the location of the floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexLevel
field.synopsis: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD index level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate index level.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
