field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamSettlLevel
field.synopsis: Specifies how weather index units are to be calculated.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamReferenceLevel
field.synopsis: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD reference level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamReferenceLevelUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate reference level.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamReferenceLevelEqualsZeroIndicator
field.synopsis: When set to 'Y', it indicates that the weather reference level equals zero.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of the floating rate spread. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the floating rate spread.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateConversionFactor
field.synopsis: The number to be multiplied by the derived floating rate of the underlying's payment stream in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the floating rate conversion factor is 1.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateSpreadType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLastResetRate
field.synopsis: The floating rate determined at the most recent reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalRate
field.synopsis: The floating rate determined at the final reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCalculationLagPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the calculation lag duration.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCalculationLagUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the calculation lag duration.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the commodity pricing day type.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayDistribution
field.synopsis: The distribution of pricing days.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayCount
field.synopsis: The number of days over which pricing should take place.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCalendar
field.synopsis: Specifies the business calendar to use for pricing. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-business-calendar for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: LegStreamCommoditySettlTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the format of the commodity settlement start and end times.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the format of the commodity settlement start and end times.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDates
field.synopsis: Number of payment dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDate
field.synopsis: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed stream payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPaymentDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of payment date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamMasterAgreementPaymentDatesIndicator
field.synopsis: When set to 'Y', it indicates that payment dates are specified in the relevant master agreement.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDates
field.synopsis: Number of pricing dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDate
field.synopsis: An adjusted or unadjusted fixed pricing date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of pricing date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDays
field.synopsis: Number of pricing days in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayOfWeek
field.synopsis: The day of the week on which pricing takes place.

code.name: EveryDay
code.synopsis: Every day (the default if not specified)

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamPricingDayNumber
field.synopsis: The occurrence of the day of week on which pricing takes place.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPricingDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPricingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the pricing or fixing date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPricingDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted pricing or fixing date.

field.name: UnderlyingPricingDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the pricing or fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPricingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted pricing or fixing date.

field.name: UnderlyingPricingTime
field.synopsis: The local market pricing or fixing time.

field.name: UnderlyingPricingTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Specifies the business center for determining the pricing or fixing time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDates
field.synopsis: Number of calculation period dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDate
field.synopsis: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed calculation period date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of fixed calculation period date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDatesXID
field.synopsis: Identifier of this calculation period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationPeriodDatesXIDRef
field.synopsis: Cross reference to another calculation period for duplicating its properties.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationBalanceOfFirstPeriod
field.synopsis: When specified and set to 'Y', it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date to the end of the calendar period in which the effective date falls (e.g. Jan 15 - Jan 31 if the calculation periods are one month long and effective date is Jan 15.). If 'N' or not specified, it indicates that the first calculation period should run from the effective date for one whole period (e.g. Jan 15 to Feb 14 if the calculation periods are one month long and the effective date is Jan 15.).

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationCorrectionPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCalculationCorrectionUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the length of time after the publication of the data when corrections can be made.

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the commodity delivery date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityBase
field.synopsis: Specifies the general base type of the commodity traded. Where possible, this should follow the naming convention used in the 2005 ISDA Commodity Definitions.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of commodity product. For coal see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-type for values. For metals see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-metal-product-type for values. For bullion see https://fixtrading.org/packages/bullion-type for the external code list of bullion types.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySecurityID
field.synopsis: Specifies the market identifier for the commodity.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySecurityIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of the UnderlyingStreamCommoditySecurityIDSource(41966) value.

code.name: ConsolidatedTapeAssociation
code.synopsis: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc
field.synopsis: Description of the commodity asset.

field.name: EncodedUnderlyingStreamCommodityDescLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc(41970) field.

field.name: EncodedUnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc(41968) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingStreamCommodityDesc(41968) field.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: The unit of measure (UOM) of the commodity asset.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityCurrency
field.synopsis: Identifies the currency of the commodity asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityExchange
field.synopsis: Identifies the exchange where the commodity is traded.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityRateSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information used for commodities. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/commodity-rate-source for code list of applicable sources.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityRateReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityRateReferencePageHeading
field.synopsis: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamDataProvider
field.synopsis: Specifies the commodity data or information provider. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-information-provider for values.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityPricingType
field.synopsis: Specifies how the pricing or rate setting of the trade is to be determined or based upon. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/commodity-rate-pricing-type for code list of applicable commodity pricing types.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityNearbySettlDayPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the nearby settlement day.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityNearbySettlDayUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the nearby settlement day.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted commodity delivery date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the commodity delivery date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted commodity delivery date.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlMonth
field.synopsis: Specifies a fixed single month for commodity delivery.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateRollPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the commodity delivery date roll.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDateRollUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the commodity delivery date roll.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the commodity delivery roll day type.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityXID
field.synopsis: Identifier of this stream commodity for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityXIDRef
field.synopsis: Reference to a stream commodity elsewhere in the message.

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommodityAltIDs
field.synopsis: Number of alternate security identifers.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityAltID
field.synopsis: Alternate security identifier value for the commodity.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityAltIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of the alternate commodity security identifier.

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommodityDataSources
field.synopsis: Number of commodity data sources in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDataSourceID
field.synopsis: Data source identifier.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDataSourceIDType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of data source identifier.

code.name: WeatherStation
code.synopsis: Weather station WBAN (Weather Bureau Army Navy)

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDays
field.synopsis: Number of days in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlDay
field.synopsis: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTotalHours
field.synopsis: Sum of the hours specified in UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeGrp.

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimes
field.synopsis: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlStart
field.synopsis: The start time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlEnd
field.synopsis: The end time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

field.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriods
field.synopsis: Number of commodity settlement periods in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlCountry
field.synopsis: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeZone
field.synopsis: Commodity delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight". See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlFlowType
field.synopsis: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotional
field.synopsis: Specifies the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotionalUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the settlement period frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the settlement period frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPrice
field.synopsis: The settlement period price.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of the settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
field.synopsis: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXID
field.synopsis: Identifier of this settlement period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXIDRef
field.synopsis: Cross reference to another settlement period for duplicating its properties.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamXID
field.synopsis: Identifier of this UnderlyingStream for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer
field.synopsis: Issuer of the bond.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalXIDRef
field.synopsis: Cross reference to another UnderlyingStream notional for duplicating its properties.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the swap stream's notional frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the swap stream's notional frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalCommodityFrequency
field.synopsis: The commodity's notional or quantity delivery frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotional
field.synopsis: Specifies the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotionalUnitOfMeasure
field.synopsis: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) for the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

code.name: PrincipalWithRelationToDebtInstrument
code.synopsis: Principal with relation to debt instrument

field.name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42026) field.

field.name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondSeniority
field.synopsis: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponType
field.synopsis: Coupon type of the bond.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponRate
field.synopsis: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
field.synopsis: The maturity date of the bond.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondParValue
field.synopsis: The par value of the bond.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
field.synopsis: Total issued amount of the bond.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDayCount
field.synopsis: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

field.name: NoUnderlyingAdditionalTerms
field.synopsis: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

field.name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlDealers
field.synopsis: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDealer
field.synopsis: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.

field.name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlTerms
field.synopsis: Number of elements in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
field.synopsis: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationSubsequentBusinessDaysOffset
field.synopsis: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlNumOfValuationDates
field.synopsis: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of applicable valuation dates.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationTime
field.synopsis: Time of valuation.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteMethod
field.synopsis: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount
field.synopsis: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
field.synopsis: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessDays
field.synopsis: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlAmount
field.synopsis: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor
field.synopsis: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount is calculated is (1 - UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor(42055)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlFixedTermIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054).

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationMethod
field.synopsis: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlTermXID
field.synopsis: Name referenced from UnderlyingSettlementTermXIDRef(41315).

field.name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlTerms
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlBusinessDays
field.synopsis: A number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used.

field.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
field.synopsis: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

field.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlTermXID
field.synopsis: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

field.name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of delivery obligation applicable for physical settlement. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

field.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
field.synopsis: Physical settlement delivery obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(42066). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTerms
field.synopsis: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional
field.synopsis: The notional amount of protection coverage for a floating rate.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency of UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional(42069). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermSellerNotifies
field.synopsis: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
field.synopsis: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources
field.synopsis: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources(42074)=Y) or not.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
field.synopsis: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermXID
field.synopsis: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

field.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEvents
field.synopsis: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for code list of applicable event types.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue
field.synopsis: Protection term event value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(42078). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for applicable event type values.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventCurrency
field.synopsis: Applicable currency if UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue(42079) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for protection term events.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with protection term events.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventDayType
field.synopsis: Day type for events that specify a period and unit.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventRateSource
field.synopsis: Rate source for events that specify a rate source, e.g. Floating rate interest shortfall.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifiers
field.synopsis: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifier
field.synopsis: Protection term event qualifier. Used to further qualify UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(43078).

field.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermObligations
field.synopsis: Number of obligations in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of obligation applicable to the protection terms. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for code list of applicable obligation types.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationValue
field.synopsis: Protection term obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType(42088). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSources
field.synopsis: Number of event news sources in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSource
field.synopsis: Newspaper or electronic news service or source that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
field.synopsis: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
field.synopsis: Last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
field.synopsis: Number of UnderlyingProvision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
field.synopsis: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(42101).

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of quote information.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the quote source.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTime
field.synopsis: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
field.synopsis: Number of UnderlyingProvision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
field.synopsis: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(42114).

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise frequency.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
field.synopsis: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
field.synopsis: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
field.synopsis: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTime
field.synopsis: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBizDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convnetion used to adjust the underlying instrument provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisions
field.synopsis: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionType
field.synopsis: Type of provision.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date of the provision.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted date of the provision.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent
field.synopsis: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent(42156) or in the underlying provision parties component.

code.name: MasterAgreeent
code.synopsis: As specified in the master agreement

code.name: Supplement
code.synopsis: As specified in the standard terms supplement

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
field.synopsis: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
field.synopsis: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
field.synopsis: The instrument provision's exercise style.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
field.synopsis: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
field.synopsis: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
field.synopsis: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
field.synopsis: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
field.synopsis: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
field.synopsis: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlMethod
field.synopsis: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionText
field.synopsis: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

field.name: EncodedUnderlyingProvisionTextLen
field.synopsis: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingProvisionText(42712) field.

field.name: EncodedUnderlyingProvisionText
field.synopsis: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingProvisionText(42170) field.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionPartyIDs
field.synopsis: Number of parties identified in the contract provision.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyID
field.synopsis: The party identifier for the payment settlement party.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyIDSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of the UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) value.

code.name: UKNationalInsuranceOrPensionNumber
code.synopsis: UK National Insurance or Pension Number

code.name: USEmployerOrTaxIDNumber
code.synopsis: US Employer or Tax ID Number

code.name: TaiwaneseForeignInvestorID
code.synopsis: Taiwanese Qualified Foreign Investor ID QFII/FID

code.name: ISITCAcronym
code.synopsis: Directed broker three character acronym as defined in ISITC "ETC Best Practice" guidelines document

code.name: BIC
code.synopsis: BIC (Bank Identification Code - SWIFT managed) code (ISO9362 - See "Appendix 6-B")

code.name: GeneralIdentifier
code.synopsis: Generally accepted market participant identifier (e.g. NASD mnemonic)

code.name: SettlementEntityLocation
code.synopsis: Settlement Entity Location (note if Local Market Settlement use "E=ISO Country Code") (see "Appendix 6-G" for valid values)

code.name: CSDParticipant
code.synopsis: CSD participant/member code (e.g. Euroclear, DTC, CREST or Kassenverein number

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionPartyRole
field.synopsis: Identifies the type or role of UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174) specified.

code.name: OrderOriginationTrader
code.synopsis: Order Origination Trader (associated with Order Origination Firm - i.e. trader who initiates/submits the order)

code.name: ExecutingTrader
code.synopsis: Executing Trader (associated with Executing Firm - actually executes)

code.name: GiveupClearingFirmDepr
code.synopsis: Giveup Clearing Firm (firm to which trade is given up)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityLiquidity
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the most relevant market in terms of liquidity (CAL)

code.name: CompetentAuthorityTransactionVenue
code.synopsis: Competent Authority of the Transaction (Execution) Venue (CATV)

code.name: PrimeBroker
code.synopsis: Prime Broker providing General Trade Services

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionPartySubIDs
field.synopsis: Number of sub-party IDs to be reported for the party.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionPartySubID
field.synopsis: Underlying provision party sub-identifier, if applicable for UnderlyingProvisionPartyID(42174).

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionPartySubIDType
field.synopsis: The type of UnderlyingProvisionPartySubID(42178).

code.name: RegistrationNumber
code.synopsis: Registration number (for settlement instructions and confirmations)

code.name: ContractLinked
code.synopsis: Contract linked to commercial or treasury financing for this counterparty

code.name: ContractAbove
code.synopsis: Contract above clearing threshold for this counterparty

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryPointSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41062).

field.name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryPointDesc
field.synopsis: Description of the delivery point identified in DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41062).

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41433).

field.name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointDesc
field.synopsis: Description of the delivery point identified in LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41433).

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the class or source of UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41781).

field.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPointDesc
field.synopsis: Description of the delivery point identified in UnderlyingDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint(41781).

field.name: NoLegContractualDefinitions
field.synopsis: Number of financing definitions in the repeating group.

field.name: LegContractualDefinition
field.synopsis: Specifies which contract definition, such as those published by ISDA, will apply for the terms of the trade. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-definitions for values.

field.name: NoLegFinancingTermSupplements
field.synopsis: Number of financing terms supplements in the repeating group.

field.name: LegFinancingTermSupplementDesc
field.synopsis: Identifies the applicable contractual supplement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-supplement for values.

field.name: LegFinancingTermSupplementDate
field.synopsis: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the contractual supplement.

field.name: NoLegContractualMatrices
field.synopsis: Number of contractual matrices in the repeating group.

field.name: LegContractualMatrixSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the applicable contract matrix. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/matrix-type-1-0.xml for values.

field.name: LegContractualMatrixDate
field.synopsis: Specifies the publication date of the applicable version of the contract matrix. If not specified, the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

field.name: LegContractualMatrixTerm
field.synopsis: Specifies the applicable key into the relevant contract matrix. In the case of 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions, the LegContractualMatrixTerm(42206) is not applicable and is to be omitted. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-matrix-transaction-type for values.

field.name: CashSettlDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted cash settlement date.

field.name: CashSettlDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the Instrument component.

field.name: CashSettlDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: CashSettlDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: CashSettlDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: CashSettlDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: CashSettlDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted cash settlement date.

field.name: NoCashSettlDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: CashSettlDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: CashSettlPriceSource
field.synopsis: The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

field.name: CashSettlPriceDefault
field.synopsis: The default election for determining settlement price.

field.name: DividendFloatingRateIndex
field.synopsis: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

field.name: DividendFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

field.name: DividendFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

field.name: DividendFloatingRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

field.name: DividendFloatingRateSpread
field.synopsis: The basis points spread from the index specified in DividendFloatingRateIndex(42218).

field.name: DividendFloatingRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: DividendFloatingRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: DividendCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: DividendCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: DividendCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: DividendFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: DividendFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: DividendFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: DividendInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: DividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

field.name: DividendFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: DividendAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

field.name: DividendNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: NoDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the DividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymeentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

field.name: DividendAccrualPaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted accrual payment date.

field.name: DividendReinvestmentIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

field.name: DividendEntitlementEvent
field.synopsis: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

field.name: DividendAmountType
field.synopsis: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

field.name: DividendUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: ExtraordinaryDividendPartySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

field.name: ExtraordinaryDividendAmountType
field.synopsis: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

field.name: ExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: DividendAccrualFixedRate
field.synopsis: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal.

field.name: DividendCompoundingMethod
field.synopsis: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

field.name: DividendNumOfIndexUnits
field.synopsis: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

field.name: DividendCashPercentage
field.synopsis: Declared cash dividend percentage.

field.name: DividendCashEquivalentPercentage
field.synopsis: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage.

field.name: NonCashDividendTreatment
field.synopsis: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

field.name: DividendComposition
field.synopsis: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

field.name: SpecialDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

field.name: MaterialDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

field.name: OptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

field.name: AdditionalDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

field.name: AllDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted FX trigger date.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted FX trigger date.

field.name: NoDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the DividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: DividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoDividendPeriods
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the DividendPeriodGrp component.

field.name: DividendPeriodSequence
field.synopsis: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

field.name: DividendPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

field.name: DividendPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

field.name: DividendPeriodUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: DividendPeriodStrikePrice
field.synopsis: Specifies the fixed strike price of the dividend period.

field.name: DividendPeriodBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The dividend period dates business day convention.

field.name: DividendPeriodValuationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted dividend period valuation date.

field.name: DividendPeriodValuationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period valuation date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: DividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: DividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: DividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: DividendPeriodValuationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

field.name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted dividend period payment date.

field.name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: DividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

field.name: DividendPeriodXID
field.synopsis: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

field.name: NoDividendPeriodBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the DividendPeriodBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: DividendPeriodBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoExtraordinaryEvents
field.synopsis: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

field.name: ExtraordinaryEventType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to the reference entity. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

field.name: ExtraordinaryEventValue
field.synopsis: The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to ExtraordinaryEventType(42297). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted cash settlement date.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the InstrumentLeg component.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted cash settlement date.

field.name: NoLegCashSettlDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: LegCashSettlDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegCashSettlPriceSource
field.synopsis: The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

field.name: LegCashSettlPriceDefault
field.synopsis: The default election for determining settlement price.

field.name: NoLegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegDividendFloatingRateIndex
field.synopsis: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

field.name: LegDividendFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

field.name: LegDividendFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

field.name: LegDividendFloatingRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

field.name: LegDividendFloatingRateSpread
field.synopsis: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegDividendFloatingRateIndex(42312).

field.name: LegDividendFloatingRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: LegDividendFloatingRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: LegDividendCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: LegDividendCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegDividendCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegDividendFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: LegDividendFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegDividendFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegDividendInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: LegDividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

field.name: LegDividendFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: LegDividendAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

field.name: LegDividendNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualPaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted accrual payment date.

field.name: LegDividendReinvestmentIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

field.name: LegDividendEntitlementEvent
field.synopsis: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

field.name: LegDividendAmountType
field.synopsis: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

field.name: LegDividendUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.
