field.synopsis: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

field.name: LegExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: LegDividendAccrualFixedRate
field.synopsis: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal.

field.name: LegDividendCompoundingMethod
field.synopsis: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

field.name: LegDividendNumOfIndexUnits
field.synopsis: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

field.name: LegDividendCashPercentage
field.synopsis: Declared cash dividend percentage.

field.name: LegDividendCashEquivalentPercentage
field.synopsis: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage.

field.name: LegNonCashDividendTreatment
field.synopsis: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

field.name: LegDividendComposition
field.synopsis: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

field.name: LegSpecialDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

field.name: LegMaterialDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

field.name: LegOptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

field.name: LegAdditionalDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

field.name: LegAllDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted FX trigger date.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted FX trigger date.

field.name: NoLegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the LegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: LegDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoLegDividendPeriods
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the LegDividendPeriodGrp component.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodSequence
field.synopsis: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodStrikePrice
field.synopsis: Specifies the fixed strike price of the dividend period.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The dividend period dates business day convention.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted dividend period valuation date.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period valuation date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodValuationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted dividend period payment date.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodXID
field.synopsis: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

field.name: NoLegDividendPeriodBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: The number of entries in the LegDividendPeriodBusinessCentersGrp component.

field.name: LegDividendPeriodBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoLegExtraordinaryEvents
field.synopsis: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

field.name: LegExtraordinaryEventType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to the reference entity. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

field.name: LegExtraordinaryEventValue
field.synopsis: The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to LegExtraordinaryEventType(42389). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectingPartySide
field.synopsis: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

field.name: LegMakeWholeDate
field.synopsis: The date through which option cannot be exercised without penalty.

field.name: LegMakeWholeAmount
field.synopsis: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the LegMakeWholeDate(42392).

field.name: LegMakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
field.synopsis: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

field.name: LegMakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
field.synopsis: The point on the floating rate index curve.

field.name: LegMakeWholeRecallSpread
field.synopsis: Spread over the floating rate index.

field.name: LegMakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
field.synopsis: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

field.name: LegMakeWholeInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
field.synopsis: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
field.synopsis: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
field.synopsis: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
field.synopsis: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

field.name: NoLegPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
field.synopsis: Number of dates in the repeating group.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDate
field.synopsis: The compounding date. Type of date is specified in LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42407).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The compounding dates business day convention.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
field.synopsis: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: NoLegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted compounding end date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted compounding end date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
field.synopsis: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
field.synopsis: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42427).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted compounding start date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted compounding start date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
field.synopsis: Length in bytes of the LegPaymentStreamFormulaImage(42452) field.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaImage
field.synopsis: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted final price payment date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted final price payment date.

field.name: NoLegPaymentStreamFixingDates
field.synopsis: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDate
field.synopsis: The fixing date. Type of date is specified in LegPaymentStreamFixingDateType(42461).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFixingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted initial price observation date.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: LegReturnRateNotionalReset
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
field.synopsis: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
field.synopsis: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
field.synopsis: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
field.synopsis: For a variance swap specifies how LegPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42472) is expressed.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
field.synopsis: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
field.synopsis: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
field.synopsis: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
field.synopsis: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
field.synopsis: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
field.synopsis: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
field.synopsis: Vega Notional represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realized volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of reference amounts.

field.name: NoLegPaymentStreamFormulas
field.synopsis: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFormula
field.synopsis: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

field.name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaDesc
field.synopsis: A description of the math formula in LegPaymentStreamFormula(42486).

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted stub end date.

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The stub end date business day convention.

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the stub end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub end date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative stub end date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative stub end date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted stub end date.

field.name: NoLegPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: LegPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub end date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted stub start date.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The stub start date business day convention.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the stub start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub start date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative stub start date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative stub start date offset.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted stub start date.

field.name: NoLegPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: LegPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub start date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegProvisionBreakFeeElection
field.synopsis: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

field.name: LegProvisionBreakFeeRate
field.synopsis: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: NoLegReturnRateDates
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate date repeating group.

field.name: LegReturnRateDateMode
field.synopsis: Specifies the valuation type applicable to the return rate date.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationEndDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationFrequencyRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of return rate valuation dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

field.name: NoLegReturnRateFXConversions
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

field.name: LegReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegReturnRateFXRate
field.synopsis: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in LegReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(42531).

field.name: LegReturnRateFXRateCalc
field.synopsis: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in LegReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(42531).

field.name: NoLegReturnRates
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

field.name: LegReturnRatePriceSequence
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

field.name: LegReturnRateCommissionBasis
field.synopsis: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

field.name: LegReturnRateCommissionAmount
field.synopsis: The commission amount.

field.name: LegReturnRateCommissionCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegReturnRateTotalCommissionPerTrade
field.synopsis: The total commission per trade.

field.name: LegReturnRateDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateAmountRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteUnits
field.synopsis: Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

code.name: AsSpecifiedInMasterConfirmation
code.synopsis: As specified in the master confirmation

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteTime
field.synopsis: The time when the quote is to be generated.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteDate
field.synopsis: The date when the quote is to be generated.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteExpirationTime
field.synopsis: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with LegReturnRateQuoteTimeType(42547) or LegReturnRateQuoteTime(42548) and LegReturnRateQuoteDate(42549), e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuoteExchange
field.synopsis: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

field.name: LegReturnRateQuotePricingModel
field.synopsis: Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateCashFlowType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

code.name: AsSpecifiedInMasterConfirmation
code.synopsis: As specified in the master confirmation

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationTime
field.synopsis: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with LegReturnRateValuationTimeType(42555) or LegReturnRateValuationTime(42556), e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationPriceOption
field.synopsis: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

field.name: LegReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
field.synopsis: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

field.name: NoLegReturnRateInformationSources
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate information source repeating group.

field.name: LegReturnRateInformationSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

field.name: LegReturnRateReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When LegReturnRateInformationSource(42561) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option.

field.name: LegReturnRateReferencePageHeading
field.synopsis: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

field.name: NoLegReturnRatePrices
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

field.name: LegReturnRatePriceBasis
field.synopsis: The basis of the return price.

field.name: LegReturnRatePrice
field.synopsis: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

field.name: LegReturnRatePriceCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of the price of the leg swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: LegReturnRatePriceType
field.synopsis: Specifies whether the LegReturnRatePrice(42566) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

field.name: NoLegReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date business center repeating group.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoLegReturnRateValuationDates
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDate
field.synopsis: The return rate valuation date. The type of date is specified in LegReturnRateValuationDateType(42573).

field.name: LegReturnRateValuationDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted settlement method election date.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The settlement method election date adjustment business day convention.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the settlement method election date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative settlement method election date offset.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative settlement method election date offset.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative settlement method election date offset.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted settlement method election date.

field.name: NoLegSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: LegSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the settlement method election unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: LegStreamVersion
field.synopsis: The stream version identifier when there have been modifications to the contract over time. Helps signal when there are embedded changes.

field.name: LegStreamVersionEffectiveDate
field.synopsis: The effective date of the LegStreamVersion(42583).

field.name: LegStreamNotionalDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: LegStreamNotionalAdjustments
field.synopsis: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

field.name: StreamCommodityDeliveryPricingRegion
field.synopsis: The delivery or pricing region associated with the commodity swap. See http://www.ecfr.gov/cgi-bin/text-idx?SID=660d6a40f836aa6ddf213cba080c5b22&node=ap17.2.43_17.e&rgn=div9 for the external code list.

field.name: LegStreamCommodityDeliveryPricingRegion
field.synopsis: The delivery or pricing region associated with the commodity swap. See http://www.ecfr.gov/cgi-bin/text-idx?SID=660d6a40f836aa6ddf213cba080c5b22&node=ap17.2.43_17.e&rgn=div9 for the external code list.

field.name: UnderlyingStreamCommodityDeliveryPricingRegion
field.synopsis: The delivery or pricing region associated with the commodity swap. See http://www.ecfr.gov/cgi-bin/text-idx?SID=660d6a40f836aa6ddf213cba080c5b22&node=ap17.2.43_17.e&rgn=div9 for the external code list.

field.name: SettlMethodElectingPartySide
field.synopsis: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

field.name: MakeWholeDate
field.synopsis: The date through which option cannot be exercised without penalty.

field.name: MakeWholeAmount
field.synopsis: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the MakeWholeDate(42591).

field.name: MakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
field.synopsis: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

field.name: MakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
field.synopsis: The point on the floating rate index curve.

field.name: MakeWholeRecallSpread
field.synopsis: Spread over the floating rate index.

field.name: MakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
field.synopsis: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

field.name: MakeWholeInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

field.name: PaymentAmountRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the reference amount when the payment amount is relative to another amount in the message. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

field.name: PaymentAmountDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method by which a payment amount is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
field.synopsis: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
field.synopsis: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

field.name: PaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

field.name: PaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
field.synopsis: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
field.synopsis: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

field.name: NoPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
field.synopsis: Number of dates in the repeating group.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDate
field.synopsis: The compounding date. The type of date is specified in PaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42608).

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The compounding dates business day convention.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
field.synopsis: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: PaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: PaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: NoPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted compounding end date.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted compounding end date.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
field.synopsis: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
field.synopsis: The basis points spread from the index specified in PaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42628).

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted compounding start date.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted compounding start date.

field.name: PaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
field.synopsis: Length in bytes of the PaymentStreamFormulaImage(42563) field.

field.name: PaymentStreamFormulaImage
field.synopsis: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted final price payment date.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetfPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted final price payment date.

field.name: NoPaymentStreamFixingDates
field.synopsis: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDate
field.synopsis: The fixing date. The type of date is specified in PaymentStreamFixingDateType(42662).

field.name: PaymentStreamFixingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

field.name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

field.name: PaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted initial price observation date.

field.name: PaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: ReturnRateNotionalReset
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
field.synopsis: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
field.synopsis: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
field.synopsis: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
field.synopsis: For a variance swap specifies how PaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42673) is expressed.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
field.synopsis: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
field.synopsis: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination.

field.name: PaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
field.synopsis: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

field.name: PaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
field.synopsis: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

field.name: PaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
field.synopsis: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

field.name: PaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

field.name: PaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
field.synopsis: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: PaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
field.synopsis: "Vega Notional" represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

field.name: NoPaymentStreamFormulas
field.synopsis: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

field.name: PaymentStreamFormula
field.synopsis: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

field.name: PaymentStreamFormulaDesc
field.synopsis: A description of the math formula in PaymentStreamFormula(42684).

field.name: PaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: PaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: PaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of reference amounts.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted stub end date.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The stub end date business day convention.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the stub end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub end date offset.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative stub end date offset.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative stub end date offset.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted stub end date.

field.name: NoPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: PaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub end date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted stub start date.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The stub start date business day convention.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the stub start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub start date offset.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative stub start date offset.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative stub start date offset.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted stub start date.

field.name: NoPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: PaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub start date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ProvisionBreakFeeElection
field.synopsis: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

field.name: ProvisionBreakFeeRate
field.synopsis: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: NoReturnRateDates
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate date repeating group.

field.name: ReturnRateDateMode
field.synopsis: Specifies the valuation type applicable to the return rate date.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationEndDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationFrequencyRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of return rate valuation dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

field.name: NoReturnRateFXConversions
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

field.name: ReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ReturnRateFXRate
field.synopsis: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in ReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(42732).

field.name: ReturnRateFXRateCalc
field.synopsis: Specifies whether ReturnRateFXRate(42733) should be multiplied or divided.

field.name: NoReturnRates
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

field.name: ReturnRatePriceSequence
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

field.name: ReturnRateCommissionBasis
field.synopsis: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

field.name: ReturnRateCommissionAmount
field.synopsis: The commission amount.

field.name: ReturnRateCommissionCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ReturnRateTotalCommissionPerTrade
field.synopsis: The total commission per trade.

field.name: ReturnRateDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: ReturnRateAmountRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteUnits
field.synopsis: Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

code.name: AsSpecifiedInMasterConfirmation
code.synopsis: As specified in the master confirmation

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteTime
field.synopsis: The time when the quote is to be generated.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteDate
field.synopsis: The date when the quote is to be generated.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteExpirationTime
field.synopsis: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with ReturnRateQuoteTimeType(42748) or ReturnRateQuoteTime(42749) and ReturnRateQuoteDate(42750), e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ReturnRateQuoteExchange
field.synopsis: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

field.name: ReturnRateQuotePricingModel
field.synopsis: Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

field.name: ReturnRateCashFlowType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationTimeType
field.synopsis: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

code.name: AsSpecifiedInMasterConfirmation
code.synopsis: As specified in the master confirmation

field.name: ReturnRateValuationTime
field.synopsis: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationTimeBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with ReturnRateValuationTimeType(42756) or ReturnRateValuationTime(42757), e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationPriceOption
field.synopsis: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

field.name: ReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
field.synopsis: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

field.name: NoReturnRateInformationSources
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate information source repeating group.

field.name: ReturnRateInformationSource
field.synopsis: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

field.name: ReturnRateReferencePage
field.synopsis: Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source. For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate. When ReturnRateInformationSource(42762) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

field.name: ReturnRateReferencePageHeading
field.synopsis: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

field.name: NoReturnRatePrices
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

field.name: ReturnRatePriceBasis
field.synopsis: The basis of the return price.

field.name: ReturnRatePrice
field.synopsis: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

field.name: ReturnRatePriceCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency of the price of the underlying swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: ReturnRatePriceType
field.synopsis: Specifies whether the ReturnRatePrice(42767) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

field.name: NoReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date business center repeating group.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoReturnRateValuationDates
field.synopsis: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDate
field.synopsis: The return rate valuation date. Type of date is specified in ReturnRateValuationDateType(42774).

field.name: ReturnRateValuationDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: NoSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the settlement method election unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted settlement method election date.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The settlement method election date adjustment business day convention.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the settlement method election date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative settlement method election date offset.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative settlement method election date offset.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative settlement method election date offset.

field.name: SettlMethodElectionDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted settlement method election date.

field.name: StreamVersion
field.synopsis: The stream version identifier when there have been modifications to the contract over time. Helps signal when there are embedded changes.

field.name: StreamVersionEffectiveDate
field.synopsis: The effective date of the StreamVersion(42784).

field.name: StreamNotionalDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: StreamNotionalAdjustments
field.synopsis: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

field.name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted cash settlement date.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateRelativeTo

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetPeriod
