field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted cash settlement date.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlPriceSource
field.synopsis: The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

field.name: UnderlyingCashSettlPriceDefault
field.synopsis: The default election for determining settlement price.

field.name: NoUnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndex
field.synopsis: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateSpread
field.synopsis: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndex(42801).

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted accrual payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted accrual payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendReinvestmentIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendEntitlementEvent
field.synopsis: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAmountType
field.synopsis: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in a separate instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendPartySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

field.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendAmountType
field.synopsis: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

field.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualFixedRate
field.synopsis: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendCompoundingMethod
field.synopsis: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendNumOfIndexUnits
field.synopsis: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendCashPercentage
field.synopsis: Declared cash dividend percentage.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendCashEquivalentPercentage
field.synopsis: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: UnderlyingNonCashDividendTreatment
field.synopsis: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendComposition
field.synopsis: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

field.name: UnderlyingSpecialDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingMaterialDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingOptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingAdditionalDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingAllDividendsIndicator
field.synopsis: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted FX trigger date.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted FX trigger date.

field.name: NoUnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingDividendPayments
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentDate
field.synopsis: Specifies the date that the dividend or coupon payment is due.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount
field.synopsis: The amount of the dividend or coupon payment.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentCurrency
field.synopsis: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount(42857) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendAccruedInterest
field.synopsis: Accrued interest on the dividend or coupon payment.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutRatio
field.synopsis: Specifies the actual dividend payout ratio associated with the equity or bond underlier.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutConditions
field.synopsis: Specifies the dividend payout conditions that will be applied in the case where the actual ratio is not known, typically because of regulatory or legal uncertainties.

field.name: NoUnderlyingDividendPeriods
field.synopsis: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendPeriodGrp component.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodSequence
field.synopsis: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStrikePrice
field.synopsis: Specifies the fixed strike price of the dividend period.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The dividend period dates business day convention.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted dividend period valuation date.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period valuation date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted dividend period payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodXID
field.synopsis: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

field.name: NoUnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of entries in UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenterGrp.

field.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: NoUnderlyingExtraordinaryEvents
field.synopsis: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType
field.synopsis: Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

field.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventValue
field.synopsis: The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885). See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

field.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectingPartySide
field.synopsis: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

field.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeDate
field.synopsis: The date through which the option cannot be exercised without penalty.

field.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeAmount
field.synopsis: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the UnderlyingMakeWholeDate(42888).

field.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
field.synopsis: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
field.synopsis: The point on the floating rate index curve.

field.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeRecallSpread
field.synopsis: Spread over the floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
field.synopsis: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

field.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
field.synopsis: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
field.synopsis: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
field.synopsis: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterpolationPeriod
field.synopsis: Defines applicable periods for interpolation.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
field.synopsis: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
field.synopsis: Number of dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDate
field.synopsis: The compounding date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42903).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
field.synopsis: The compounding dates business day convention.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
field.synopsis: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
field.synopsis: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

code.name: FRN
code.synopsis: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.

code.name: IMM
code.synopsis: The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.

code.name: IMMCAD
code.synopsis: The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.

code.name: IMMAUD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.

code.name: IMMNZD
code.synopsis: The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.

code.name: SFE
code.synopsis: The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.

code.name: TBILL
code.synopsis: The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted first date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted last date of the compounding schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters
field.synopsis: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
field.synopsis: The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted compounding end date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted compounding end date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
field.synopsis: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
field.synopsis: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
field.synopsis: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42923).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
field.synopsis: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
field.synopsis: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
field.synopsis: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
field.synopsis: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
field.synopsis: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
field.synopsis: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
field.synopsis: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
field.synopsis: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
field.synopsis: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted compounding start date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted compounding start date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
field.synopsis: Length in bytes of the UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImage(42948) field.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImage
field.synopsis: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted final price payment date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetPeriod
field.synopsis: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
field.synopsis: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted final price payment date.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDates
field.synopsis: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDate
field.synopsis: The fixing date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateType(42957).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateType
field.synopsis: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
field.synopsis: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
field.synopsis: Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
field.synopsis: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
field.synopsis: The adjusted initial price observation date.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
field.synopsis: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingReturnRateNotionalReset
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
field.synopsis: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
field.synopsis: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
field.synopsis: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
field.synopsis: For a variance swap specifies how UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42968) is expressed.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
field.synopsis: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
field.synopsis: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
field.synopsis: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
field.synopsis: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
field.synopsis: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
field.synopsis: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
field.synopsis: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
field.synopsis: Vega Notional represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
field.synopsis: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
field.synopsis: Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
field.synopsis: Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document. See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of reference amounts.

field.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulas
field.synopsis: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormula
field.synopsis: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

field.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaDesc
field.synopsis: A description of the math formula in UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormula(42982).
